name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति/अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग हेतु पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing financial assistance for post-secondary education including tuition fees, maintenance allowance, and academic study expenses.
description_hi: मैट्रिकोत्तर कक्षाओं (11वीं, 12वीं, स्नातक, स्नातकोत्तर) में अध्ययनरत छात्रों को शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं जीवन निर्वाह भत्ता।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: OBC, SC, and ST students enrolled in post-matric courses
Low-income students pursuing college or technical diplomas
benefits: Complete reimbursement of non-refundable tuition and institutional fees.
Monthly maintenance allowance of ₹4,000 to ₹13,500 per year depending on course level.
Special study tour and thesis allowance for research students.
documents: Caste Certificate issued by Tehsildar / Competent Authority
Fee Receipt and College Bonafide Certificate
Active Bank Account linked with Aadhaar
application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or respective State scholarship portal.
Select Post-Matric Scholarship scheme and fill academic, caste, and income details.
Upload scanned copies of required documents.
Submit online application and download the verification receipt.
Submit printed copy with attested documents to the educational institution for verification.
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship (OBC)
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति (अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग)
description: Uttar Pradesh state scholarship providing complete tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance stipend for OBC students enrolled in Class 11, 12, undergraduate, postgraduate, and professional degree courses in UP.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (OBC) के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, स्नातक एवं परास्नातक स्तर पर शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: OBC students domiciled in Uttar Pradesh
Students pursuing intermediate, diploma, graduation, and post-graduation
benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement as approved by the fee fixation committee.
Maintenance allowance directly credited via DBT to Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Special allowance for day scholars and hostellers.
documents: Uttar Pradesh Domicile / Niwas Praman Patra
OBC Caste Certificate verified via UP eDistrict portal
Fee Receipt of current academic session
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account (DBT enabled)
application_steps: Visit the official UP Scholarship portal (scholarship.up.gov.in).
Click on 'Student' menu and select 'Registration' -> 'Post Matric Other than Inter' or 'Post Matric Inter'.
Complete registration using Aadhaar number and mobile OTP.
Log in, fill educational, personal, and fee details.
Upload necessary certificates and lock application.
Submit hard copy with document proofs to your college or institute within the designated date.

name: Uttar Pradesh Dashmottar Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश दशमोत्तर (कक्षा 11-12 एवं उच्च शिक्षा) छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: Flagship Uttar Pradesh scholarship scheme for General, OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing higher education, degree programs, engineering, medical, ITI, and polytechnic courses.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार द्वारा उच्च शिक्षा, डिग्री, इंजीनियरिंग, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं मेडिकल कोर्स कर रहे विद्यार्थियों हेतु व्यापक शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: College, university, and technical institute students domiciled in UP
Meritorious and economically disadvantaged students in higher education
benefits: Reimbursement of non-refundable college and university course fees.
Annual scholarship grant ranging from ₹6,000 to ₹50,000+ based on course.
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into student's Aadhaar-linked savings account.
documents: Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
application_steps: Go to scholarship.up.gov.in portal.
Select Student Registration -> Postmatric (Other than Inter) Fresh / Renewal.
Verify Aadhaar with DigiLocker integration.
Fill current course details, roll number, and tuition fee paid.
Verify all details and submit final application.
Forward physical copy to university or college verification officer.

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री अभ्युदय योजना (नि:शुल्क प्रतियोगी परीक्षा कोचिंग)
description: Free coaching program organized across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh for youth preparing for UPSC Civil Services, UPPSC, JEE, NEET, CDS, NDA, and other state entrance examinations.
description_hi: आईएएस, आईपीएस, पीसीएस, नीट, जेईई, एनडीए आदि प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं की तैयारी हेतु राज्य के मेधावी छात्र-छात्राओं को नि:शुल्क कोचिंग एवं टैबलेट सहायता।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Aspirants preparing for competitive examinations in Uttar Pradesh
Students from rural and financially weak backgrounds
benefits: Free classroom coaching delivered by IAS, IPS, PCS officers and subject specialists.
Free high-quality digital study material, question banks, and e-learning resources.
Free tablet/device distribution to selected meritorious coaching participants.
application_steps: Visit the official Abhyudaya portal (abhyudaya.up.gov.in).
Click on 'Register' and select the target exam (UPSC/UPPSC, JEE, NEET, NDA).
Enter educational qualifications and preferred district study center.
Appear for the online eligibility screening test.
Qualified candidates are allotted offline classroom batches or virtual live lectures.

name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme (PM YASASVI)
description: Comprehensive scholarship scheme by the Government of India for meritorious students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-Notified Tribes (DNT) studying in top designated schools and higher educational institutions.
description_hi: ओबीसी, ईबीसी एवं डीएनटी वर्ग के होनहार विद्यार्थियों के लिए केंद्र सरकार की प्रतिष्ठित प्री एवं पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति योजना।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Class 9, 10, 11, 12 or top colleges
Students with annual family income up to ₹2.50 Lakh
benefits: Scholarship grant up to ₹75,000 per year for Class 9 and 10 students.
Scholarship grant up to ₹1,25,000 per year for Class 11 and 12 students.
Full tuition fee coverage and living expense stipend for top-class college education.
application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) under Ministry of Social Justice.
Choose PM-YASASVI scheme according to your class (Pre-Matric / Post-Matric / Top Class).
Provide personal details, caste certificate verification number, and academic record.
Upload necessary certificates and submit application.
Institute verifies records online and DBT disbursement is made directly by the Ministry.
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (PM-USP)
name_hi: कॉलेज एवं विश्वविद्यालयी छात्रों हेतु केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति योजना (पीएम-यूएसपी)
description: Department of Higher Education scholarship awarded to meritorious college and university students who have secured above 80th percentile in their respective Class 12 board examinations.
description_hi: 12वीं बोर्ड में 80 परसेंटाइल से अधिक अंक प्राप्त करने वाले मेधावी स्नातक एवं स्नातकोत्तर विद्यार्थियों को वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious Class 12 pass-outs entering regular degree programs
College and university students with family income under ₹4.5 Lakh
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum at graduation level for first three years of college.
₹20,000 per annum at post-graduation level.
Paid directly through DBT into beneficiary bank account without any deductions.
documents: Class 12 Marksheet showing >80th percentile in State / CBSE / ICSE board
Income Certificate issued by Competent Government Authority
College Admission Letter and Fee Receipt
application_steps: Log in to National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Apply under 'Department of Higher Education' -> 'Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship'.
Enter Class 12 roll number, board name, and college roll number.
Upload income certificate and submit application.
Institution and State Nodal Officer verify credentials online.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to arrest school dropouts at Class 8 and encourage meritorious students from economically weaker sections to continue secondary and higher secondary education.
description_hi: कक्षा 8 के बाद पढ़ाई छोड़ने वाले छात्रों को रोकने हेतु मेधावी छात्र-छात्राओं को कक्षा 9 से 12 तक वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Class 9 to 12 students in government, local body, and government-aided schools
Students clearing the state-level NMMSS selection exam
benefits: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) from Class 9 to Class 12.
Disbursed quarterly directly through Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
documents: Aadhaar Card and School Identity Card
application_steps: Appear for the state-level NMMSS written exam in Class 8.
After qualifying, register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Submit academic and banking details for DBT disbursement.
Renew application annually from Class 9 through Class 12.
department: Department of School Education and Literacy

name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) on Education Loans / Vidya Lakshmi
name_hi: शिक्षा ऋण पर केंद्रीय क्षेत्र ब्याज सब्सिडी (सीएसआईएस) / विद्या लक्ष्मी योजना
description: Government interest subsidy providing full moratorium on interest during course duration plus one year for education loans availed by students from economically weaker sections pursuing approved professional and technical degree courses.
description_hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्ग के छात्रों को उच्च व्यावसायिक एवं तकनीकी शिक्षा हेतु लिए गए बैंक ऋण पर पढ़ाई की अवधि तक शून्य ब्याज सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Students enrolled in technical and professional courses in India
Students with parental family income up to ₹4.50 Lakh per annum
benefits: 100% interest waiver during the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year).
Single-window online education loan application via Vidya Lakshmi portal across 40+ banks.
Collateral-free loan options under Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Education Loans (CGFSEL).
documents: Income Certificate from authorized government revenue official (below ₹4.5 Lakh)
Admission letter to NAAC/NBA accredited university or professional institute
application_steps: Visit Vidya Lakshmi portal (vidyalakshmi.co.in).
Register and fill the Common Education Loan Application Form (CELAF).
Search and select loan schemes from participating scheduled commercial banks.
Select eligibility for Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS).
Upload proof of income and admission, then track bank approval online.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
name_hi: एआईसीटीई प्रगति छात्रवृत्ति योजना (बालिकाओं हेतु तकनीकी शिक्षा छात्रवृत्ति)
description: Scheme implemented by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) providing financial support to meritorious girl students admitted to technical degree or diploma courses in AICTE-approved institutions.
description_hi: एआईसीटीई द्वारा अनुमोदित संस्थानों में बी.टेक, बी.ई., या पॉलिटेक्निक डिप्लोमा में प्रवेश लेने वाली बालिकाओं को वार्षिक ₹50,000 छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Female students entering 1st year of technical degree or diploma courses
Up to 2 girls per family with annual income under ₹8 Lakh
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study (up to 4 years for degree, 3 years for diploma).
Can be utilized for college fee payment, computer purchase, books, and stationeries.
documents: Admission letter from centralized counseling admission process (CAP)
Family income certificate (below ₹8 Lakh per annum)
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Account Details
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Apply under 'AICTE' -> 'Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students'.
Submit academic admission and family details.
Institution verifies application online and scholarship is disbursed directly via DBT.
source_name: All India Council for Technical Education

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
name_hi: एआईसीटीई सक्षम छात्रवृत्ति योजना (दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों हेतु)
description: Scholarship to encourage and support specially-abled students with disability not less than 40% to pursue technical education in degree and diploma courses in AICTE-recognized institutions.
description_hi: 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले छात्र-छात्राओं को इंजीनियरिंग एवं तकनीकी शिक्षा हेतु वार्षिक ₹50,000 वित्तीय प्रोत्साहन।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Differently-abled students with >= 40% disability enrolled in technical courses
Students with family income under ₹8 Lakh
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for tuition fees, books, and assistive software/equipment.
Provided for the entire standard duration of the degree or diploma program.
documents: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card or Disability Certificate (>=40%)
application_steps: Apply online via National Scholarship Portal under AICTE section.
Upload UDID disability certificate and college allotment order.
Verify bank details for direct benefit transfer.
source_name: All India Council for Technical Education
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

name: Uttar Pradesh Pre-Matric Scholarship
description: State government scholarship for students enrolled in Class 9 and 10 in recognized schools in Uttar Pradesh belonging to SC, ST, OBC, General, and Minority communities.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के माध्यमिक विद्यालयों में कक्षा 9 व 10 में अध्ययनरत विद्यार्थियों हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति सहायता।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Class 9 and 10 school students in Uttar Pradesh
Families with income up to ₹2,00,000 per annum
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 credited to student's bank account.
Covers school stationary, uniform, and exam fees.
application_steps: Register on scholarship.up.gov.in under 'Pre-Matric Fresh' registration.
Enter school name, roll number, and personal details.
Submit application and print verification form for principal's signature.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments directly transferred into bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
description_hi: सभी पात्र भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष की वित्तीय सहायता, तीन समान किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में प्रदान की जाती है।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers
Landholding farmer families across all Indian states
benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹6,000 per financial year.
Paid in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each via DBT.
Direct Aadhaar-linked payment into bank accounts without middlemen.
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner.
Enter Aadhaar number and select Rural or Urban Farmer Registration.
Fill landholding survey number, bank details, and submit.
Complete eKYC via OTP or biometric CSC centre.
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing comprehensive financial risk coverage against natural calamities, pests, droughts, floods, and unseasonal rains at minimal premium rates.
description_hi: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं, कीटों और बेमौसम बारिश से फसल बर्बादी के जोखिम के खिलाफ किसानों को न्यूनतम प्रीमियम पर व्यापक फसल बीमा सुरक्षा।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers
benefits: Lowest premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
Balance premium heavily subsidized by Central and State governments.
Claims paid directly into bank account based on satellite and mobile app crop cutting experiments.
documents: Land possession certificate / RoR / Khasra Khatauni
Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Village Officer
application_steps: Apply online via PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in) or through nearest bank/CSC.
Select state, district, crop season (Kharif/Rabi), and crop name.
Upload land record and pay the nominal farmer share premium.
Receive policy number and download crop insurance certificate.
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Concessional short-term institutional credit facility allowing farmers, dairy farmers, and fishers to obtain timely loans for crop cultivation, seeds, fertilizers, and farm equipment at an effective 4% annual interest rate.
description_hi: किसानों, पशुपालकों एवं मत्स्य पालकों को खेती और उपकरणों हेतु मात्र 4% प्रभावी ब्याज दर पर सुलभ संस्थागत ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Individual and joint borrower farmers, tenant farmers, and oral lessees
Animal husbandry and fisheries entrepreneurs
benefits: Credit limit up to ₹3,00,000 at subvented interest rate of 4% per year on prompt repayment.
Collateral-free credit limit up to ₹1,60,000.
Flexible revolving cash credit with built-in RuPay card for ATM withdrawals.
documents: Land title documents verified by revenue authority
application_steps: Download KCC 1-page application from pmkisan.gov.in or obtain from local bank branch.
Submit along with land ownership copy and Aadhaar.
Bank verifies land records and issues KCC card within 14 working days.
source_name: Ministry of Finance & Ministry of Agriculture

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop)
name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना (प्रति बूंद अधिक फसल)
description: Government subsidy scheme providing financial assistance of up to 55% for small & marginal farmers to install micro-irrigation systems including drip and sprinkler irrigation.
description_hi: खेतों में ड्रिप एवं स्प्रिंकलर सिंचाई प्रणाली स्थापित करने हेतु किसानों को 45% से 55% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All landholding farmers adopting drip or micro-sprinkler irrigation methods
benefits: 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers on micro-irrigation equipment.
45% subsidy for other farmers.
Water saving of up to 40-50% with higher crop productivity.
application_steps: Apply on State Agriculture Department portal or PMKSY portal.
Select empanelled micro-irrigation equipment manufacturer.
Department conducts field verification and releases subsidy directly to manufacturer/farmer.
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Uttar Pradesh Kisan Pension Yojana
description: Social security pension program provided by the Uttar Pradesh government for elderly small and marginal farmers living below poverty line who no longer have active farm earnings.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के वृद्ध एवं आर्थिक रूप से असहाय किसानों हेतु ₹1,000 प्रति माह की सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन।
ministry: Agriculture & Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Elderly farmers domiciled in Uttar Pradesh aged 60 and above
Small and marginal farmers holding less than 2.5 acres of land
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 credited directly into the farmer's bank account.
Quarterly disbursement via DBT.
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar or Voter ID showing 60+ years)
application_steps: Apply via UP Social Welfare portal (sspy-up.gov.in).
Fill rural farmer details, landholding size, and bank info.
Verification conducted by Gram Panchayat and Block Development Officer.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जय)
description: World's largest government-funded health protection scheme providing health coverage of up to Rs. 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalization.
description_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा माध्यमिक और तृतीयक अस्पताल में भर्ती के लिए प्रदान किया जाता है।
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Low-income families
SECC identified households
Vulnerable and deprived citizens
benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.
Covers pre-existing diseases from Day 1.
Valid at all empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
Covers 1,949 medical and surgical procedures including post-hospitalization medicines.
application_steps: Check eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir / CSC.
Authenticate identity using Aadhaar OTP or Biometric scan.
Download and print the Ayushman Golden Card (PVC Card).
Present card at any empaneled hospital for 100% cashless treatment.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
description: Initiative to make available quality generic medicines and surgical products at 50% to 90% cheaper prices compared to branded medicines through dedicated Jan Aushadhi Kendras across India.
description_hi: ब्रांडेड दवाओं की तुलना में 50% से 90% तक कम कीमत पर उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली जेनेरिक दवाएं जनऔषधि केंद्रों से उपलब्ध कराना।
ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
target_beneficiaries: All citizens, especially chronic patients needing affordable lifelong medicines
benefits: Over 1,965 quality generic medicines and 293 surgical equipments at 50-90% discount.
Certified WHO-GMP standard products.
Over 10,000 Kendras operating across India for easy neighborhood access.
application_steps: Locate nearest Kendra via 'Jan Aushadhi Sugam' mobile app or website.
Visit the Kendra with your doctor prescription.
Purchase medicines directly across the counter.
source_name: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: State health insurance scheme by the UP Government providing ₹5 Lakh annual cashless healthcare cover to poor families in Uttar Pradesh not covered under Central Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.
description_hi: आयुष्मान भारत से छूटे उत्तर प्रदेश के निर्धन एवं अन्त्योदय कार्डधारक परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा कवर।
ministry: Medical Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Antyodaya ration card holders and registered construction workers in UP
Economically deprived families not listed in SECC 2011
benefits: ₹5,00,000 cashless medical treatment per family per year.
Covers major diseases, surgeries, and critical hospitalizations across all empaneled hospitals.
documents: UP Ration Card (Antyodaya or Eligible Household)
application_steps: Visit any Government Community Health Centre (CHC) or District Hospital in UP.
Present Ration card and Aadhaar at Ayushman Mitra desk.
Generate State Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya card instantly.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Direct financial assistance of up to Rs. 1,20,000 (plains) to Rs. 1,30,000 (hilly/difficult areas) for the construction of a pucca house with basic amenities for homeless and kutcha-house rural families.
description_hi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले परिवारों को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.20 लाख से ₹1.30 लाख की सीधी वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Rural households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses or homeless
Low-income rural families identified in Awaas+ survey
benefits: Direct grant of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/northeastern states.
Additional 90-95 days of unskilled wage employment under MGNREGA (~₹20,000+).
Additional ₹12,000 assistance for construction of household latrine under Swachh Bharat.
Free LPG connection under PM Ujjwala Yojana and electricity connection under Saubhagya.
documents: Existing Kutcha House photograph with geotag
application_steps: Contact your Gram Panchayat Secretary or Block Development Office.
Ensure inclusion in the Awaas+ survey database.
Geo-tagging of current house is performed by Gram Rozgar Sahayak.
Grant disbursed in 3 stages linked to construction progress (plinth, roof, completion).

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U)
description: Financial assistance and interest subsidy up to ₹2.5 Lakh for eligible Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Low Income Group (LIG) urban families to construct or buy their first pucca house in cities.
description_hi: शहरी क्षेत्रों में अपना पक्का मकान बनाने अथवा खरीदने हेतु आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर एवं निम्न आय वर्ग के परिवारों को ₹2.5 लाख तक अनुदान व ब्याज सब्सिडी।
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Urban families living in slum or rental accommodations with no pucca house anywhere in India
EWS (income < ₹3 Lakh) and LIG (income ₹3-6 Lakh) households
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).
Direct subsidy of up to ₹2,50,000 for Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC).
Houses mandatorily registered in female head of family name.
documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Proof of not owning any pucca house in India (Affidavit)
application_steps: Apply online at pmayuclap.gov.in or through Urban Local Body (Nagar Nigam/Palika).
Enter Aadhaar and fill family income details.
Local municipal authority conducts physical verification and approves funding.
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free institutional loans up to Rs. 20 Lakh for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises across Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000-₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5-₹20 Lakh) categories.
description_hi: गैर-कॉर्पोरेट, गैर-कृषि लघु एवं सूक्ष्म उद्यमों के लिए ₹20 लाख तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त (बिना गारंटी) संस्थागत ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Micro-entrepreneurs, shopkeepers, traders, artisanal businesses, food vendors
New and expanding small business enterprises
benefits: Zero collateral or third-party guarantee required.
MUDRA RuPay Debit Card provided for hassle-free working capital withdrawals.
Repayment tenures up to 5 to 7 years at competitive commercial bank interest rates.
documents: Business registration / Udyam Certificate (for existing units)
Project proposal / quotation for machines or inventory
application_steps: Visit the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or any scheduled bank/NBFC.
Select MUDRA category (Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun).
Upload project quotation and business details.
Loan is processed and sanctioned directly by the chosen bank.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
name_hi: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (पीएम स्वनिधि)
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) to urban street vendors, with 7% interest subsidy.
description_hi: शहरी रेहड़ी-पटरी विक्रेताओं को ₹10,000, ₹20,000 और ₹50,000 तक का सस्ता कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण एवं 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी।
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Urban street vendors, hawkers, thela-walas, and roadside service providers
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000.
7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account on prompt repayment.
Monthly cashback reward up to ₹100 for conducting digital sales and UPI payments.
documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_steps: Apply via pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in portal or through your local municipal town vending committee.
Authenticate with Aadhaar OTP.
Select lending institution and submit application for instant sanction.
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Department of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank financing between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield manufacturing, services, or trading enterprise.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति और महिला उद्यमियों को नया उद्यम स्थापित करने हेतु ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का बैंक ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST entrepreneurs or women entrepreneurs entering business
benefits: Composite loan between ₹10 Lakh and ₹100 Lakh covering up to 85% of project cost.
Handholding support via SIDBI for DPR preparation and training.
Repayable in 7 years with a moratorium period of up to 18 months.
documents: Caste Certificate (for SC/ST) or Identity Proof (for Women)
application_steps: Register on standupmitra.in portal.
Select category and connect with nearby scheduled commercial bank branch.
Participate in DPR evaluation and receive sanction.

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री युवा स्वरोजगार योजना
description: UP state scheme providing loans up to ₹25 Lakh for industrial units and ₹10 Lakh for service units, with a 25% government margin money capital subsidy for educated unemployed youth in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को उद्योग हेतु ₹25 लाख एवं सेवा क्षेत्र हेतु ₹10 लाख तक ऋण व 25% सब्सिडी सहायता।
ministry: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Educated unemployed residents of Uttar Pradesh aged 18 to 40 years
Youth with minimum High School (10th pass) educational qualification
benefits: Bank loan up to ₹25,00,000 for manufacturing and ₹10,00,000 for service enterprises.
25% margin money subsidy (up to ₹6.25 Lakh for industry and ₹2.5 Lakh for service) provided by the UP Government.
Subsidy converted to outright grant if unit operates successfully for 2 years.
documents: High School Marksheet / Certificate (proving 10th pass and age)
application_steps: Apply online via UP DIUP portal (diupmsme.upsdc.gov.in).
Select 'Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana' and fill project details.
Application screened by District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) chaired by District Magistrate.
Bank sanctions and disburses loan with margin money subsidy deposit.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
name_hi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (मनरेगा)
description: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work near their village.
description_hi: ग्रामीण परिवारों के वयस्क सदस्यों को प्रत्येक वित्तीय वर्ष में कम से कम 100 दिनों के अकुशल शारीरिक मजदूरी रोजगार की कानूनी गारंटी।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do manual labor
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of paid wage employment per household per year.
Statutory wage rate (₹240 to ₹375+ per day based on State schedule).
Unemployment allowance paid if employment is not provided within 15 days of application.
Works focused on water conservation, soil health, afforestation, and village rural infrastructure.
application_steps: Submit written or verbal application for Job Card to Gram Panchayat.
Gram Panchayat issues Job Card free of charge within 15 days.
Submit application for work whenever needed; get work assigned within 5 km radius.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector, offering 15% to 35% government capital subsidy.
description_hi: लघु उद्योग एवं सेवा उद्यम स्थापित कर स्वरोजगार के अवसर पैदा करने हेतु 15% से 35% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी युक्त बैंक ऋण योजना।
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed individuals aged 18 and above wanting to start their own enterprise
SHGs, cooperative societies, and registered charitable institutions
benefits: Project loans up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing units and ₹20 Lakh for service units.
Government subsidy of 25% (urban) to 35% (rural) for special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Ex-Servicemen).
Beneficiary own contribution only 5% to 10% of total project cost.
documents: Education Marksheet (8th pass minimum for projects > ₹10L in manufacturing)
application_steps: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in (PMEGP e-portal).
Upload project report and applicant details.
District Level Task Force evaluates proposal and forwards to chosen bank.
Complete mandatory Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training.

name: Uttar Pradesh Rozgar Sangam (Sewayojan) & Berojgari Bhatta
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश रोजगार संगम (सेवायोजन पोर्टल) एवं रोजगार मेला
description: Single-window online employment exchange connecting job seekers with government departments, public sector units, and private sector employers with regular district Rozgar Melas and youth allowances.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के शिक्षित बेरोजगारों को निजी व सरकारी क्षेत्रों में नौकरियों के अवसर, रोजगार मेला और आजीविका मार्गदर्शन।
ministry: Labour and Employment Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth residing in Uttar Pradesh seeking career opportunities
benefits: Direct online application to thousands of verified private and contractual public job vacancies.
Free participation in monthly district-level mega Rozgar Melas.
Free skill assessment and interview coaching sessions.
application_steps: Register on sewayojan.up.nic.in portal.
Create profile, upload certificates, and fill skills and qualifications.
Browse active vacancies and apply directly with 1 click.

name: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS)
description: Government scheme providing 12-month paid internships in India's top 500 companies for youth aged 21-24 with monthly stipend of Rs. 5,000 plus a one-time grant of Rs. 6,000 for incidental expenses.
description_hi: देश की शीर्ष 500 कंपनियों में 21 से 24 वर्ष के युवाओं को 12 माह की सवेतन व्यावहारिक इंटर्नशिप, ₹5,000 प्रति माह वजीफा और ₹6,000 एकमुश्त सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Corporate Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Youth aged 21 to 24 who have completed Class 10, 12, ITI, Polytechnic, or Graduation
Candidates not in full-time employment or full-time education
Family income under ₹8 Lakh per annum
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹5,000 (₹4,500 from Central Govt + ₹500 from company CSR) for 12 months.
One-time incidental grant of ₹6,000 upon joining the internship.
Insurance coverage under PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima and PM Suraksha Bima paid by the Government.
Hands-on corporate exposure with certificate of completion from top industry leaders.
application_steps: Visit the official PMIS portal (pminternship.mca.gov.in).
Register using Aadhaar and complete profile verification.
Browse internships posted by top 500 companies by sector, state, and district.
Select and apply for up to 5 internship opportunities.
Shortlisted candidates are contacted directly by host companies for onboarding.

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0)
description: One-year apprenticeship training program for technically qualified youth (graduates, diploma holders, and general vocational degree students) providing industry stipends subsidized by the Central Government.
description_hi: डिप्लोमा एवं डिग्री धारक युवाओं को उद्योगों में 1 वर्ष का व्यावहारिक प्रशिक्षण एवं सरकारी सहायता प्राप्त मासिक वजीफा।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Fresh engineering, general streams, and diploma graduates passing within last 3-5 years
benefits: Monthly stipend up to ₹9,000 per month for Graduate apprentices and ₹8,000 for Diploma apprentices.
Direct 50% government DBT subsidy of stipend directly into student bank account.
National Certificate of Proficiency issued upon completion recognized worldwide.
application_steps: Register on NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in).
Complete student enrollment and verify email/mobile.
Search establishments and apply for active apprenticeship vacancies.
source_name: Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) / Ministry of Education

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Skill certification scheme offering free industry-aligned technical and vocational training, assessment, and government certification across futuristic job roles including AI, robotics, drones, and green energy.
description_hi: उद्योगों की मांग के अनुसार युवाओं को तकनीकी और व्यावसायिक कौशल का निःशुल्क प्रशिक्षण, मूल्यांकन और सरकारी प्रमाणन प्रदान करने की प्रमुख योजना।
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
target_beneficiaries: School and college dropouts or unemployed youth seeking skill certification
benefits: 100% free training courses aligned with National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF).
Monetary reward/stipend of ₹8,000 on successful certification.
Free accidental insurance coverage of ₹2 Lakh for 3 years under Kaushal Bima.
Placement and apprenticeship assistance through Rozgar Melas.
application_steps: Visit Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in).
Search training centers near your location by course or sector.
Register online with Aadhaar and enroll in the batch of your choice.
source_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
name_hi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्या योजना
description: Placement-linked skill development scheme for rural poor youth aged 15-35, providing completely free residential training, uniforms, food, and guaranteed minimum 70% job placement in organized sectors.
description_hi: ग्रामीण गरीब युवाओं हेतु पूर्णतः निःशुल्क आवासीय कौशल प्रशिक्षण, वर्दी, भोजन एवं संगठित क्षेत्र में कम से कम 70% सुनिश्चित रोजगार।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Rural youth aged 15 to 35 years belonging to poor households (SECC/BPL)
benefits: Free residential vocational training with lodging, boarding, and training kit.
Mandatory placement with minimum wage guarantee in verified companies.
Post-placement support allowance of ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month.
documents: BPL Card / MGNREGA Job Card / SECC verification
application_steps: Apply via Gram Panchayat or directly at ddugky.gov.in.
Attend mobilization camps conducted by Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs).
Select trade and join the residential training academy.

name: Uttar Pradesh Skill Development Mission (UPSDM)
description: Free vocational training initiative by the UP Government training over 1 million youth across IT, healthcare, apparel, electronics, and automotive trades with certified NSDC standards and job placements.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के युवाओं को रोजगारपरक तकनीकी ट्रेड्स में निःशुल्क प्रशिक्षण और प्रतिष्ठित कंपनियों में प्लेसमेंट।
ministry: Vocational Education and Skill Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed and school-dropout youth in Uttar Pradesh aged 14 to 35
benefits: Free training courseware, uniform, and certification.
Training centers situated across all 75 districts of UP.
Placement drives connecting certified candidates with local industries.
application_steps: Register at upsdm.gov.in portal.
Select desired sector, course, and training partner center.
Enroll in upcoming batch upon counseling.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Government-backed small savings scheme for girl children with the highest post-office interest rate (8.2% p.a.), triple tax exemption under Section 80C, and maturity on reaching 21 years.
description_hi: बालिकाओं के उज्ज्वल भविष्य और उच्च शिक्षा हेतु 8.2% उच्चतम ब्याज दर और 80C के तहत पूर्ण कर छूट वाली बचत योजना।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Parents / legal guardians of girl children aged below 10 years (maximum 2 girls per family)
benefits: Attractive guaranteed interest rate (currently 8.2% compounded annually).
Minimum deposit of only ₹250 per year up to maximum ₹1,50,000 per year.
EEE tax benefit (principal, interest, and maturity amount completely tax-free).
Partial withdrawal up to 50% permitted for girl's higher education after age 18.
documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar Card and PAN of parent/guardian
application_steps: Visit any post office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Submit SSY Account Opening Form along with birth certificate.
Deposit initial amount (min ₹250) and receive the SSY Passbook.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Direct Benefit Transfer maternity benefit scheme providing cash incentive of ₹5,000 (1st child) and ₹6,000 (2nd girl child) to pregnant and lactating mothers for wage loss compensation and nutrition.
description_hi: गर्भवती एवं धात्री माताओं को पोषण सुधार एवं प्रसव सहायता हेतु ₹5,000 से ₹6,000 तक की सीधी डीबीटी नकद सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first two living children
benefits: Cash incentive paid in installments directly into mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Encourages timely ante-natal check-ups (ANC) and institutional delivery.
documents: Aadhaar Card of mother and husband
application_steps: Register at local Anganwadi Centre or apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
Submit MCP card details after first ANC checkup.
Installments are credited automatically through DBT upon milestones.
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री कन्या सुमंगला योजना
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme by the UP Government providing a total of ₹25,000 in 6 installments across girl child birth, vaccination, school admissions (Class 1, 6, 9), and higher degree enrollment.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश में बालिकाओं के जन्म से लेकर स्नातक तक 6 चरणों में कुल ₹25,000 की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने वाली योजना।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Girl children domiciled in UP from families with annual income under ₹3 Lakh
benefits: Total ₹25,000 financial support credited at 6 key developmental stages of the girl child.
Guarantees school retention, health immunization, and eliminates female foeticide.
application_steps: Apply online via mksy.up.gov.in portal.
Select relevant phase (birth, vaccine, class 1, 6, 9, or degree).
Block Development Officer / SDM approves and DBT funds are released.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
description: Monthly social security pension for senior citizens aged 60 years and above belonging to BPL households across all Indian states and Union Territories.
description_hi: बीपीएल परिवारों के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों हेतु मासिक सामाजिक सुरक्षा वृद्धावस्था पेंशन।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: BPL senior citizens aged 60 and above with no other steady source of income
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹500 to ₹1,500 credited to beneficiary bank account (combined Central + State contribution).
Lifelong DBT transfer without intermediaries.
application_steps: Apply through NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or local District Social Welfare Office / Gram Panchayat.
Submit verification forms; approved pensions are disbursed monthly via PFMS.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension scheme for citizens aged 18-40, providing guaranteed lifelong pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month starting at age 60 based on voluntary monthly contributions.
description_hi: 18 से 40 वर्ष के नागरिकों के लिए 60 वर्ष की आयु से ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 तक की गारंटीकृत आजीवन मासिक पेंशन योजना।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: All Indian citizens aged 18-40 having a savings bank account (especially unorganized sector workers)
benefits: Government-guaranteed pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month.
PFRDA regulated pension fund with lifelong payout to subscriber, and thereafter to spouse.
Nominee receives complete accumulated corpus upon demise of both subscriber and spouse.
documents: Active Savings Bank Account with auto-debit consent
application_steps: Visit your bank branch or log into net banking.
Fill APY subscriber registration form and choose target pension amount (e.g. ₹5,000/month).
Set auto-debit on your savings bank account.
source_name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)

name: Uttar Pradesh Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
description: State monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month (₹3,000 quarterly) provided by the Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department to elderly citizens aged 60 and above living below poverty line.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के 60 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के निर्धन बुजुर्गों हेतु ₹1,000 प्रति माह की सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन सहायता।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens domiciled in UP aged 60 years or above
Annual family income up to ₹46,080 (rural) or ₹56,460 (urban)
benefits: Pension of ₹1,000 per month credited directly into beneficiary savings bank account.
Disbursed on quarterly basis via DBT.
documents: Age Certificate / Aadhaar Card showing 60+ years
application_steps: Apply online via SSPY portal (sspy-up.gov.in).
Submit personal, residential, and banking details.
Verified by Gram Panchayat Secretary / Lekhpal and approved by District Social Welfare Officer.

name: Divyangjan Swavalamban Scheme (NHFDC)
description: Concessional loans up to Rs. 50 Lakh at low interest rates (5% to 8%) with 100% financial assistance for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) to start self-employment ventures, business units, and pursue professional education.
description_hi: दिव्यांग व्यक्तियों (PwD) को स्वरोजगार, व्यवसाय और व्यावसायिक शिक्षा हेतु 5% से 8% की रियायती ब्याज दर पर ₹50 लाख तक का ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: Indian citizens with 40% or more disability certified under Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act
benefits: Concessional interest rate between 5% and 8% per annum (rebate of 1% for women with disabilities).
Loans up to ₹50,00,000 for manufacturing and services enterprises.
Repayment period up to 10 years with flexible moratorium.
documents: Disability Certificate (minimum 40% disability) or UDID Card
application_steps: Apply via State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs), RRBs, or nationalized banks implementing NHFDC schemes.
Download forms at nhfdc.nic.in.
Submit project proposal for loan sanction and disbursal.
source_name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation

name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
name_hi: एडीआईपी योजना (दिव्यांगजनों हेतु सहायक उपकरण वितरण योजना)
description: Government scheme providing free or heavily subsidized contemporary and scientifically manufactured assistive aids and appliances (wheelchairs, motorized tricycles, hearing aids, braille kits, prosthetics) to PwDs.
description_hi: दिव्यांगजनों को आधुनिक सहायक उपकरण (मोटराइज्ड ट्राइसाइकिल, व्हीलचेयर, श्रवण यंत्र, कृत्रिम अंग आदि) निःशुल्क या भारी सब्सिडी पर उपलब्ध कराना।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more disability holding valid certificate
Monthly income under ₹20,000 (100% free aid) or ₹20,000-₹30,000 (50% subsidy)
benefits: 100% free aids including motorized tricycles, smart canes, hearing aids, wheelchairs, and artificial limbs.
Aids delivered via regular district-level assessment and distribution camps organized by ALIMCO.
documents: Income Certificate (monthly income < ₹20,000 for full grant)
application_steps: Register at adip.disabilityaffairs.gov.in or attend ALIMCO camp in your district.
Undergo medical assessment by specialists.
Receive customized assistive device at distribution ceremony.
source_name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities

name: Uttar Pradesh Divyangjan Pension Yojana
description: Monthly disability pension of ₹1,000 per month provided by the Uttar Pradesh Government to differently-abled persons with 40% or more disability living in UP with low family income.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले निर्धन नागरिकों हेतु ₹1,000 प्रति माह की नियमित पेंशन सहायता।
ministry: Divyangjan Empowerment Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Differently-abled citizens domiciled in UP with >=40% disability
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 (credited quarterly at ₹3,000 via DBT).
Priority coverage under state housing and welfare schemes.
documents: Disability Certificate issued by Chief Medical Officer (CMO) or UDID Card
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account details
application_steps: Apply online via SSPY portal (sspy-up.gov.in) under 'Divyang Pension'.
Upload CMO disability certificate and income proof.
Approved by District Divyangjan Empowerment Officer and disbursed to bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National mission for universal financial inclusion providing zero-balance basic savings bank deposit (BSBD) accounts, free RuPay debit card with ₹2 Lakh in-built accidental insurance, and overdraft up to ₹10,000.
description_hi: प्रत्येक असंबद्ध परिवार को शून्य शेष बचत बैंक खाता, ₹2 लाख का निःशुल्क दुर्घटना बीमा और ₹10,000 तक की ओवरड्राफ्ट सुविधा।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Any Indian citizen aged 10 and above who does not hold a bank account
benefits: Zero minimum balance required (no penalty for non-maintenance).
Free RuPay Debit Card with built-in ₹2,00,000 accidental insurance cover.
Overdraft (OD) facility up to ₹10,000 for eligible account holders.
Gateway for all Central and State government DBT benefit transfers.
application_steps: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra / Customer Service Point (CSP).
Fill the PMJDY account opening form and submit Aadhaar.
Account opened and RuPay debit card handed over immediately.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Government accidental death and disability insurance providing ₹2 Lakh accidental death/permanent total disability cover at an ultra-low premium of only ₹20 per year.
description_hi: मात्र ₹20 प्रति वर्ष के अत्यंत कम प्रीमियम पर ₹2 लाख का आकस्मिक मृत्यु एवं पूर्ण स्थायी विकलांगता बीमा कवर।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: All bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years
benefits: ₹2,00,000 compensation on accidental death or permanent total disability.
₹1,00,000 compensation on permanent partial disability.
Nominal premium of just ₹20 auto-debited once a year in May.
application_steps: Submit enrollment form to your bank or activate via mobile/internet banking.
Annual premium is debited automatically every year.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: One-year renewable term life insurance offering ₹2 Lakh life cover to citizens aged 18-50 for death due to any cause at an affordable annual premium of ₹436.
description_hi: किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु होने पर परिवार को ₹2 लाख का जीवन बीमा कवर, मात्र ₹436 वार्षिक प्रीमियम पर।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years
benefits: ₹2,00,000 pure term life risk cover payable to nominee upon death of the insured from any cause.
Renews automatically annually via bank auto-debit.
application_steps: Enroll at your bank branch or through mobile banking app.
Fill nominee details and authorize annual debit of ₹436.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers (street vendors, agricultural workers, construction workers, domestic helpers) ensuring guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60.
description_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के श्रमिकों (मजदूर, घरेलू कामगार, रेहड़ी पटरी वाले) हेतु 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद ₹3,000 प्रति माह की सुनिश्चित पेंशन।
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
target_beneficiaries: Unorganized workers aged 18-40 with monthly income <= ₹15,000 not covered by EPFO/ESIC/NPS
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹3,000 per month on attaining age 60.
50% matching monthly contribution deposited by the Central Government.
50% family pension payable to spouse upon death of the pensioner.
documents: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account Passbook
application_steps: Visit any Common Service Centre (CSC) or register via maandhan.in.
Enter Aadhaar and bank details for eKYC.
Pay 1st monthly installment in cash at CSC; receive PM-SYM Card instantly.

name: Uttar Pradesh Shramik Kalyan & Sant Ravidas Shiksha Sahayata
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश श्रमिक कल्याण एवं संत रविदास शिक्षा सहायता योजना
description: Comprehensive welfare scheme by the UP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UP BOCW) providing monthly stipends up to ₹5,000 and free bicycle for children of registered construction workers pursuing education.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के पंजीकृत निर्माण श्रमिकों के बच्चों को कक्षा 1 से उच्च शिक्षा तक छात्रवृत्ति एवं निःशुल्क साइकिल सहायता।
ministry: Labour Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Registered construction and building workers in Uttar Pradesh and their children
benefits: Monthly educational stipend ranging from ₹500 to ₹5,000 per month based on class level.
Free bicycle distributed to students in Class 9 and above.
Marriage assistance up to ₹55,000 for daughters of registered workers.
documents: UP BOCW Labour Registration Card (Labour Card)
Aadhaar Card of worker and student
application_steps: Apply online at upbocw.in portal under 'Sant Ravidas Shiksha Sahayata'.
Enter Labour Card registration number and student details.
Assistant Labour Commissioner approves and scholarship funds are credited via DBT.
source_name: UP BOCW / Government of Uttar Pradesh

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
name_hi: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों हेतु केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति योजना (PM-USP)
description: Scholarship awarded by the Ministry of Education to meritorious students from low-income families who scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12 board examinations to pursue higher degree courses.
description_hi: कक्षा 12वीं में 80वीं पर्सेंटाइल से अधिक अंक प्राप्त करने वाले कम आय वर्ग के मेधावी छात्र-छात्राओं को उच्च शिक्षा (स्नातक/स्नातकोत्तर) हेतु छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious 12th pass students pursuing regular degree courses in recognized universities and colleges
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three years of undergraduate study
₹20,000 per annum at postgraduate degree level
application_steps: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal
Select Central Sector Scheme under Department of Higher Education
Provide Class 12 roll number and board verification
Submit for institute and state level verification

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
description: Scheme aimed at providing technical education advancement and empowering young women admitted to AICTE approved technical degree and diploma programs.
description_hi: एआईसीटीई द्वारा अनुमोदित तकनीकी डिग्री एवं डिप्लोमा पाठ्यक्रमों में प्रवेश लेने वाली प्रतिभावान बालिकाओं को प्रोत्साहन एवं आर्थिक संबल।
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
target_beneficiaries: Girl students admitted to 1st year or 2nd year (lateral entry) of technical degree/diploma in AICTE approved colleges
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fee, books, equipment, laptops, and software
application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme
Provide enrollment details and upload admission proofs
Institute e-verification

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
name_hi: बेगम हज़रत महल राष्ट्रीय बालिका छात्रवृत्ति (अल्पसंख्यक)
description: Financial scholarship scheme implemented by the Ministry of Minority Affairs for meritorious girl students belonging to notified minority communities studying in Class 9 to 12.
description_hi: मुस्लिम, ईसाई, सिख, बौद्ध, जैन एवं पारसी अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय की कक्षा 9 से 12वीं में पढ़ने वाली मेधावी छात्राओं हेतु छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Minority girl students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) securing at least 50% marks
benefits: ₹5,000 per annum for Class 9 and 10
₹6,000 per annum for Class 11 and 12
application_steps: Register online on National Scholarship Portal
Fill academic credentials and school UDISE code
Upload documents and submit for school verification

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region
name_hi: ईशान उदय उत्तर-पूर्व क्षेत्र विशेष छात्रवृत्ति योजना
description: Special UGC scholarship administered to provide 10,000 fresh scholarships every year to students domiciled in the North Eastern States admitted to general degree, technical, and professional courses.
description_hi: पूर्वोत्तर राज्यों (असम, अरुणाचल, मणिपुर, मेघालय, मिजोरम, नागालैंड, सिक्किम, त्रिपुरा) के विद्यार्थियों को उच्च शिक्षा हेतु यूजीसी विशेष छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Students with domicile of North Eastern Region who have passed Class 12 and admitted to 1st year of general or professional degree courses
benefits: ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses
₹7,800 per month for technical, medical, and professional degree courses
application_steps: Submit application on National Scholarship Portal
Choose UGC Ishan Uday scheme
Complete institute verification

name: Vidya Lakshmi Portal Educational Loan & Interest Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: विद्या लक्ष्मी पोर्टल शिक्षा ऋण एवं ब्याज अनुदान योजना (CSIS)
description: First of its kind portal developed under the guidance of Department of Higher Education providing single-window access to education loans and Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) during moratorium period.
description_hi: उच्च शिक्षा विभाग द्वारा संचालित एकल खिड़की पोर्टल जिसके माध्यम से बैंकों द्वारा शिक्षा ऋण तथा अध्ययन अवधि हेतु पूर्ण ब्याज सब्सिडी (CSIS) प्रदान की जाती है।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Students enrolled in professional/technical degree courses in recognized institutions seeking collateral-free or subsidized education loans
benefits: 100% interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course period + 1 year) for family income up to ₹4.5 Lakh
Single common application form for loans across 40+ scheduled banks
documents: Income Certificate issued by authorized State authority
application_steps: Register on vidyalakshmi.co.in
Fill Common Educational Loan Application Form (CELAF)
Search loan schemes and apply to up to three banks
Bank reviews and disburses loan with interest subsidy claim

name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
description: Flagship fellowship designed for improving the quality of research in higher educational institutions in science and technology at IITs, IISc, IISERs, and central universities.
description_hi: आईआईटी, आईआईएससी और केंद्रीय विश्वविद्यालयों में विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी के अत्याधुनिक क्षेत्रों में डॉक्टरेट शोध हेतु प्रतिष्ठित प्रधानमंत्री फेलोशिप।
ministry: Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: B.Tech, M.Tech, M.Sc graduates admitted to Ph.D. programs at PMRF granting institutions with exceptional academic standing
benefits: Fellowship of ₹70,000/month for Year 1-2, ₹75,000/month for Year 3, and ₹80,000/month for Year 4-5
Annual research contingency grant of ₹2 Lakhs per year (₹10 Lakhs total)
documents: Ph.D. Admission Letter in PMRF Nodal Institute
application_steps: Get admitted to Ph.D. at participating institute
Apply through internal PMRF nomination portal
National selection committee peer evaluation

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme & Interest Subvention
name_hi: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड (KCC) योजना एवं ब्याज अनुदान
description: Credit facility scheme providing farmers with adequate and timely credit support from the banking system for cultivation, post-harvest expenses, maintenance of farm assets, and allied activities.
description_hi: किसानों को फसलों की खेती, कटाई उपरांत खर्चों, कृषि यंत्रों के रख-रखाव एवं पशुपालन/मत्स्य पालन हेतु रियायती ब्याज दर पर त्वरित संस्थागत ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Individual/joint farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHGs of farmers including animal husbandry and fishery farmers
benefits: Collateral-free credit limit up to ₹1.60 Lakh (up to ₹3 Lakh with simplified security)
Effective interest rate of only 4% per annum upon prompt repayment (7% base minus 3% prompt repayment incentive)
ATM enabled RuPay Kisan Credit Card
application_steps: Submit one-page KCC application form at nearest commercial bank, RRB, or Cooperative Bank
Verification of land titles by bank officer
Card issuance and credit limit sanctioned within 14 days

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Pan-India Central Sector Scheme providing medium to long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
description_hi: कटाई उपरांत फसल प्रबंधन हेतु गोदाम, कोल्ड स्टोरेज, ग्रेडिंग यूनिट और सामुदायिक कृषि परिसंपत्तियों के निर्माण हेतु रियायती ऋण व ब्याज अनुदान।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), Marketing Cooperative Societies, FPOs, SHGs, Farmers, Agri-entrepreneurs, and Startups
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 Crores for a maximum period of 7 years
Credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE scheme for loans up to ₹2 Crores with fee paid by Government
application_steps: Register online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal
Fill project details and choose lending bank branch
Online evaluation by Ministry and sanction by bank
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
description: Flagship scheme for focused and sustainable development of the fisheries sector covering fish production, aquaculture, post-harvest infrastructure, and modern fishing vessels.
description_hi: मत्स्य पालन, जलीय कृषि (एक्वाकल्चर), आधुनिक नौकाओं, बायोफ्लोक यूनिट और कोल्ड चेन अवसंरचना के विकास हेतु 40% से 60% सरकारी वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
target_beneficiaries: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fisheries cooperatives, entrepreneurs, and SC/ST/Women beneficiaries
benefits: Government financial assistance of 40% of project cost for General category and 60% for SC, ST, and Women beneficiaries for fish ponds, biofloc, RAS, and motorboats
Livelihood support during ban period
documents: Land / Water body lease or ownership documents
application_steps: Submit project proposal on pmmsy.dof.gov.in or to District Fisheries Officer
Technical sanction by District Level Committee
Project implementation and milestone-linked subsidy release

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) - Farm Machinery Subsidy
name_hi: कृषि यंत्रीकरण पर उप-मिशन (SMAM) - कृषि यंत्र अनुदान
description: Promotes modern farm mechanization by providing 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of agricultural equipment like tractors, power tillers, rotavators, harvesters, and drones.
description_hi: किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, पॉवर टिलर और कृषि ड्रोन खरीदने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान (सब्सिडी)।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers, women farmers, SC/ST farmers, and Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs)
benefits: 40% to 50% direct subsidy on purchase of approved farm machinery from empanelled manufacturers
Up to 80% subsidy for establishing Village Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs)
documents: Caste Certificate (for SC/ST higher subsidy quota)
application_steps: Register on agrimachinery.nic.in portal or State DBT Agriculture portal
Select required machinery and authorized dealer
Generate token/permit, purchase machinery, and claim subsidy post-inspection
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Soil Health Card (SHC) Scheme
description: Provides all farmers with comprehensive nutrient status report cards for their agricultural holdings along with customized recommendations on dosage of fertilizers and soil amendments.
description_hi: किसानों को उनके खेतों की मिट्टी की गुणवत्ता, 12 पोषक तत्वों की स्थिति और संतुलित उर्वरक उपयोग हेतु निःशुल्क मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All farmers having cultivable land across all States and UTs
benefits: Free soil testing covering 12 physical and chemical parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC)
Expert crop-specific fertilizer and micronutrient advisory reducing cultivation costs by 15-20%
application_steps: Local Agriculture Officer or Soil Testing Mobile Van collects soil samples from farm
Testing conducted at district soil testing lab
Soil Health Card delivered online or via Gram Panchayat
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) - Shishu
description: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹50,000 for small businesses, street vendors, shopkeepers, service enterprises, and artisans starting new ventures.
description_hi: नए छोटे व्यवसायियों, दुकानदारों, सेवा प्रदाताओं एवं कारीगरों को बिना किसी गारंटी के ₹50,000 तक का संस्थागत सूक्ष्म ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Small business owners, micro-enterprises, artisans, self-employed individuals, retail traders
benefits: Collateral-free institutional micro loan up to ₹50,000
Repayment tenure up to 5 years
Mudra Debit Card for working capital withdrawals
documents: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN Card
Proof of business address / trade license
Quotation for machinery or items to be purchased
application_steps: Apply online via udyamimitra.in portal or visit any public/private commercial bank, NBFC, or MFI
Submit Shishu loan application form with KYC
Sanction and disbursement within 7 to 10 days

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) - Kishore & Tarun
name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना - किशोर एवं तरुण ऋण
description: Collateral-free enterprise expansion loans covering Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh) and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh) for established micro and small enterprises.
description_hi: स्थापित सूक्ष्म एवं लघु व्यवसायों के विस्तार, मशीनरी क्रय एवं कार्यशील पूंजी हेतु ₹50,000 से लेकर ₹20 लाख तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त (बिना गारंटी) ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Existing micro and small business enterprises, manufacturing units, trading firms, logistics providers, and professional service providers
benefits: Loan from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 under Kishore category; ₹5,00,000 up to ₹20,00,000 under Tarun category
Zero processing fee for loans up to ₹5 Lakh
Guaranteed under Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU)
documents: Past 2 years financial statements and ITR
application_steps: Apply through JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or udyamimitra.in
Choose preferred lender bank branch
Upload business financials and receive in-principle approval

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Comprehensive support scheme providing end-to-end assistance to traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades including skill upgradation, toolkit grants, and collateral-free credit at 5%.
description_hi: पारंपरिक 18 शिल्पों (बढ़ई, लोहार, कुम्हार, मोची, दर्जी, राजमिस्त्री आदि) के कारीगरों को कौशल प्रशिक्षण, ₹15,000 टूलकिट अनुदान और 5% रियायती ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक का ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: Artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in one of the 18 traditional family-based trades
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card
Basic skill training of 5-7 days and Advanced training of 15 days with ₹500/day stipend
₹15,000 grant in e-vouchers for purchasing modern toolkits
Collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹1 Lakh (Tranche 1) and ₹2 Lakhs (Tranche 2) at concessional 5% interest
documents: Ration Card (to verify one member per family)
application_steps: Register at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with biometric authentication on pmvishwakarma.gov.in
Three-step verification: Gram Panchayat / ULB -> District Implementation Committee -> Screening Committee
Download certificate and attend training

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy program aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sectors with government margin money subsidies up to 35%.
description_hi: गैर-कृषि क्षेत्र में नए विनिर्माण एवं सेवा उद्यम स्थापित करने हेतु ₹50 लाख तक का बैंक ऋण तथा 15% से 35% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान (सब्सिडी)।
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: Individuals above 18 years, SHGs, cooperative societies, and charitable trusts setting up new manufacturing or service units
benefits: Maximum project cost eligible is ₹50 Lakhs for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakhs for service sector
Government subsidy (Margin Money) of 15% to 25% for General category and 25% to 35% for Special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Ex-servicemen/NER/Rural)
documents: Educational Marksheet (minimum Class 8 pass for projects > ₹10 Lakhs in manufacturing)
application_steps: Apply online through KVIC portal at kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal
Submit project cost estimates and choose financing bank branch
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) reviews and forwards to bank for sanction

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC, ST and Women Entrepreneurs
name_hi: स्टैंड-अप इंडिया योजना (एससी, एसटी एवं महिला उद्यमी)
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
description_hi: विनिर्माण, सेवा, कृषि-संबद्ध अथवा व्यापार क्षेत्र में नया उद्यम (ग्रीनफील्ड) स्थापित करने हेतु प्रत्येक बैंक शाखा द्वारा एससी, एसटी एवं महिला उद्यमियों को ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का बैंक ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: SC or ST and/or Woman entrepreneurs above 18 years of age setting up greenfield (first-time) enterprises
benefits: Composite bank loan (including term loan and working capital) between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore covering up to 85% of project cost
Credit Guarantee coverage through NCGTC
application_steps: Register on standupmitra.in portal
Apply directly or seek handholding through Lead District Manager (LDM) / SIDBI / NABARD
Bank reviews project and disburses composite loan

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
name_hi: सूक्ष्म एवं लघु उद्यम क्रेडिट गारंटी ट्रस्ट (CGTMSE)
description: Enables collateral-free credit for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) by providing third-party credit guarantee cover to member lending institutions up to ₹5 Crores.
description_hi: सूक्ष्म एवं लघु उद्यमियों को बिना किसी तृतीय-पक्ष गारंटी अथवा अचल संपत्ति गिरवी रखे बैंकों से ₹5 करोड़ तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त ऋण दिलाने हेतु क्रेडिट गारंटी।
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises engaged in manufacturing or service activities
benefits: Collateral-free bank loans up to ₹500 Lakhs (₹5 Crores)
Guarantee coverage of up to 85% for micro-enterprises up to ₹5 Lakh, women-owned units, and units in NER
Substantially reduced guarantee fees
documents: Audited Financials / IT Returns for past 2 years
application_steps: Approach any Scheduled Commercial Bank, NBFC, or Regional Rural Bank with project proposal
Request loan sanction under CGTMSE guarantee scheme
Lending institution applies to CGTMSE trust online upon sanction

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
description: Provides financial assistance to DPIIT-recognized early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization through selected incubators.
description_hi: डीपीआईआईटी से मान्यता प्राप्त नवोन्मेषी शुरुआती स्टार्टअप्स को प्रोटोटाइप विकास, उत्पाद परीक्षण और बाजार में प्रवेश हेतु ₹50 लाख तक का सीड फंड।
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
target_beneficiaries: DPIIT-recognized early-stage technology and innovative startups incorporated not more than 2 years ago
benefits: Grants up to ₹20 Lakhs for validation of Proof of Concept, prototype development, or product trials
Debt / convertible debentures up to ₹50 Lakhs for market entry, commercialization, and scaling
application_steps: Log in to startupindia.gov.in portal with DPIIT credentials
Apply for Startup India Seed Fund and choose up to 3 sector-relevant incubators
Present to Incubator Seed Management Committee (ISMC)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
description: Skill certification initiative offering industry-aligned vocational training in future-skills (AI, robotics, IoT, drones, green energy) with free training, assessment, and placement support.
description_hi: युवाओं को उद्योग-अनुकूल आधुनिक तकनीकों (एआई, ड्रोन, रोबोटिक्स, 3डी प्रिंटिंग) में निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण, राष्ट्रीय प्रमाणन एवं रोजगार सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
target_beneficiaries: Indian youth aged 15-45 who are school/college dropouts or looking to acquire industry-ready technical skills
benefits: 100% free government sponsored training at accredited Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKK)
Government skill certification recognized across India and internationally
Placement assistance and post-placement stipend support
application_steps: Register on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in)
Search job roles and select nearby training centre
Complete classroom and on-the-job training and appear for certification assessment
source_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
description: Promotes apprenticeship training in industrial establishments by providing financial incentive to employers and direct stipend support to apprentice trainees across designated trades.
description_hi: आईटीआई, डिप्लोमा एवं सामान्य स्नातकों को औद्योगिक प्रतिष्ठानों में ऑन-द-जॉब शिक्षुता (अप्रेंटिसशिप) प्रशिक्षण एवं सरकारी मासिक वजीफा।
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
target_beneficiaries: ITI pass-outs, diploma holders, engineering and general stream graduates seeking industrial apprenticeship
benefits: Monthly stipend during apprenticeship (prescribed based on qualification)
25% of stipend up to ₹1,500 per month paid directly by Government of India via DBT to candidate
National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued post assessment
application_steps: Register on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal
Complete profile and search apprenticeship vacancies posted by registered companies
Accept contract and begin training

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Demand-driven placement-linked skill training initiative for rural poor youth aged 15-35 years that guarantees placement of at least 70% trained candidates in formal jobs.
description_hi: ग्रामीण गरीब युवाओं को आधुनिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण तथा कम से कम 70% प्रशिक्षित उम्मीदवारों को निजी क्षेत्र में नियमित रोजगार की गारंटी।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Rural youth aged 15-35 belonging to poor rural households (BPL/SECC)
benefits: Free residential/non-residential training with free boarding, lodging, uniform, and books
Guaranteed placement with minimum wages
Post-placement support allowance of ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month for 2 to 6 months
documents: BPL Ration Card / SECC verification / MGNREGA Job Card
application_steps: Register at nearest Gram Panchayat, Kaushalyarth camp, or ddugky.gov.in
Counseling and trade allocation
Complete training and join placed employer

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Senior Citizen Universal Health Cover (70+ Years)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत वरिष्ठ नागरिक 70+ सार्वभौमिक स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा योजना
description: Universal health insurance providing distinct ₹5,00,000 per year free cashless health cover to ALL citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of their income or economic status.
description_hi: 70 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के सभी वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को आय सीमा के बिना प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का पृथक निःशुल्क कैशलेस अस्पताल उपचार।
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All Indian citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of income
benefits: Exclusive additional health cover of ₹5,00,000 per year per senior citizen / senior couple
No waiting period for pre-existing diseases
Cashless treatment at any empaneled hospital across India
documents: Aadhaar Card (date of birth proving age 70+ years)
Active mobile number linked with Aadhaar
application_steps: Download Ayushman App or visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in
Select 'Enroll 70+ Senior Citizen'
Authenticate using Aadhaar OTP or face authentication
Download instant distinct Ayushman Vayoshri Card

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
description: Makes quality generic medicines, surgical devices, and nutraceutical products available to all citizens at 50% to 90% lower prices than branded equivalents through dedicated Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
description_hi: सभी नागरिकों को ब्रांडेड दवाओं की तुलना में 50% से 90% कम कीमत पर उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली जेनेरिक दवाएं और सर्जिकल उत्पाद उपलब्ध कराना।
ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
department: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)
target_beneficiaries: All citizens seeking affordable high-quality medicines; also provides self-employment to pharmacists
benefits: Access to 2,000+ generic medicines and 300+ surgical items at 50-90% discount
Suvidha sanitary pads at only ₹1 per pad
Empowerment of individual entrepreneurs/pharmacists with ₹5 Lakh incentives to open kendras
documents: Valid doctor prescription (for prescription drugs) to purchase at outlet
For opening Kendra: D.Pharm / B.Pharm license, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card
application_steps: Walk in to any of 10,000+ Jan Aushadhi Kendras with prescription
Locate nearest store via 'Jan Aushadhi Sugam' mobile app

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (Nutrition Support for TB Patients)
name_hi: निक्षय पोषण योजना (टीबी रोगियों हेतु पोषण सहायता)
