description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial nutritional assistance of ₹500 to ₹1,000 per month directly into bank accounts of all notified tuberculosis patients throughout their treatment duration.
description_hi: उपचाररत सभी टीबी रोगियों को उनके पोषण एवं आहार सहायता हेतु ₹500 से ₹1,000 प्रति माह की प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता (डीबीटी)।
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All TB patients diagnosed and registered on the Ni-kshay portal undergoing active treatment
benefits: Monthly financial transfer directly to bank account via DBT for the entire course of TB treatment (typically 6 months or longer for drug-resistant TB)
Free anti-TB medicines and diagnostic testing
documents: Ni-kshay ID generated by hospital / DOTS center
application_steps: Patient is diagnosed and enrolled on nikshay.in portal by health care facility
Bank account details entered by district TB officer
Monthly DBT disbursed automatically

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Flagship rural housing scheme providing financial grant of up to ₹1,30,000 to homeless households and families living in kutcha or dilapidated houses in rural areas to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
description_hi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले पात्र परिवारों को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.20 लाख से ₹1.30 लाख तक का एकमुश्त सीधा वित्तीय अनुदान।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Houseless rural families and families living in zero, one, or two-room kutcha houses identified through Awaas+ / SECC lists
benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/northeastern states disbursed in installments linked to construction stages
Additional 90-95 days of unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA (~₹25,000)
₹12,000 grant for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM-G)
LPG connection under PM Ujjwala Yojana
documents: Gram Panchayat / BPL / Awaas+ Registration ID
application_steps: Beneficiaries identified through Gram Sabha and Geo-tagged via AwaasApp
Sanction order issued by Block Development Officer (BDO)
Installments released electronically directly into beneficiary's bank account upon geo-tagged physical stage verification

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
description: Comprehensive urban housing mission to construct and subsidize 1 crore pucca houses for Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), and Middle Income Group (MIG) families in cities.
description_hi: शहरी क्षेत्रों में ईडब्ल्यूएस, एलआईजी एवं मध्यम आय वर्ग के परिवारों को अपना पक्का मकान बनाने, खरीदने अथवा गृह ऋण पर ₹1.80 लाख तक का ब्याज अनुदान।
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Department of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Urban families from EWS (annual income up to ₹3 Lakh), LIG (up to ₹6 Lakh), and MIG (up to ₹9 Lakh) who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) up to ₹1.80 Lakh
Central financial assistance of ₹1.5 Lakh per house for Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC) and Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)
documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Land Ownership Record (for BLC) or Allotment letter (for AHP)
Affidavit certifying no pucca house ownership
application_steps: Apply online through official portal pmaymis.gov.in or nearest CSC
Select appropriate vertical (BLC, AHP, or Interest Subsidy Scheme)
Physical verification by Urban Local Body / Municipal Corporation and sanction
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY 2.0)
description: Direct benefit transfer maternity benefit scheme providing ₹5,000 for the first child and ₹6,000 for the second child (if girl) to compensate for wage loss and promote institutional nutrition and health check-ups.
description_hi: गर्भवती एवं स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को प्रथम बच्चे पर ₹5,000 तथा दूसरे बच्चे के रूप में बालिका जन्म पर ₹6,000 की नकद वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Pregnant women and lactating mothers who are not in regular government employment
benefits: ₹5,000 in two installments for the first living child upon early registration and institutional delivery
Special incentive of ₹6,000 in single installment if the second child born is a girl
Credited directly into mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank account
application_steps: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in
Enter ANC checkup records from MCP card
Automatic DBT transfer to mother's bank account
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative (DAY-NRLM)
name_hi: लखपति दीदी योजना (दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - एनआरएलएम)
description: National economic empowerment mission to enable 3 crore women Self-Help Group (SHG) members across rural India to earn a sustainable sustainable income of at least ₹1,00,000 per year.
description_hi: ग्रामीण महिला स्वयं सहायता समूह (SHG) की सदस्यों को सूक्ष्म उद्यम, ड्रोन दीदी, पशुपालन एवं कृषि-व्यवसाय हेतु प्रशिक्षण, ऋण और ₹1 लाख वार्षिक आय का संबल।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
department: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
target_beneficiaries: Rural women who are active members of Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM Self-Help Groups
benefits: Collateral-free low-interest bank credit through SHG-Bank linkage
Technical training in high-income livelihoods: Agriculture, poultry, dairy, mushroom farming, Namo Drone Didi, and mini-enterprises
Market linkages through government e-Marketplace (GeM) and SARAS fairs
application_steps: Join or register through local Gram Panchayat Village Organization (VO) / Cluster Level Federation (CLF)
Livelihood business plan formulation with Community Resource Person (CRP)
Community Investment Fund (CIF) loan disbursement and enterprise establishment

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections along with free first cylinder and stove to adult women belonging to poor households to protect maternal and respiratory health from biomass smoke.
description_hi: गरीब परिवारों की वयस्क महिलाओं को निःशुल्क एलपीजी गैस कनेक्शन, पहला भरा हुआ गैस सिलेंडर तथा चूल्हा (हॉटप्लेट) निःशुल्क प्रदान करना।
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
target_beneficiaries: Adult woman belonging to poor household (SC, ST, PMAY beneficiaries, Antyodaya, Most Backward Classes, or verified low income) not owning an existing LPG connection
benefits: Completely deposit-free LPG connection sponsored by Central Government (₹1,600 assistance)
First 14.2 kg LPG cylinder free of cost
Free single burner hotplate (stove)
Targeted ongoing subsidy of ₹300 per 14.2 kg refill directly credited to bank account for up to 12 refills per year
documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant woman and all adult family members
Ration card showing family composition / Self-declaration for migrants
Bank Account Number and IFSC Code
application_steps: Apply online on pmuy.gov.in or submit physical application at nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas)
Document verification and de-duplication check through OMC portal
Installation of connection at beneficiary's household
source_name: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Old age protection pension scheme for unorganized workers like street vendors, agriculture laborers, domestic workers, rickshaw pullers, and construction workers providing guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000.
description_hi: असंगठित कामगारों (मजदूर, घरेलू सहायिका, रेहड़ी पटरी, निर्माण श्रमिक) हेतु ₹3,000 मासिक सुनिश्चित पेंशन योजना जिसमें समान 50% अंशदान केंद्र सरकार करती है।
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
target_beneficiaries: Unorganized workers aged 18-40 years whose monthly income is ₹15,000 or less and not covered under EPFO, ESIC, or NPS
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining the age of 60 years
50% matching contribution paid by Central Government into worker's pension account
Family pension of 50% to spouse in case of subscriber's demise
documents: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC
application_steps: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and bank details
Pay first monthly contribution in cash (ranging from ₹55 to ₹200 depending on age)
Instant generation of PM-SYM Pension Card with unique Pension Account Number

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
description: Non-contributory welfare pension under National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) providing monthly financial assistance to elderly BPL citizens aged 60 years and above.
description_hi: गरीबी रेखा से नीचे जीवनयापन करने वाले 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को सम्मानपूर्वक जीवन हेतु मासिक वृद्धावस्था पेंशन।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above living below the poverty line (BPL)
benefits: Monthly pension credited directly into beneficiary's bank account (combined Central + State contribution typically ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹2,500/month depending on state)
Higher central share for super-seniors aged 80+ years
application_steps: Apply online on nsap.nic.in or submit application to Block Development Officer (BDO) / Municipal Social Welfare Office
Field inquiry and sanction by district welfare officer
Monthly DBT pension disbursement

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY) - Assistive Living Devices for Seniors
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय वयोश्री योजना (वरिष्ठ नागरिकों हेतु सहायक उपकरण)
description: Provides physical aids and assisted-living devices for senior citizens belonging to BPL category or suffering from age-related disabilities such as low vision, hearing impairment, and locomotor issues.
description_hi: बीपीएल एवं निम्न आय वर्ग के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को उम्र संबंधी शारीरिक अक्षमताओं हेतु चश्मे, श्रवण यंत्र, व्हीलचेयर, वॉकर एवं कृत्रिम दांत निःशुल्क उपलब्ध कराना।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above belonging to BPL category or having monthly income not exceeding ₹15,000
benefits: Completely free assisted-living devices: Walking sticks, elbow crutches, walkers, tripods, quadpods, hearing aids, wheelchairs, artificial dentures, and spectacles
Distributed through specialized ALIMCO assessment and distribution camps
documents: Certificate of impairment from government medical officer
application_steps: Register at district assessment camp conducted by ALIMCO / District Administration
Medical screening by specialists
Free distribution of customized devices
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / ALIMCO

name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
name_hi: दिव्यांगजनों हेतु सहायक उपकरण क्रय/फिटिंग सहायता योजना (ADIP)
description: Assists needy disabled persons in procuring durable, sophisticated, and scientifically manufactured modern aids and appliances including motorized tricycles, smart canes, cochlear implants, and braille kits.
description_hi: दिव्यांगजनों को शारीरिक, आर्थिक एवं सामाजिक रूप से सक्षम बनाने हेतु आधुनिक सहायक उपकरण (मोटराइज्ड ट्राइसाइकिल, व्हीलचेयर, कॉकलियर इम्प्लांट, स्मार्ट केन) निःशुल्क प्रदान करना।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability having monthly family income up to ₹20,000 (100% subsidy) and between ₹20,001 to ₹30,000 (50% subsidy)
benefits: 100% free distribution of standard and high-end assistive aids: Motorized tricycles (for adults with ≥80% locomotor disability), smart hearing aids, braille slates, laptops with screen readers, daisy players, and wheelchairs
Up to ₹6,00,000 financial support for Cochlear Implant surgeries for hearing-impaired children up to 5 years
documents: Disability Certificate / Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card (≥40% disability)
application_steps: Attend ALIMCO distribution camps or apply online through DEPwD portal adip.depwd.gov.in
Document verification and clinical assessment
Fitting and issuance of assistive devices

name: Concessional Loans and Self-Employment Scheme for Divyangjan (NHFDC)
name_hi: दिव्यांगजनों हेतु रियायती स्वरोजगार ऋण योजना (NHFDC)
description: Financial assistance program providing concessional loans at interest rates as low as 4% to 8% to persons with disabilities to start their own businesses, agricultural ventures, or pursue professional education.
description_hi: दिव्यांग उद्यमियों को अपनी दुकान, व्यावसायिक उद्यम, कृषि-डेयरी अथवा उच्च शिक्षा हेतु 4% से 8% रियायती ब्याज दर पर ₹50 लाख तक का आसान ऋण।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC)
target_beneficiaries: Persons with benchmark disability of 40% or above aged 18 years or above with viable enterprise plans
benefits: Concessional self-employment loans up to ₹50 Lakhs for business and service sector projects
Interest rate between 4% and 8% per annum (further 1% rebate for women with disabilities)
Education loans up to ₹20 Lakhs in India and ₹40 Lakhs abroad at 4% interest
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate showing ≥40% disability
application_steps: Apply through State Channelizing Agency (SCA) of NHFDC or partner commercial banks / RRBs
Project appraisal and sanction
Loan disbursement with handholding support

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: One-year life insurance scheme renewable from year to year offering ₹2,00,000 life cover for death due to any reason at an affordable premium of only ₹436 per year.
description_hi: मात्र ₹436 वार्षिक प्रीमियम पर किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु होने की दशा में परिवार/नामिती को ₹2,00,000 की सुनिश्चित जीवन बीमा सुरक्षा।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: All individual bank or post office account holders aged 18 to 50 years
benefits: ₹2,00,000 life insurance coverage in case of death of the insured due to any reason
Affordable premium of only ₹436 per year auto-debited in a single installment from subscriber's bank account
application_steps: Log in to net banking or visit home bank branch
Fill simple consent-cum-declaration form for auto-debit of premium
Instant policy generation

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: One-year accidental insurance scheme renewable annually offering ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability and ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability at a nominal premium of ₹20 per year.
description_hi: मात्र ₹20 वार्षिक प्रीमियम पर आकस्मिक मृत्यु अथवा पूर्ण दिव्यांगता पर ₹2 लाख तथा आंशिक दिव्यांगता पर ₹1 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा कवर।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: All individual bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years
benefits: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability (loss of both eyes, hands, or feet)
₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability (loss of one eye, hand, or foot)
Nominal premium of only ₹20 per annum auto-debited from bank account
application_steps: Enable through netbanking / mobile banking app or submit consent form at bank branch
Annual auto-debit activated

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Provides 5 kg of food grains (wheat/rice) completely free of cost every month to over 80 crore poor beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) through fair price ration shops.
description_hi: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम (NFSA) के तहत 80 करोड़ से अधिक निर्धन नागरिकों को प्रतिमाह प्रति व्यक्ति 5 किलो अनाज (चावल/गेहूं) पूर्णतः निःशुल्क।
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution
target_beneficiaries: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration card holders across all States and UTs
benefits: 5 kg free foodgrains per person per month for Priority Households (PHH)
35 kg free foodgrains per family per month for Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families
One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) portability across any Fair Price Shop in India
documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
application_steps: Collect monthly quota at any Fair Price Shop (FPS) through electronic Point of Sale (ePoS) biometric authentication
source_name: Department of Food and Public Distribution

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
name_hi: पीएम सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना (रूफटॉप सोलर)
description: National rooftop solar initiative providing capital subsidy up to ₹78,000 directly to residential households to install solar systems and get up to 300 units of free electricity every month.
description_hi: आवासीय घरों की छतों पर सोलर पैनल लगाने हेतु ₹78,000 तक की सीधी सरकारी सब्सिडी तथा प्रतिमाह 300 यूनिट तक निःशुल्क बिजली।
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
target_beneficiaries: Residential households with an independent roof or suitable terrace with an active domestic electricity connection
benefits: Direct central capital subsidy: ₹30,000 for 1 kW system; ₹60,000 for 2 kW; ₹78,000 for 3 kW and above
Free electricity up to 300 units per month and surplus power sold back to DISCOM via net metering
Collateral-free low-interest bank loans at 7% through national banks
application_steps: Register on national portal pmsuryaghar.gov.in
Choose state DISCOM and consumer account number
Select registered solar vendor, install system, net-metering inspection, and subsidy credit
source_name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

name: PM-KUSUM Scheme (Solar Agriculture Pumps & Solarization)
name_hi: पीएम-कुसुम योजना (सौर कृषि पंप एवं सौरीकरण)
description: Subsidizes installation of standalone solar agriculture pumps (Component B) and solarization of existing grid-connected agricultural pumps (Component C) with up to 60% government subsidy.
description_hi: किसानों को सिंचाई हेतु डीजल एवं पारंपरिक बिजली पंपों के स्थान पर 60% सरकारी अनुदान (सब्सिडी) पर सोलर वाटर पंप उपलब्ध कराना।
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
target_beneficiaries: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, Water User Associations (WUAs), and FPOs with cultivable agricultural land
benefits: Up to 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% State Government) on capital cost of solar pump systems
Farmer pays only 10% upfront; remaining 30% available via low-interest bank loan
Zero recurring electricity or diesel bills for irrigation
documents: Proof of source of water (borewell/open well)
application_steps: Apply online via State Renewable Energy Development Agency (e.g. UPNEDA, MEDA, RREC) portal
Pay 10% farmer share
Vendor installs solar pump with remote monitoring system
source_name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
description: Provides completely free high-quality CBSE middle and higher secondary education (Class 6 to 12) along with free residential boarding, lodging, uniform, and books to Scheduled Tribe children.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) के मेधावी छात्र-छात्राओं को कक्षा 6 से 12वीं तक सीबीएसई माध्यम से निःशुल्क गुणवत्तापूर्ण आवासीय शिक्षा, भोजन, आवास व वस्त्र।
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
department: National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS)
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe (ST) boys and girls residing in tribal-dominated blocks and remote regions
benefits: 100% free residential education from Class 6 to 12 in state-of-the-art CBSE schools
Free boarding, lodging, uniforms, stationery, computer labs, sports training, and medical care
Special coaching for competitive examinations (JEE, NEET, CUET)
documents: Class 5 passing marksheet for admission to Class 6
application_steps: Apply for Eklavya Model Residential School Selection Test (EMRSST) conducted in Class 5
Entrance exam merit list published
Admission counseling and seat allotment

name: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Candidates
name_hi: अनुसूचित जनजाति हेतु राष्ट्रीय विदेशी छात्रवृत्ति
description: Full financial support covering 100% tuition fees, maintenance allowance, travel, and health insurance for meritorious ST students pursuing Master's, Ph.D., and Post-Doctoral studies abroad.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) के मेधावी विद्यार्थियों को विश्व के शीर्ष विश्वविद्यालयों से स्नातकोत्तर (मास्टर्स) एवं डॉक्टरेट (पीएचडी) की पढ़ाई हेतु 100% सरकारी वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: ST students holding confirmed admission offer in top 500 QS/Times Higher Education ranked foreign universities with family income under ₹6 Lakh
benefits: Full tuition fees paid directly to foreign university
Annual maintenance allowance of US $15,400 (or £9,900 in UK)
Economy class return airfare, visa fees, and health insurance allowance
documents: Unconditional Admission Offer from Foreign University
application_steps: Apply online on overseas.tribal.gov.in portal
Selection committee scrutinizes applications based on QS rank of university
Issue of provisional award letter and visa facilitation

name: PM-JANMAN (Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan)
name_hi: पीएम-जनमन (प्रधानमंत्री जनजाति आदिवासी न्याय महा अभियान)
description: Comprehensive mission with budget outlay of ₹24,104 crore aimed at socio-economic development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) through housing, electricity, clean water, road connectivity, and health.
description_hi: विशेष रूप से कमजोर जनजातीय समूहों (PVTG) के सामाजिक-आर्थिक विकास हेतु पक्के मकान, स्वच्छ पेयजल, बिजली, सड़क एवं आजीविका का समग्र महा-अभियान।
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) households across 18 States and Andaman & Nicobar Islands
benefits: PMAY-G pucca house grant of ₹2.39 Lakh per PVTG family
All-weather road connectivity to PVTG habitations under PMGSY
Dedicated Mobile Medical Units (MMUs) and Ayushman cards
Off-grid solar electricity for un-electrified remote households
application_steps: Saturation door-to-door survey by District Administration
Direct enrollment and sanction of multi-sector welfare benefits

name: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP)
description: Holistic support program providing handloom weavers with raw material subsidies (yarn), modern looms and accessories, design innovations, solar lighting, and marketing exhibitions.
description_hi: हथकरघा बुनकरों को धागा (यार्न) पर 15% सरकारी सब्सिडी, आधुनिक करघा एवं उपकरण, सौर प्रकाश व्यवस्था तथा सीधे हाट/मेलों में विपणन सुविधा।
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
department: Office of the Development Commissioner for Handlooms
target_beneficiaries: Handloom weavers, master weavers, handloom cooperatives, and weaver Self Help Groups (SHGs)
benefits: 15% price subsidy on hank yarn (cotton, wool, silk) through Raw Material Supply Scheme (RMSS)
90% to 100% financial assistance for upgrading looms, jacquards, and dobby mechanisms
₹10,000 to ₹25,000 for setting up individual solar lighting units in weaver workstations
documents: Weaver Pehchan Identity Card issued by DC (Handlooms)
application_steps: Apply through local Weavers' Service Centre (WSC) or Weavers Cooperative Society
Inspection and technical recommendation by WSC officials
Subsidy and equipment release

name: SAMARTH Scheme (Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector)
name_hi: समर्थ योजना (वस्त्र क्षेत्र में क्षमता निर्माण योजना)
description: Demand-driven placement-oriented training program providing entry-level and upskilling training in apparel, weaving, spinning, and technical textiles with guaranteed wage employment.
description_hi: वस्त्र, परिधान एवं गारमेंट निर्माण क्षेत्र में युवाओं को आधुनिक सिलाई, बुनाई एवं डिजाइनिंग का निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण तथा कम से कम 70% रोजगार।
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth, women, and traditional artisans seeking wage employment or self-employment in the organized textile industry
benefits: 100% free NSQF-aligned training with modern sewing, embroidery, and textile machinery
Biometric attendance-linked daily allowance for trainees
Guaranteed wage employment for at least 70% of certified trainees in textile mills and garment export houses
documents: Educational Certificate (minimum 8th/10th pass depending on job role)
application_steps: Register on samarth-textiles.gov.in portal
Select accredited training partner center in apparel / textile cluster
Assessment by third-party agency and industrial placement

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (Development and Conservation of Indigenous Breeds)
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय गोकुल मिशन (स्वदेशी नस्ल सुधार एवं डेयरी विकास)
description: Aims to enhance milk production and productivity of bovine population through sex-sorted semen, artificial insemination, and 50% capital subsidy up to ₹4 Crores for breed multiplication farms.
description_hi: स्वदेशी गाय-भैंसों की नस्ल सुधार, सेक्स-सॉर्टेड सीमेन तकनीक, दुग्ध उत्पादन वृद्धि तथा डेयरी फार्म स्थापना हेतु 50% तक सरकारी पूंजीगत अनुदान।
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD)
target_beneficiaries: Dairy farmers, rural youth, private entrepreneurs, FPOs, and cooperatives establishing breed multiplication farms
benefits: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹2 Crores for setting up Breed Multiplication Farms (minimum 200 indigenous cows/buffaloes)
Sex-sorted semen doses made available to small farmers at heavily subsidized rate of only ₹100 per dose (guaranteeing >90% female calves)
Free Artificial Insemination (AI) service at farmer's doorstep
documents: Land Ownership / Lease Documents for dairy farm
application_steps: Submit proposal online on dahd.nic.in or breedmultiplicationfarm portal
State Level Project Screening Committee reviews project
Central Project Approval Committee sanctions subsidy directly to lending bank
source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying

name: National Livestock Mission (NLM) - Entrepreneurship Development
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय पशुधन मिशन (NLM) - उद्यमिता विकास कार्यक्रम
description: Provides 50% capital subsidy up to ₹50 Lakhs directly to individuals, SHGs, and entrepreneurs for establishing commercial poultry, sheep, goat, and pig breeding units and fodder seed production.
description_hi: बकरी पालन, भेड़ पालन, कुक्कुट (मुर्गी) पालन, सुअर पालन एवं चारा उत्पादन इकाइयों की स्थापना हेतु 50% तक सीधा सरकारी अनुदान (अधिकतम ₹50 लाख)।
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
target_beneficiaries: Farmers, individual entrepreneurs, Cooperatives, FPOs, and SHGs setting up commercial livestock breeding farms
benefits: 50% back-ended capital subsidy: Up to ₹50 Lakhs for Sheep & Goat breeding (500 females + 25 males); up to ₹25 Lakhs for Poultry parent farm (1,000 birds); up to ₹30 Lakhs for Pig breeding
Subsidized term loans available from scheduled commercial banks with interest subvention under AHIDF
documents: Training certificate in animal husbandry / poultry
application_steps: Submit project online on nlm.udyamimitra.in portal
State Implementing Agency (SIA) examines DPR
Direct subsidy release into borrower's bank loan account
source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME Scheme)
name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य उद्योग उन्नयन योजना (PMFME)
description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10 Lakhs to individual micro-food processing units (pickles, spices, bakery, flour mills, oil expellers, snacks).
description_hi: सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण इकाइयों (आटा चक्की, तेल मिल, मसाला पिसाई, बेकरी, अचार-मुरब्बा) के आधुनिकीकरण एवं नए प्लांट हेतु 35% तक का सरकारी अनुदान (अधिकतम ₹10 लाख)।
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
target_beneficiaries: Existing micro-food processing entrepreneurs, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Self Help Groups (SHGs), and Producer Cooperatives
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10,00,000 per unit
Seed capital financial assistance of ₹40,000 per SHG member for working capital and minor tools
Support for FSSAI food licensing, packaging design, and quality lab testing
documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with machinery quotations
application_steps: Apply online on pmfme.mofpi.gov.in portal
District Resource Person (DRP) assists in preparing DPR and bank loan application
District Level Committee (DLC) recommends to financing bank for loan sanction and subsidy

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana (Mega Food Parks & Cold Chain)
name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री किसान संपदा योजना (मेगा फूड पार्क एवं कोल्ड चेन)
description: Comprehensive umbrella package providing financial grants up to 50% for creating modern post-harvest agro-processing clusters, integrated cold chains, and preservation infrastructure.
description_hi: कृषि उपज के मूल्य संवर्धन एवं बर्बादी रोकने हेतु मेगा फूड पार्क, एकीकृत कोल्ड चेन और प्रसंस्करण क्लस्टरों के निर्माण हेतु 35% से 50% तक पूंजीगत अनुदान।
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
target_beneficiaries: Agro-entrepreneurs, food processors, FPOs, and cooperative societies establishing commercial cold chains and value addition centers
benefits: Financial grant-in-aid of 35% for general areas and 50% for North-Eastern / Himalayan / ITDP states up to ₹10 Crores for integrated cold chains
Reduces agricultural post-harvest wastage and guarantees fair remuneration to farmers
documents: Land Ownership / Lease Documents for industrial site
application_steps: Submit Expression of Interest (EoI) on mofpi.gov.in portal during open calls
Technical Evaluation Committee and Inter-Ministerial Approval Committee (IMAC) review
Milestone-based grant release directly into bank escrow account

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan (Universal School Education)
description: Overarching program for school education from pre-school to class 12 providing free textbooks, uniforms, digital classrooms, science labs, and transport subsidies in government schools.
description_hi: प्री-स्कूल से 12वीं तक सभी सरकारी विद्यालयों में निःशुल्क पाठ्यपुस्तकें, यूनिफॉर्म, डिजिटल स्मार्ट क्लास और समग्र शैक्षणिक सुविधाएं।
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
target_beneficiaries: Children aged 4 to 18 years enrolled in Government and Government-aided schools across India
benefits: Free textbooks up to Class 8 under RTE Act
Two sets of free school uniforms per child per year up to Class 8
Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) residential schools for girls from disadvantaged groups
Special educator support for Children with Special Needs (CwSN)
documents: School Admission Record / UDISE+ student ID
application_steps: Admission in any government or local body school
Entitlements delivered directly through school on opening day

name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman / Mid-Day Meal)
name_hi: पीएम पोषण शक्ति निर्माण योजना (मध्याह्न भोजन)
description: Provides hot cooked nutritious lunch every school day to over 11.8 crore children enrolled in pre-primary (Balvatika) and classes 1 to 8 in government and aided schools.
description_hi: सरकारी एवं सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालयों के कक्षा 1 से 8वीं तक के सभी विद्यार्थियों को प्रतिदिन निःशुल्क ताजा गर्म एवं पौष्टिक भोजन।
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
target_beneficiaries: All children attending Classes 1 to 8 and Balvatika in government, local body, and government-aided schools
benefits: Hot cooked meal providing minimum 450 calories and 12g protein (Primary) and 700 calories and 20g protein (Upper Primary)
Fortified rice with iron, folic acid, and Vitamin B12 to eliminate childhood anemia
Increases school attendance and nutritional status
documents: School enrollment / Student register entry in government school
application_steps: Automatic entitlement for every student attending classes daily at school

name: Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education for SC Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों हेतु टॉप क्लास शिक्षा योजना
description: Full financial support covering full tuition fees, living expenses, and computer allowances for meritorious SC students admitted into 266 premier institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs).
description_hi: आईआईटी, आईआईएम, एम्स, एनआईटी एवं नेशनल लॉ यूनिवर्सिटी में प्रवेश पाने वाले एससी वर्ग के मेधावी छात्रों की पूर्ण फीस एवं लैपटॉप भत्ता।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: SC students securing admission into notified premier institutes with total family income up to ₹8.00 Lakh/year
benefits: Full non-refundable tuition fees and academic charges directly paid to institute (up to ₹2 Lakh/year in private institutes; unlimited in government)
Living expenses of ₹3,000 per month (₹36,000/year)
One-time computer/laptop allowance of ₹45,000 and ₹5,000/year for books and stationery
application_steps: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
Institute head e-verifies credentials
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC and Landless Agricultural Labourers
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति एवं भूमिहीन कृषि मजदूरों हेतु राष्ट्रीय विदेशी छात्रवृत्ति
description: Centrally funded scholarship covering 100% tuition fees, living allowances, visa, and airfare for SC students, de-notified tribes, and children of landless agricultural workers to pursue Masters/Ph.D. abroad.
description_hi: एससी एवं भूमिहीन खेतिहर परिवारों के मेधावी छात्रों को विदेश के शीर्ष विश्वविद्यालयों से मास्टर्स व पीएचडी की उच्च शिक्षा हेतु पूर्ण वित्तीय छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: SC candidates, traditional artisans, and children of landless agricultural laborers with family income up to ₹8 Lakh having confirmed foreign admission in top 500 QS universities
benefits: 100% actual tuition fees paid directly to foreign university
Annual maintenance allowance of US $15,400 (or £9,900 in UK)
Economy class return international airfare, health insurance, and visa application fee
documents: Unconditional Admission Offer from Foreign University (QS top 500)
application_steps: Apply online on nosmsje.gov.in portal
Screening Committee evaluates QS ranking of host institution
Award letter issued and Indian mission abroad disburses fee directly to university
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति एवं अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग के छात्रों हेतु निःशुल्क कोचिंग योजना
description: Provides high-quality free coaching and monthly stipends of up to ₹6,000 for competitive examinations (UPSC, State PSCs, SSC, Banking, JEE, NEET, GATE, CLAT) for SC and OBC candidates.
description_hi: एससी एवं ओबीसी वर्ग के निर्धन विद्यार्थियों को सिविल सेवा, जेईई, नीट, बैंक एवं क्लैट की तैयारी हेतु प्रतिष्ठित कोचिंग संस्थानों में निःशुल्क कोचिंग एवं मासिक वजीफा।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: SC and OBC students with family income not exceeding ₹8.00 Lakh/year preparing for premier competitive examinations
benefits: 100% coaching course fee paid directly to empanelled premier coaching institutes by Central Government
Monthly stipend of ₹4,000 for local students and ₹6,000 for outstation students throughout the coaching duration (up to 12 months)
Special incentives for Divyangjan
documents: Class 10 and 12 Marksheets and Degree Certificate
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Details
application_steps: Apply online on coaching.dosje.gov.in portal
Merit list prepared based on Class 12 / Degree marks
Allotment to empanelled coaching institute with DBT stipend release
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY - Organic Farming)
name_hi: परंपरागत कृषि विकास योजना (पीकेवीवाई - जैविक खेती)
description: Promotes chemical-free organic farming through cluster approach with financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for cluster formation, organic inputs, certification, and packaging.
description_hi: किसानों को जैविक खाद, वर्मीकम्पोस्ट, बायो-पेस्टीसाइड एवं पीजीएस जैविक प्रमाणीकरण हेतु प्रति हेक्टेयर ₹50,000 की वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Farmers willing to form clusters of 20 or more farmers having 50 acres of contiguous land for certified organic farming
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3-year transition period: ₹31,000/ha for on-farm organic inputs via DBT + ₹8,800/ha for post-harvest value addition and packaging
Free Participatory Guarantee System (PGS-India) organic certification enabling premium crop prices
application_steps: Join village farmer cluster through District Agriculture Officer or Regional Centre of Organic Farming
Register on Jaivik Kheti portal (jaivikkheti.in)
Participatory peer inspection and certification
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: Comprehensive horticulture development mission providing 40% to 50% capital subsidies for establishing fruit orchards, polyhouses, shade nets, mushroom units, and pack-houses.
description_hi: फल, सब्जी, मसाला, मशरूम एवं पुष्प उत्पादन हेतु पॉलीहाउस, शेडनेट, नर्सरी एवं कोल्ड स्टोरेज स्थापना पर 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Horticulture farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, and agribusiness entrepreneurs
benefits: Up to 50% capital subsidy for erecting Polyhouses and Shade Net Houses
Subsidies for establishing high-density apple, mango, citrus, and banana orchards
Financial assistance for mushroom spawn labs, pack-houses, and reefer transport vans
documents: Detailed Project Plan / Quotations from empaneled manufacturers
Bank Sanction Letter (for credit linked projects)
application_steps: Submit project to District Horticulture Officer (DHO) or State Horticulture Mission portal
Technical inspection and work permit issuance
Direct subsidy release upon post-installation verification
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM - Sweet Revolution)
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय मधुमक्खी पालन एवं शहद मिशन (मीठी क्रांति)
description: Provides up to 80% financial subsidy for scientific beekeeping, purchase of bee colonies and beehives, honey testing laboratories, and honey processing units.
description_hi: किसानों एवं ग्रामीण युवाओं को अतिरिक्त आय हेतु मधुमक्खी बक्से, मधुमक्खी कालोनियां एवं शहद प्रसंस्करण इकाइयां स्थापित करने पर 80% तक अनुदान।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Beekeepers, farmers, landless rural youth, SHGs, and beekeeping cooperatives
benefits: Financial assistance up to 80% of cost for 10 to 50 beehive boxes and colonies for small farmers/SHGs
Increases agricultural crop pollination by 20-30%
Substantial ancillary income through sale of raw honey, beeswax, royal jelly, and propolis
documents: Beekeeping Training Certificate from NBB / KVIC / ICAR
application_steps: Register on Madhukranti portal (madhukranti.in) of National Bee Board
Submit subsidy claim through District Horticulture / Khadi Board
Subsidy credited to bank account

name: MSME Champions Scheme - ZED (Zero Defect Zero Effect) Certification
name_hi: एमएसएमई जेड (जीरो डिफेक्ट जीरो इफेक्ट) प्रमाणन योजना
description: Provides financial subsidy of up to 80% on certification cost to MSMEs to adopt sustainable manufacturing, reduce industrial waste, enhance quality, and obtain ZED ratings (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
description_hi: सूक्ष्म, लघु एवं मध्यम उद्योगों को गुणवत्ता सुधार, शून्य खराबी एवं पर्यावरण सुरक्षा प्रमाणन हेतु 80% तक की सरकारी वित्तीय प्रतिपूर्ति।
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: Udyam registered manufacturing Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises in India
benefits: Subsidies on certification costs: 80% for Micro, 60% for Small, and 50% for Medium enterprises (additional 10% for women/SC/ST owned units)
Financial assistance up to ₹5 Lakhs for handholding and consultancy to achieve higher ZED levels
Preferential bank interest rate concessions (up to 0.5% lower) for ZED certified units from public sector banks
documents: Factory layout and manufacturing process flow
application_steps: Register on zed.msme.gov.in with Udyam number
Take free online ZED pledge and complete desktop self-assessment
Desktop / site assessment by accredited assessment agencies (QCI) and certificate award

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
name_hi: पारंपरिक उद्योगों के उत्थान हेतु कोष योजना (स्फूर्ति / SFURTI)
description: Grants financial assistance up to ₹5 Crores to organize traditional artisans and rural craftspeople into modern industrial clusters with common facility centres, advanced tooling, and e-commerce linkages.
description_hi: पारंपरिक कारीगरों (खादी, बांस, मिट्टी, चर्म, कपड़ा) के क्लस्टर विकास हेतु ₹5 करोड़ तक का 100% सरकारी अनुदान, कॉमन फैसिलिटी सेंटर और आधुनिक मशीनरी।
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: Artisans, rural craftspeople, NGOs, institutions, and Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) forming traditional artisan clusters (500+ artisans)
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹2.5 Crores for Regular Clusters (up to 500 artisans) and up to ₹5 Crores for Major Clusters (more than 500 artisans)
Covers 100% cost of hard interventions (land development, common work sheds, automated machinery) and soft interventions (training, market fairs)
Transforms daily wage artisans into co-owners of modern industrial producer companies
documents: SPV Registration documents (Section 8 Company / Producer Co)
Artisan cluster roll with Aadhaar details
Land availability documents for Common Facility Centre
application_steps: Submit project concept on sfurti.msme.gov.in through Nodal Agency (KVIC, Coir Board, IIE)
Scheme Steering Committee (SSC) approval chaired by Secretary MSME
Tranche-wise grant release directly into SPV escrow account

name: National SC-ST Hub (NSSH)
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जाति एवं अनुसूचित जनजाति हब (NSSH)
description: Special institutional initiative to promote enterprise culture and fulfill the mandate of 4% public procurement from SC/ST entrepreneurs by Central Ministries and CPSEs.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति एवं जनजाति के उद्यमियों के व्यवसाय विस्तार, सरकारी खरीद (4% कोटा), रियायती ऋण एवं निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण हेतु समर्पित राष्ट्रीय हब।
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises owned by Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs having Udyam registration
benefits: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) providing 25% capital subsidy up to ₹25 Lakhs for purchasing modern machinery
100% reimbursement of fee for GeM registration, BIS/ISO certifications, barcoding, and testing charges
Reimbursement of participation fee in national and international trade fairs
documents: Udyam Registration Certificate (with SC/ST promoter classification)
application_steps: Register on scsthub.in portal or visit nearest NSIC office
Submit claim under SCLCSS or reimbursement scheme
Inspection by NSIC and direct subsidy credit to bank loan account

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना (IGNWPS)
description: Monthly pension under National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) providing regular financial sustenance to widows aged 40 to 59 years living below the poverty line.
description_hi: गरीबी रेखा से नीचे जीवनयापन करने वाली 40 से 59 वर्ष की निराश्रित विधवा माताओं-बहनों को सम्मानजनक जीवन हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 40-59 years belonging to households living below poverty line (BPL)
benefits: Monthly pension credited directly into beneficiary's bank account (combined Central + State contribution typically ₹1,000 to ₹2,500/month depending on state)
Seamless transition into IGNOAPS old age pension upon attaining 60 years of age
application_steps: Apply online on nsap.nic.in or at local Gram Panchayat / Municipal Welfare Office
Inquiry by Block Development Officer (BDO) and sanction order issued
Monthly DBT pension payment

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांगता पेंशन योजना (IGNDPS)
description: Non-contributory disability pension providing monthly financial support to persons aged 18 to 79 years living below poverty line with severe or multiple disabilities (≥80% disability).
description_hi: 80% या उससे अधिक गंभीर दिव्यांगता वाले 18 से 79 वर्ष के बीपीएल नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु प्रतिमाह सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Persons aged 18-79 living below poverty line with severe or multiple disabilities (minimum 80% benchmark disability)
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month (combined Central and State assistance) credited directly into bank account via DBT
Free assistive devices and priority in state social welfare welfare allocations
documents: Disability Certificate / UDID Card showing ≥80% disability
application_steps: Apply online via nsap.nic.in or at Block Social Welfare Office
Medical officer and administrative verification
Direct bank credit per month

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
description: Provides immediate lump-sum financial grant of ₹20,000 to a bereaved BPL family upon the untimely death of the primary breadwinner aged between 18 and 59 years.
description_hi: बीपीएल परिवार के मुख्य कमाऊ मुखिया (18 से 59 वर्ष) की असामयिक मृत्यु पर शोकाकुल परिवार को तात्कालिक आर्थिक संबल हेतु ₹20,000 की एकमुश्त सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: BPL families where the primary earning breadwinner (male or female) aged 18 to 59 years has passed away
benefits: One-time lump-sum grant of ₹20,000 paid directly into the bank account of the surviving spouse or eldest family member to prevent destitution
No deduction or repayment
documents: Death Certificate of primary breadwinner (mentioning age between 18-59 years)
BPL Ration Card / Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
application_steps: Submit application within 1 year of death at Block Development Office or via state portal (e.g. nfbs.upsdc.gov.in)
Tehsildar verifies family dependency
Sanction by District Social Welfare Officer and payment release via DBT

name: SVAMITVA Scheme (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)
name_hi: स्वामित्व योजना (ग्रामीण आबादी क्षेत्र ड्रोन सर्वेक्षण एवं संपत्ति कार्ड)
description: Reformative scheme using high-resolution drone mapping to provide legal ownership 'Property Cards' (Gharauni / Sampatti Patra) to rural household owners for their inhabited land (Abadi).
description_hi: ग्रामीण आबादी क्षेत्रों में ड्रोन तकनीक से भूमि सर्वेक्षण कर ग्रामीणों को उनकी रिहायशी संपत्ति का मालिकाना कानूनी दस्तावेज (संपत्ति कार्ड / घरौनी) प्रदान करना।
ministry: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
department: Survey of India / Ministry of Panchayati Raj
target_beneficiaries: Rural citizens owning houses in village inhabited (Abadi / Lal Dora) areas across all States and UTs
benefits: Official legal Property Card (Gharauni) validating ownership of residential houses in rural abadi
Enables rural citizens to leverage their property as collateral to take bank home loans and business loans
Reduces village land disputes and enables accurate local tax collection by Gram Panchayats
documents: Identification by Gram Panchayat during ground survey
application_steps: Drone flying conducted over village abadi by Survey of India teams
Ground truth verification by Revenue/Panchayat officials with village elders
Issuance and digital download of SVAMITVA Property Card

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY - Institutional Delivery Incentive)
name_hi: जननी सुरक्षा योजना (जेएसवाई - संस्थागत प्रसव प्रोत्साहन)
description: Safe motherhood intervention under National Health Mission promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women with cash assistance of ₹1,400 in rural areas and ₹1,000 in urban areas.
description_hi: गरीब गर्भवती महिलाओं को सुरक्षित प्रसव एवं मातृ-शिशु मृत्यु दर कम करने हेतु सरकारी अस्पताल में प्रसव कराने पर ₹1,400 (ग्रामीण) एवं ₹1,000 (शहरी) की नकद सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All pregnant women delivering in government or accredited private health facilities in Low Performing States (LPS); BPL/SC/ST pregnant women in High Performing States
benefits: Cash assistance of ₹1,400 (rural) and ₹1,000 (urban) in Low Performing States (UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Assam, J&K, Uttarakhand)
Free transport to and from hospital through 108/102 ambulance
Free post-delivery medicines and diagnostics
documents: BPL Card / Caste Certificate (in HPS states)
application_steps: Register pregnancy at nearest Sub-Centre / Primary Health Centre (PHC) through ASHA worker
Delivery at government hospital or accredited private hospital
Cash incentive disbursed directly via DBT or cheque at time of discharge

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK - Zero Expense Delivery)
name_hi: जननी शिशु सुरक्षा कार्यक्रम (जेएसएसके - पूर्णतः निःशुल्क प्रसव)
description: Entitles all pregnant women delivering in public health institutions to completely free and cashless delivery including caesarean section, free drugs, diagnostics, blood, food, and transport.
description_hi: सरकारी स्वास्थ्य संस्थानों में गर्भवती महिलाओं को सामान्य एवं सिजेरियन प्रसव, दवाएं, जांच, भोजन एवं एम्बुलेंस परिवहन पूर्णतः निःशुल्क उपलब्ध कराना (शून्य खर्च)।
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All pregnant women delivering in public health institutions and sick newborn infants up to 1 year of age
benefits: Completely cashless and free delivery including C-section in all government hospitals
Free medicines, consumables, and blood transfusion
Free diet during hospital stay (up to 3 days for normal, 7 days for caesarean)
Free home-to-facility and facility-to-home transport
application_steps: Report to any government hospital / Community Health Centre (CHC) for delivery
Automatic zero-billing cashless treatment
source_name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
description: Guarantees comprehensive and free antenatal care (ANC) checkup packages by gynecologists/specialists to all pregnant women on the 9th of every month across designated government health facilities.
description_hi: प्रत्येक माह की 9 तारीख को सभी गर्भवती महिलाओं को स्त्री रोग विशेषज्ञों द्वारा निःशुल्क एवं व्यापक प्रसव पूर्व जांच (अल्ट्रासाउंड, हीमोग्लोबिन, शुगर, बीपी) की गारंटी।
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All pregnant women in their 2nd and 3rd trimesters visiting public health facilities on the 9th of every month
benefits: Free comprehensive antenatal clinical examination by medical specialists
Free ultrasound diagnostics, blood and urine tests
Free iron-folic acid and calcium supplements
High-Risk Pregnancy (HRP) identification and red sticker categorization for prioritized care
application_steps: Visit nearest Primary Health Centre (PHC), CHC, or District Hospital on the 9th of any month
Direct consultation and diagnostics
source_name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: National Career Service (NCS Project)
description: One-stop digital platform and physical Model Career Centres connecting job seekers, students, and apprentices with registered employers across government and private sectors with free career counseling.
description_hi: देशभर के शिक्षित युवाओं को सरकारी एवं निजी क्षेत्र में नौकरियों, ऑनलाइन जॉब मेलों, करियर परामर्श एवं निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण से जोड़ने वाला राष्ट्रीय डिजिटल पोर्टल।
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
target_beneficiaries: Job seekers, fresh graduates, ITI passouts, skilled workers, and employers across India
benefits: Free access to over 15 lakh active job vacancies in banking, IT, manufacturing, healthcare, and retail
Free career counseling and aptitude testing at 400+ Model Career Centres
Free access to Microsoft DigiSaksham digital skill courses and TCS iON employability modules
Direct participation in mega job fairs (Rozgar Mela)
application_steps: Register online at ncs.gov.in portal
Build detailed job seeker profile and search vacancies
Apply with one click and attend direct interviews

name: e-Shram Portal (National Database of Unorganized Workers)
name_hi: ई-श्रम कार्ड (असंगठित कामगारों का राष्ट्रीय डेटाबेस)
description: Comprehensive national database providing a 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) e-Shram Card to unorganized workers with ₹2,00,000 accidental insurance and direct linkage to all central and state welfare benefits.
description_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के श्रमिकों (मजदूर, पेंटर, प्लंबर, गिग वर्कर, नाई, धोबी) को ₹2 लाख का निःशुल्क दुर्घटना बीमा एवं सभी सरकारी योजनाओं से सीधा जुड़ाव देने वाला ई-श्रम कार्ड।
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
target_beneficiaries: All unorganized workers aged 16-59 years (construction workers, migrant workers, street vendors, domestic helpers, agricultural workers, gig/platform workers)
benefits: Universal Account Number (UAN) e-Shram card valid across all States and UTs
Accidental death and permanent disability cover of ₹2,00,000 (and ₹1,00,000 for partial disability) under PMSBY
Direct pipeline for emergency disaster relief and cash transfers during crises
application_steps: Self-register online on eshram.gov.in portal or visit nearest CSC / Seva Kendra
Aadhaar OTP verification
Instant download of laminated e-Shram Card

name: PM-DAKSH (Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampanna Hitgrahi)
description: National action plan offering free upskilling, short term training, and entrepreneurship development with ₹1,000 to ₹1,500/month stipends for SC, OBC, EBC, DNT, and sanitation workers.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग, विमुक्त घुमंतू जातियों एवं सफाई कर्मचारियों के युवाओं को आधुनिक तकनीकी व्यवसायों में निःशुल्क प्रशिक्षण एवं मासिक वजीफा।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_beneficiaries: Candidates belonging to SC, OBC (income < ₹3 Lakh), EBC (income < ₹1 Lakh), DNT, and waste pickers / sanitation workers aged 18-45
benefits: 100% free training courses in high-demand trades: Apparel, computer technology, automotive repair, food processing, electronics, and solar PV installation
Monthly stipend of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 per month credited via DBT based on attendance
Placement assistance and post-training startup loans from apex corporations (NSFDC, NBCFDC)
application_steps: Apply online on pmdaksh.dosje.gov.in portal or PM-DAKSH mobile app
Select training institute and trade
Assessment and certification upon completion
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
description: Transformative national infrastructure mission ensuring clean, potable piped tap water supply of 55 liters per person per day to every rural household in India.
description_hi: देश के प्रत्येक ग्रामीण परिवार के घर में नल से शुद्ध एवं पर्याप्त पेयजल (55 लीटर प्रति व्यक्ति प्रतिदिन) की नियमित आपूर्ति।
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
target_beneficiaries: All rural households, schools, anganwadis, and community health centers in villages across India
benefits: Free individual functional household tap connection (FHTC) providing safe drinking water directly inside the home
Eliminates physical drudgery of fetching water for rural women and girls
Regular water quality testing through Field Test Kits (FTKs) managed by village women
application_steps: Village Action Plan formulated by Village Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC) / Pani Samiti
Pipeline laid and tap installed at household doorstep

name: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin (Individual Household Latrine - IHHL)
name_hi: स्वच्छ भारत मिशन - ग्रामीण (व्यक्तिगत घरेलू शौचालय सहायता)
description: Provides financial incentive of ₹12,000 to eligible rural households for constructing individual household twin-pit toilets to maintain Open Defecation Free (ODF Plus) status.
description_hi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में शौचालय विहीन गरीब परिवारों को घर में पक्का शौचालय निर्माण हेतु ₹12,000 की सीधी नकद प्रोत्साहन राशि।
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
target_beneficiaries: Rural households belonging to BPL or identified APL (SC/ST, small/marginal farmers, landless laborers, women-headed households, divyangjan) without an individual toilet
benefits: Cash financial incentive of ₹12,000 credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT upon toilet construction and geo-tagging
Ensures dignity and safety for women and prevents waterborne diseases
application_steps: Apply online on sbm.gov.in portal or submit application to Gram Panchayat
Block sanitation team inspects and geo-tags constructed toilet on mobile app
Incentive credited directly into bank account
source_name: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP - Mission Shakti Sambal)
name_hi: बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ (मिशन शक्ति संबल)
description: National multi-sectoral initiative addressing skewed child sex ratio, preventing female feticide, guaranteeing institutional survival, and promoting girl child secondary and higher education.
description_hi: बालिकाओं के प्रति भेदभाव समाप्त करने, लिंगानुपात में सुधार तथा बालिकाओं की माध्यमिक एवं उच्च शिक्षा व कौशल विकास हेतु राष्ट्रीय अभियान।
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Girl children, adolescent girls, and young women across all districts in India
benefits: Free admission facilitation in secondary and higher secondary schools
Financial linkages with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana at village Anganwadis
District level awards and scholarships for meritorious girl students in sports and academics
application_steps: Participate through District Women and Child Development Office, local Anganwadi, and school programs
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: One Stop Centre Scheme (Sakhi Centres - Mission Shakti)
name_hi: सखी वन स्टॉप सेंटर योजना (मिशन शक्ति)
description: Provides 24x7 integrated emergency support, medical care, legal counseling, police assistance, and psycho-social counseling under one roof to women affected by violence.
description_hi: घरेलू या किसी भी प्रकार की हिंसा से पीड़ित महिलाओं को एक ही छत के नीचे 24 घंटे आपातकालीन आश्रय, चिकित्सा उपचार, कानूनी सहायता एवं पुलिस सुरक्षा।
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Any woman or girl facing physical, sexual, emotional, psychological, or economic abuse, irrespective of age, marital status, or income
benefits: 24x7 immediate emergency medical care and first aid
Police facilitation and lodging of Zero FIR / NCR
Free legal aid through District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)
Short-stay temporary residential shelter up to 5 days with food and toiletries
Professional psychological and trauma counseling
documents: No mandatory documents required for emergency rescue and admission (Aadhaar or ID can be provided later)
application_steps: Walk in to nearest One Stop Centre located near District Hospital or dial Women Helpline 181 / Emergency 112
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Working Women Hostel Scheme (Sakhi Niwas)
description: Provides safe, affordable, and furnished residential hostel accommodation with day-care creche facilities for working women living away from their families in urban and semi-urban centers.
description_hi: अपने परिवार से दूर शहरों में नौकरी अथवा व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण प्राप्त करने वाली महिलाओं को सुरक्षित, सुसज्जित एवं किफायती आवासीय छात्रावास।
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Working women who are single, widowed, divorced, separated, or married with spouse working in a different town, with monthly salary up to ₹50,000 (metros) or ₹35,000 (other cities)
benefits: Safe and highly subsidized hostel accommodation with 24x7 security and CCTV
Attached day-care creche facility for children of resident working women (girls up to 18 years, boys up to 5 years)
Stay permitted for up to 3 years
documents: Employment Letter / Salary Slip / Training Proof
application_steps: Apply directly to hostel superintendent of local Sakhi Niwas / Working Women Hostel
Scrutiny of employment credentials and room allotment
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
description: Small savings program exclusively for women and girls offering an attractive high fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum for a 2-year tenure with partial withdrawal facility.
description_hi: महिलाओं एवं बालिकाओं के नाम पर 2 वर्ष की अवधि हेतु 7.5% की उच्च निश्चित ब्याज दर वाली सुरक्षित सरकारी लघु बचत योजना।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Any woman in her own name or guardian on behalf of a minor girl child
benefits: High sovereign fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum compounded quarterly
Flexible deposit starting from ₹1,000 up to maximum ₹2,00,000 for a tenure of 2 years
Partial withdrawal of up to 40% of the balance allowed after completion of 1 year
application_steps: Visit any Post Office or designated commercial bank branch
Fill Mahila Samman Savings form and deposit amount in cash / cheque
Receive MSSC Passbook

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
description: Premier government retirement savings scheme for individuals aged 60+ offering a high sovereign interest rate of 8.2% per annum paid out as regular quarterly income with tax benefits.
description_hi: 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों हेतु 8.2% ब्याज दर वाली सुरक्षित सरकारी योजना, जिसमें हर तीन महीने पर नियमित ब्याज आय मिलती है।
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Indian citizens aged 60 years or above (or aged 55-60 for individuals retired under VRS/Superannuation)
benefits: High sovereign interest rate of 8.2% per annum with quarterly interest payments credited directly into savings account
Investment ceiling up to ₹30,00,000 per individual (₹60 Lakhs for joint couple account)
Tax deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 Lakh per financial year
documents: Proof of Age (PAN Card / Voter ID / Passport)
application_steps: Open account at any Post Office or public/private commercial bank branch
Deposit amount via cheque / draft
Quarterly interest credited automatically on 1st of April, July, October, January

name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement (SC/ST)
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति (अनुसूचित जाति / जनजाति)
description: State welfare scholarship covering non-refundable fees and living allowances for SC and ST students studying in post-matric and higher educational institutions in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के अनुसूचित जाति एवं अनुसूचित जनजाति के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु कक्षा 11वीं से उच्च शिक्षा तक निःशुल्क शिक्षा एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: SC and ST students domiciled in Uttar Pradesh with family income below ₹2.5 Lakh/year
benefits: Complete fee waiver/reimbursement of institutional tuition charges
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly to student bank account
application_steps: Apply via scholarship.up.gov.in
Online verification via DigiLocker / Aadhaar
Institute submits verified master data to Social Welfare Department

name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement (General Category Poor)
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति (सामान्य वर्ग निर्धन)
description: State financial assistance for meritorious and economically disadvantaged General category students domiciled in UP with annual family income up to ₹2,00,000.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के सामान्य वर्ग के निर्धन छात्र-छात्राओं (वार्षिक पारिवारिक आय ₹2 लाख तक) हेतु शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति सहायता।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Economically poor General category students studying in Class 11, 12, degree, or professional programs in UP
benefits: Reimbursement of tuition fees as per government slabs
Maintenance stipend credited directly to bank account
application_steps: Submit application on scholarship.up.gov.in under General Category link
Institutional verification and district sanction

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme providing ₹25,000 in six milestone stages from birth to graduation to promote girl child education, health, and gender equality in UP.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश में बालिकाओं के जन्म से लेकर स्नातक तक की शिक्षा हेतु 6 चरणों में कुल ₹25,000 की वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Girl children born and domiciled in UP in families with annual income up to ₹3 Lakh (maximum 2 daughters per family)
benefits: Total financial assistance of ₹25,000 disbursed across 6 stages: Birth (₹5,000), Immunization (₹2,000), Class 1 (₹3,000), Class 6 (₹3,000), Class 9 (₹5,000), Degree/Diploma admission (₹7,000)
application_steps: Apply online through mksy.up.gov.in portal
Upload stage-specific documentation
Verification by Block Development Officer / SDM and DBT release

name: Uttar Pradesh Vridhavastha Pension Yojana (Old Age Pension)
description: State pension providing monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 directly to destitute elderly citizens aged 60 years and above domiciled in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वृद्धजनों को प्रतिमाह ₹1,000 (तिमाही ₹3,000) की नियमित पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Elderly citizens of UP aged 60 years or older living below poverty line (rural income ≤ ₹46,080/yr; urban ≤ ₹56,460/yr)
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 (disbursed as ₹3,000 per quarter) directly into bank account via PFMS DBT
Health assistance and social security
application_steps: Apply on sspy-up.gov.in portal
Select 'Old Age Pension' and submit details
Block / Tehsil inquiry and District Social Welfare Officer sanction

name: Uttar Pradesh Divyangjan Pension Yojana
description: Monthly disability pension of ₹1,000 provided by Uttar Pradesh Government to persons with 40% or more benchmark disability living in economically weaker households.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु ₹1,000 प्रतिमाह की पेंशन सहायता।
ministry: Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Persons with ≥40% disability domiciled in UP with annual household income up to ₹60,000
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 credited quarterly directly via DBT into beneficiary's bank account
documents: Disability Certificate issued by CMO (≥40% disability)
application_steps: Submit online application on sspy-up.gov.in under Divyang Pension link
Verification by Gram Panchayat / Lekhpal and District Divyangjan Officer sanction

name: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana (Free Competitive Exam Coaching)
name_hi: मुख्यमंत्री अभ्युदय योजना (निःशुल्क प्रतियोगी परीक्षा कोचिंग)
description: Provides free comprehensive high-quality coaching, study materials, and tablet support for underprivileged youth preparing for UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, NEET, NDA, CDS, and banking exams.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के मेधावी एवं निर्धन युवाओं को सिविल सेवा (UPSC/UPPSC), जेईई, नीट, एनडीए, सीडीएस आदि हेतु निःशुल्क ऑफलाइन व ऑनलाइन कोचिंग।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Students of Uttar Pradesh preparing for competitive exams who cannot afford private coaching fees
benefits: Free physical and virtual classroom coaching by IAS, IPS, and subject matter experts at divisional headquarters
Free e-learning content and mentorship
Free tablet distribution for selected top performers
application_steps: Register on abhyuday.up.gov.in
Select desired examination course and nearest divisional center
Appear in state eligibility screening test to secure seat

name: One District One Product (ODOP) Margin Money Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: एक जनपद एक उत्पाद (ODOP) मार्जिन मनी सब्सिडी योजना
description: Financial assistance scheme by MSME UP providing margin money subsidies of up to 25% (up to ₹20 Lakhs) on bank loans to establish or expand district-specific traditional product units.
description_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश के पारंपरिक जिला उत्पादों (जैसे भदोही कालीन, मुरादाबाद पीतल, अलीगढ़ ताले) के निर्माण एवं व्यवसाय विस्तार हेतु 25% तक मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: MSME and Export Promotion Department, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Artisans, micro-entrepreneurs, and manufacturing units producing products identified under UP's ODOP list
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% for projects up to ₹25 Lakh (max ₹6.25 Lakh); 20% for projects ₹25-50 Lakh; 10% for projects > ₹50 Lakh (max ₹20 Lakh)
Common facility center access and skill training
application_steps: Apply online on diupmsme.upsdc.gov.in portal
Select ODOP Margin Money Scheme
District Level Committee (DLC) evaluation and bank sanction

name: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya (MAA) Yojana (Formerly Chiranjeevi)
description: Universal health insurance scheme of Rajasthan offering cashless hospitalization cover of up to ₹25 Lakhs per family per year across empaneled public and private hospitals.
description_hi: राजस्थान के परिवारों को गंभीर बीमारियों के उपचार हेतु प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹25 लाख तक का कैशलेस अस्पताल स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
ministry: Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department, Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: All families domiciled in Rajasthan possessing Jan Aadhaar card (free for NFSA, SECC, small/marginal farmers; nominal premium for others)
benefits: Cashless medical cover of up to ₹25 Lakhs per family per year
Includes day care, critical organ transplants, cancer treatment, and accidental insurance of ₹10 Lakhs
documents: Jan Aadhaar Card / Jan Aadhaar Acknowledgment Receipt
application_steps: Register through Rajasthan SSO portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) or nearest e-Mitra kiosk
Free auto-inclusion for NFSA, BPL, and marginal farmers; others pay ₹850/year premium
Avail treatment using Jan Aadhaar at empaneled hospitals

name: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana (Unemployment Allowance)
name_hi: राजस्थान मुख्यमंत्री युवा संबल योजना (बेरोजगारी भत्ता)
description: Provides monthly unemployment allowance of ₹4,000 for male graduates and ₹4,500 for female/transgender/specially-abled graduates in Rajasthan along with skill internship.
description_hi: राजस्थान के शिक्षित बेरोजगार स्नातक युवाओं को ₹4,000 (पुरुष) तथा ₹4,500 (महिला/दिव्यांग) मासिक बेरोजगारी भत्ता एवं कौशल इंटर्नशिप।
ministry: Department of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship, Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed graduates domiciled in Rajasthan aged up to 30 years (35 years for female/SC/ST/Divyang) with family income up to ₹2 Lakh
benefits: Monthly financial allowance of ₹4,000 for males; ₹4,500 for women, Transgender, and Divyangjan for up to 2 years
Daily 4 hours internship in government offices to gain administrative experience
application_steps: Log in to Rajasthan SSO portal and navigate to Employment Exchange
Apply under Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana
Join assigned department internship

name: Rajasthan Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (SC/ST/OBC/SBC/EBC)
description: Scholarship and complete fee reimbursement for SC, ST, OBC, SBC, and EBC students studying in Class 11, 12, college degrees, and professional courses in Rajasthan.
description_hi: राजस्थान के अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग एवं विशेष पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों हेतु सम्पूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST students (income up to ₹2.5 Lakh) and OBC/EBC students (income up to ₹1.5 Lakh) domiciled in Rajasthan
benefits: 100% non-refundable course fee reimbursement directly deposited in student's bank account
Monthly maintenance allowance throughout academic year
application_steps: Apply online via SSO Rajasthan (sje.rajasthan.gov.in/scholarship)
Institute verification through online portal
District SJE officer sanction and DBT payment

name: Punjab Ashirwad Scheme (Shagun Scheme for Girls Marriage)
description: Financial assistance of ₹51,000 provided by Punjab Government to poor families (SC/BC/EWS) on the marriage of daughters to prevent indebtedness.
description_hi: पंजाब में अनुसूचित जाति, पिछड़ा वर्ग एवं आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह पर ₹51,000 का सरकारी शगुन/आशीर्वाद अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: SC, BC, and economically backward families domiciled in Punjab with annual income below ₹32,790
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹51,000 credited directly into the bank account of the bride/mother
application_steps: Submit application on ashirwad.punjab.gov.in or through District Social Justice Officer
Verification by Tehsil Welfare Officer and DBT sanction

name: Chirayu Haryana Yojana (Extended Ayushman Bharat)
description: State expanded health assurance program covering families verified under Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) with annual income up to ₹3,00,000 with ₹5 Lakh free hospitalization cover.
description_hi: हरियाणा में परिवार पहचान पत्र (PPP) धारक ₹3 लाख तक की वार्षिक आय वाले परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का निःशुल्क कैशलेस अस्पताल उपचार।
ministry: Health Department, Haryana
department: Haryana Ayushman Bharat Health Protection Authority
target_beneficiaries: Families verified in Haryana Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) with annual income up to ₹3.00 Lakh (free up to ₹1.80 Lakh; ₹1,500 contribution for ₹1.80-3.00 Lakh)
benefits: Cashless medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled private and civil hospitals
Card issuance linked with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Family ID
application_steps: Check eligibility on chirayuayushmanharyana.in using Family ID
Pay nominal token contribution if income between ₹1.80L - ₹3.00L
Download Chirayu Golden Card

name: Haryana Old Age Samman Allowance (Vridhavastha Samman)
description: Highest state old age pension in India providing ₹3,000 per month automatically sanctioned to senior citizens aged 60+ based on Parivar Pehchan Patra data.
description_hi: हरियाणा के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को बिना किसी सरकारी दफ्तर के चक्कर लगाए ₹3,000 प्रतिमाह का स्वतः सम्मान भत्ता।
ministry: Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs & BCs Department, Haryana
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60+ domiciled in Haryana with combined husband-wife income not exceeding ₹3,00,000 per year
benefits: Monthly pension allowance of ₹3,000 directly credited into bank account
Proactive auto-sanction through Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) upon attaining 60 years
documents: Bank Account linked with Family ID
application_steps: Citizen receives SMS/call upon turning 60 based on PPP data
Citizen gives consent to field verification officer
Pension starts automatically without submitting manual forms

name: Delhi Higher Education and Skill Development Guarantee Scheme
name_hi: दिल्ली उच्च शिक्षा एवं कौशल विकास ऋण गारंटी योजना
description: Government of NCT of Delhi provides credit guarantee for educational loans up to ₹10 Lakhs without any third-party guarantee or collateral for students pursuing higher education in Delhi.
description_hi: दिल्ली के छात्रों को स्नातक, स्नातकोत्तर एवं डिप्लोमा पाठ्यक्रमों हेतु बिना किसी अचल संपत्ति बंधक अथवा गारंटर के ₹10 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण।
ministry: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Students who have passed Class 10 and 12 from Delhi seeking loans for higher studies in recognized colleges/universities in Delhi
benefits: Collateral-free educational loan up to ₹10 Lakhs
Delhi Government provides 100% guarantee to lending banks through Higher Education and Skill Development Guarantee Fund
Moratorium period of Course duration + 1 year
documents: Class 10 and 12 marksheets and passing certificates from schools in Delhi
Admission Proof in recognized college in Delhi
application_steps: Apply online through Delhi Government e-District portal or higheredn.delhi.gov.in
Select lending bank branch
Bank processes application under state credit guarantee cover

name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
description: Financial assistance program promoting girl child education and preventing female foeticide by depositing institutional financial milestones totaling up to ₹36,000.
description_hi: दिल्ली में बालिकाओं के जन्म एवं स्कूली शिक्षा (कक्षा 1, 6, 9, 10वीं, 12वीं) के विभिन्न स्तरों पर कुल ₹35,000 से ₹36,000 का वित्तीय संचय।
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Girl children born in Delhi or studying in recognized schools in Delhi with family income not exceeding ₹1,00,000/year
benefits: Milestone deposits: ₹11,000 for institutional birth in Delhi (₹10,000 if home birth); ₹5,000 each upon admission to Class 1, 6, 9, 10, and 12
Entire accumulated amount with compound interest paid to girl upon passing Class 10/12 and attaining 18 years
documents: Delhi Domicile / Residence Proof for past 3 years
application_steps: Apply through school where girl is admitted or via edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in
State Life Insurance Corporation (SBIL / LIC) manages the trust deposit
Maturity claim submitted upon turning 18

name: Nanda Gaura Yojana (Gaura Devi Kanya Dhan Uttarakhand)
description: Financial assistance program providing ₹11,000 upon the birth of a girl child and ₹51,000 upon passing Class 12 to encourage girls to pursue higher university education.
description_hi: उत्तराखंड में बालिका जन्म पर ₹11,000 तथा 12वीं कक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने पर उच्च शिक्षा हेतु ₹51,000 की प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Women Empowerment and Child Development Department, Uttarakhand
target_beneficiaries: Girl children domiciled in Uttarakhand from families with annual income up to ₹72,000
benefits: ₹11,000 cash grant upon institutional birth of girl child
₹51,000 one-time grant upon successfully passing Class 12 from any recognized board in Uttarakhand to enroll in higher education
documents: Uttarakhand Domicile / Sthaniya Niwas Praman Patra
application_steps: Apply online on nandagaura.uk.gov.in portal
Verification by Anganwadi worker and Child Development Project Officer (CDPO)
DBT release directly into girl's account

name: Himachal Pradesh Mukhya Mantri Swavlamban Yojana (MMSY)
description: Promotes local entrepreneurship in Himachal Pradesh by providing 25% to 35% capital subsidy and 5% interest subvention for 3 years on bank loans up to ₹1 Crore.
