description_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश के युवाओं एवं महिलाओं को विनिर्माण, पर्यटन, सेवा एवं कृषि-उद्योग स्थापित करने हेतु ₹1 करोड़ तक के ऋण पर 25% से 35% तक का पूंजीगत अनुदान।
ministry: Industries Department, Himachal Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Himachali youth aged 18-45 years (up to 50 years for women and widows) setting up new enterprises
benefits: Capital investment subsidy: 25% for males, 30% for women, and 35% for SC/ST/Divyang/Widows on project machinery up to ₹1 Crore
5% interest subsidy for 3 years on term loans
Land allocation at 50% concessional rates in industrial areas
application_steps: Submit project on emerginghimachal.hp.gov.in portal
District Level Committee (DLC) chaired by Deputy Commissioner approves subsidy
Bank disburses loan and subsidy released directly to bank

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Direct financial empowerment scheme providing monthly direct benefit transfer of ₹1,500 to underprivileged women aged 21-65 years residing in Maharashtra.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र की 21 से 65 वर्ष आयु वर्ग की पात्र महिलाओं को आर्थिक स्वावलंबन एवं पोषण हेतु प्रतिमाह ₹1,500 की नकद वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Married, widowed, divorced, deserted, and destitute women aged 21-65 residing in Maharashtra with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer of ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 per year) directly credited into woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Economic independence and nutritional security
documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate / Ration Card issued at least 15 years ago
Yellow / Orange Ration Card or Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh)
application_steps: Apply online through Nari Shakti Doot Mobile App or ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in portal
Upload documents and Aadhaar e-KYC
Gram Panchayat / Ward screening and direct monthly bank credit

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY Maharashtra)
name_hi: महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जन आरोग्य योजना (महाराष्ट्र)
description: Universal health insurance scheme of Maharashtra providing cashless medical and surgical treatment of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 1,000+ empaneled hospitals.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र के नागरिकों को 1,356 प्रकार की गंभीर बीमारियों एवं शल्य चिकित्सा हेतु प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य उपचार।
ministry: Public Health Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: All ration card holder families in Maharashtra holding Yellow, Orange, or White ration cards (Universal health coverage)
benefits: Cashless hospital care of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers 1,356 medical and surgical procedures across 34 specialized categories including renal transplant, cardiac surgeries, and oncology
Free diagnostic and medicine support during hospital stay
application_steps: Visit any empaneled government or private network hospital
Meet Arogyamitra at MJPJAY helpdesk with Ration Card and Aadhaar
Hospital sends e-pre-authorization and provides cashless treatment

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
name_hi: राजर्षि छत्रपति शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ति योजना (ईबीसी)
description: Higher education fee reimbursement scheme on MahaDBT portal providing 50% tuition and exam fee waiver to students from Economically Backward Classes (EBC) in professional courses.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र के आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्ग (EBC/SEBC) के विद्यार्थियों को मेडिकल, इंजीनियरिंग एवं व्यावसायिक उच्च शिक्षा में 50% शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति।
ministry: Higher and Technical Education Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Maharashtra admitted through CAP rounds to professional/technical diploma, degree, and postgraduate courses with family income up to ₹8 Lakh
benefits: 50% reimbursement of tuition fees and exam fees approved by Fee Regulating Authority (FRA)
Direct electronic transfer into student / institute account via MahaDBT
documents: Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar (≤ ₹8 Lakh/year)
application_steps: Log in to mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in portal
Apply under Directorate of Higher Education / Directorate of Technical Education
College nodal officer e-verifies credentials

name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP Maharashtra)
description: Credit-linked capital subsidy scheme assisting youth to establish manufacturing and service micro-enterprises with loans up to ₹50 Lakhs and government subsidies up to 35%.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को विनिर्माण एवं सेवा क्षेत्र में उद्योग स्थापित करने हेतु ₹50 लाख तक का ऋण एवं 15% से 35% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Industries Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Youth aged 18-45 years (up to 50 years for women, SC, ST, and Ex-Servicemen) domiciled in Maharashtra
benefits: Financial assistance for projects up to ₹50 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹20 Lakhs in service sector
Capital subsidy (Margin Money) of 15% to 25% for general category and 25% to 35% for special categories (Women/SC/ST/Divyang/Rural)
documents: Educational Marksheet (Class 10 pass for projects > ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing)
application_steps: Submit online application on cmegp.gov.in portal
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) reviews and forwards to designated bank
Bank disburses loan and subsidy released directly into escrow account

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY Gujarat)
description: Comprehensive higher education scholarship of Gujarat providing 50% tuition fee reimbursement up to ₹2 Lakh/year, hostel allowances, and book grants to meritorious students.
description_hi: गुजरात के 10वीं/12वीं में 80 पर्सेंटाइल से अधिक अंक पाने वाले विद्यार्थियों को मेडिकल, इंजीनियरिंग एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में 50% तक ट्यूशन फीस एवं हॉस्टल सहायता।
ministry: Education Department, Government of Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Students securing ≥80 percentile in Class 10/12 board exams admitted to degree/diploma courses in Gujarat with family income up to ₹6 Lakh
benefits: 50% tuition fee assistance: up to ₹2,00,000/year for medical/dental; up to ₹50,000/year for engineering/professional; up to ₹25,000/year for diploma
Hostel accommodation allowance of ₹1,200 per month (₹12,000/year)
One-time book and equipment grant up to ₹10,000
documents: Income Certificate issued by Mamlatdar / TDO (≤ ₹6 Lakh)
application_steps: Apply online at mysy.guj.nic.in
Document verification at designated Help Centre (government colleges)
Direct transfer of scholarship into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account

name: Vhali Dikri Yojana (Gujarat Dear Daughter Scheme)
description: Financial incentive program by Gujarat Government granting total financial assistance of ₹1,10,000 across three stages for the education and marriage of the first two girl children in poor families.
description_hi: गुजरात में बालिकाओं के सशक्तिकरण एवं शिक्षा हेतु तीन चरणों में कुल ₹1,10,000 (कक्षा 1, कक्षा 9 एवं 18 वर्ष आयु) की वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: First and second girl children born in Gujarat families with annual income up to ₹2,00,000
benefits: First installment of ₹4,000 on admission to Class 1
Second installment of ₹6,000 on admission to Class 9
Third lump-sum installment of ₹1,00,000 upon attaining 18 years of age (without being married before 18) for higher education or marriage
documents: Aadhaar Card of parents and daughter
application_steps: Submit application at Anganwadi Centre, Taluka Development Office, or through Digital Gujarat portal (digitalgujarat.gov.in)
Scrutiny by Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) and sanction

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
description: Flagship direct income support scheme providing ₹1,250 per month directly into bank accounts of over 1.29 crore women in Madhya Pradesh to foster health, nutrition, and self-reliance.
description_hi: मध्य प्रदेश की 21 से 60 वर्ष की विवाहित, विधवा एवं तलाकशुदा महिलाओं को प्रतिमाह ₹1,250 की प्रत्यक्ष नकद आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Resident women of MP aged 21-60 years whose combined family annual income is under ₹2.5 Lakh and not paying income tax
benefits: Monthly financial transfer of ₹1,250 (credited on 10th of every month) directly via DBT into Aadhaar-linked bank account
Subsidized domestic LPG refills at ₹450 under Ladli Behna Gas Subsidy scheme
documents: Samagra Family ID and Member ID
Bank Account linked with Aadhaar with active DBT
application_steps: Camps organized at Gram Panchayat and Ward level
Biometric e-KYC on cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in
Instant generation of Ladli Behna registration receipt and monthly credit

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY Madhya Pradesh)
name_hi: मुख्यमंत्री मेधावी विद्यार्थी योजना (MMVY मध्य प्रदेश)
description: State education initiative where the Madhya Pradesh Government pays 100% of the tuition fees for students securing ≥70% in MP Board (≥85% in CBSE/ICSE) admitted to engineering, medical, law, and degree colleges.
description_hi: 12वीं में मेधावी अंक लाने वाले विद्यार्थियों के मेडिकल (MBBS), इंजीनियरिंग (IIT/NIT/JEE), क्लैट (NLU) एवं डिग्री पाठ्यक्रमों की सम्पूर्ण ट्यूशन फीस म.प्र. सरकार द्वारा वहन।
ministry: Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in MP scoring ≥70% in MP Board or ≥85% in CBSE/ICSE in Class 12 with family income up to ₹6 Lakh
benefits: 100% tuition fee paid directly to institution by State Government for MBBS in government/private medical colleges in MP
Full academic fees paid for IIT, NIT, IIIT, BITS Pilani, NLU, and government engineering colleges
Full fee reimbursement for regular degree courses in government colleges
application_steps: Apply online on Scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in under MMVY section
Institute verifies fee demand and admission records
Sanction and direct fee remittance to institution

name: Mukhya Mantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana
description: Comprehensive social safety net for unorganized workers in MP providing maternity assistance of ₹16,000, death ex-gratia up to ₹4 Lakhs, funeral assistance, and free higher education for children.
description_hi: असंगठित श्रमिकों को प्रसूति सहायता (₹16,000), दुर्घटना मृत्यु पर ₹4 लाख अनुग्रह राशि, अंत्येष्टि सहायता एवं बच्चों की निःशुल्क उच्च शिक्षा।
ministry: Labour Department, Madhya Pradesh
department: MP Unorganized Workers Social Security Board
target_beneficiaries: Registered unorganized workers aged 18-60 domiciled in MP not paying income tax or holding government jobs
benefits: Maternity assistance of ₹16,000 for women workers
Accidental death assistance of ₹4,00,000 to family; ₹2,00,000 for normal death
₹5,000 immediate funeral aid
Complete free higher education in technical/medical institutes for children of Sambal card holders
application_steps: Apply online at sambal.mp.gov.in portal
Inquiry by Gram Panchayat Secretary / Ward in-charge
Instant issuance of Sambal 2.0 Smart Card

name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
description: Direct benefit transfer program providing monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 (₹12,000 per year) directly to married, widowed, and abandoned women in Chhattisgarh.
description_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ की 21 वर्ष से अधिक आयु की विवाहित, विधवा एवं परित्यक्ता महिलाओं को प्रतिमाह ₹1,000 (वार्षिक ₹12,000) की नकद आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Married women aged 21 and above domiciled in Chhattisgarh whose family income is not subject to income tax
benefits: Monthly assistance of ₹1,000 directly credited via DBT on the first week of every month into beneficiary's bank account
documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant and husband
Marriage Certificate / Ration Card showing marital status
application_steps: Apply through mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in portal or submit form at Anganwadi Centre / Gram Panchayat
Aadhaar biometric authentication
Monthly DBT release

name: Chhattisgarh Krishi Unnati Yojana (Paddy Farmers Assistance)
name_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ कृषक उन्नति योजना (धान उपार्जन सहायता)
description: Flagship agricultural support scheme providing input assistance ensuring farmers receive ₹3,100 per quintal for paddy procurement up to 21 quintals per acre.
description_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ के धान उत्पादक किसानों को ₹3,100 प्रति क्विंटल का सुनिश्चित मूल्य एवं प्रति एकड़ 21 क्विंटल धान विक्रय पर अंतर राशि का सीधा भुगतान।
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Paddy producing farmers registered on the Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay / Unified Farmer Portal in Chhattisgarh
benefits: Differential input subsidy ensuring farmers receive ₹3,100 per quintal (above Central MSP)
Procurement ceiling of 21 quintals per acre
One-time direct bank transfer of differential amount
application_steps: Register land and crop details on kisan.cg.nic.in portal
Sell paddy at Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACS) mandi
Direct transfer of difference subsidy amount into bank account

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (Bihar)
description: Comprehensive girl child welfare program providing financial assistance totaling up to ₹54,100 from birth to graduation to prevent infant mortality and promote female higher education.
description_hi: बिहार में बालिकाओं के जन्म से लेकर स्नातक उत्तीर्ण होने तक विभिन्न चरणों में कुल ₹54,100 (जन्म पर ₹5,000, 12वीं पर ₹25,000, स्नातक पर ₹50,000) की प्रोत्साहन राशि।
ministry: Education and Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar
target_beneficiaries: Girl students domiciled in Bihar passing intermediate or graduation from recognized institutions in Bihar
benefits: ₹25,000 one-time incentive upon passing Intermediate (Class 12) unmarried
₹50,000 one-time incentive upon completing Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) in any stream from recognized university in Bihar
Direct electronic transfer into girl's personal bank account
documents: Bank Passbook with student's name and IFSC (Bank located in Bihar)
application_steps: Register on medhasoft.bih.nic.in portal
Enter university registration roll number and Aadhaar details
College verifies student graduation list and DBT payment credited

name: Bihar Student Credit Card (BSCC) Scheme
description: Provides collateral-free educational loans up to ₹4,00,000 guaranteed by Bihar Government to 12th pass students for pursuing higher education in technical, medical, and general degree courses.
description_hi: 12वीं पास छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षा हेतु राज्य सरकार की गारंटी पर बिना किसी गिरवी या बंधक के ₹4 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण मात्र 1% (महिला/दिव्यांग) एवं 4% (पुरुष) ब्याज पर।
ministry: Education Department, Bihar
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Bihar who have passed Class 12 (or 10th for polytechnic) admitted to recognized higher education institutions in India
benefits: Education loan up to ₹4,00,000 covering college fees, hostel, books, laptop, and living expenses
Concessional simple interest: 1% for females, transgender, and Divyangjan; 4% for male students
Moratorium period of Course duration + 1 year (no interest during course)
documents: College Admission Proof and Fee Structure
Aadhaar Card of student and co-borrower
application_steps: Register on 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in portal
Visit District Registration and Counseling Centre (DRCC) for document physical verification
BSEFC issues approval and disburses fee directly to college

name: Bihar Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (SC/ST/EBC/Women/Yuva)
description: Flagship industrial promotion program providing ₹10,00,000 financial support (50% grant + 50% interest-free loan) to set up new manufacturing and service micro-enterprises in Bihar.
description_hi: नया उद्योग स्थापित करने हेतु ₹10 लाख की सहायता: ₹5 लाख का पूर्ण सरकारी अनुदान (सब्सिडी) तथा ₹5 लाख का ब्याज-मुक्त ऋण (महिलाओं/युवाओं हेतु 1% नाममात्र ब्याज)।
ministry: Industries Department, Government of Bihar
target_beneficiaries: Youth, women, SC, ST, and EBC citizens of Bihar aged 18-50 years with minimum intermediate/ITI/polytechnic diploma qualification
benefits: Total financial assistance of ₹10 Lakhs: ₹5 Lakhs direct government grant (subsidy) + ₹5 Lakhs soft loan repayable in 84 monthly installments
0% interest for SC, ST, EBC, and Women; only 1% simple interest for general/OBC youth
₹25,000 one-time grant for 2 weeks training
documents: Class 12 / ITI / Diploma / Degree Passing Certificate
application_steps: Apply online on udyami.bihar.gov.in when annual registration window opens
Computerized lottery selection monitored by Industries Department
Two-week enterprise training and tranche-wise fund release

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
description: UN Public Service Award-winning conditional cash transfer scheme providing annual scholarships (K1) and a one-time grant of ₹25,000 (K2) to keep girls in school and prevent child marriage.
description_hi: बालिकाओं को बाल विवाह से बचाने एवं उच्च शिक्षा तक पहुंचाने हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति (K1) तथा 18 वर्ष आयु पर ₹25,000 का एकमुश्त सरकारी अनुदान (K2)।
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal
target_beneficiaries: Unmarried girls aged 13-18 enrolled in Class 8-12 (K1) and aged 18-19 pursuing higher education/training (K2) in West Bengal
benefits: K1: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 paid every year from age 13 to 18 while in school
K2: One-time capital grant of ₹25,000 paid upon turning 18 if unmarried and enrolled in an educational or vocational institution
K3: Special fellowship for post-graduate higher education
documents: Unmarried Declaration signed by parent and head of institution
Bank Account in girl's sole name with IFSC
application_steps: Fill application form at school / college
School head verifies and uploads data on wb.gov.in/kanyashree portal
Direct bank credit to girl's account

name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (West Bengal)
description: Direct financial assistance scheme providing monthly basic income of ₹1,000 to General category women and ₹1,200 to SC/ST women aged 25-60 years residing in West Bengal.
description_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल की 25 से 60 वर्ष की महिलाओं को प्रतिमाह ₹1,000 (सामान्य वर्ग) तथा ₹1,200 (एससी/एसटी वर्ग) की नियमित बुनियादी आय सहायता।
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal
target_beneficiaries: Women residents of West Bengal aged 25-60 years not in permanent government employment
benefits: Monthly direct financial grant: ₹1,000 per month for General category women; ₹1,200 per month for SC/ST women
Credited directly via DBT into beneficiary's personal Aadhaar-linked bank account on the first week of every month
documents: Bank Passbook showing name and IFSC
application_steps: Submit application form at Duare Sarkar (Government at Doorstep) camps held across the state
Verification by Block Development Officer / Sub-Divisional Officer
Monthly automatic credit

name: Swasthya Sathi Scheme (West Bengal)
description: Flagship universal health protection scheme providing ₹5,00,000 cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover per family per year, issued in the name of the eldest woman of the family.
description_hi: परिवार की वरिष्ठ महिला के नाम पर जारी स्मार्ट कार्ड के माध्यम से प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का पूर्णतः कैशलेस अस्पताल स्वास्थ्य उपचार।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, West Bengal
target_beneficiaries: All resident families of West Bengal not covered under any other government statutory health scheme
benefits: Basic health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per annum per family on a floater basis
Paperless and cashless treatment in 2,400+ government and private network hospitals across Bengal and top hospitals in India
All pre-existing diseases covered from day one
documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Ration Card / Digital Khadya Sathi Card
Photograph of eldest female family head
application_steps: Enroll at Duare Sarkar camp or local municipal/block office
Biometric capture of family members
Issuance of Swasthya Sathi Smart Card on the spot

name: KALIA Scheme (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation)
name_hi: कालिया योजना (ओडिशा कृषक आजीविका एवं आय संवर्धन)
description: Progressive agrarian welfare scheme providing financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year for cultivation to small/marginal farmers and ₹12,500 livelihood grants to landless agricultural households.
description_hi: ओडिशा के छोटे व सीमांत किसानों को खेती हेतु ₹10,000 प्रतिवर्ष तथा भूमिहीन खेतिहर परिवारों को बकरी, बत्तख व डेयरी पालन हेतु ₹12,500 की आजीविका सहायता।
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Empowerment, Odisha
department: Directorate of Agriculture and Food Production
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural households, and vulnerable agricultural laborers domiciled in Odisha
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹4,000 (Rabi) + ₹4,000 (Kharif) per year for input procurement (fertilizers, seeds)
One-time financial assistance of ₹12,500 to landless agricultural households for allied activities (goat rearing, duckery, fisheries)
Life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh and accidental cover of ₹2 Lakh
application_steps: Apply online on kalia.odisha.gov.in portal
Validation by Village Agriculture Worker (VAW) and Gram Panchayat scrutiny
Direct benefit transfer via PFMS directly to bank account

name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY / Gopabandhu Jan Arogya)
description: Comprehensive health insurance program of Odisha providing cashless medical treatment of ₹5,00,000 per family and ₹10,00,000 for women members per year in premier hospitals.
description_hi: ओडिशा के 1 करोड़ परिवारों को प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख तथा परिवार की महिला सदस्यों हेतु ₹10 लाख प्रति वर्ष का कैशलेस अस्पताल स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Odisha
target_beneficiaries: NFSA and SFSS ration card holder families domiciled in Odisha
benefits: Cashless healthcare up to ₹5,00,000 per family per annum
Enhanced cover up to ₹10,00,000 per annum for all female family members
Cashless services across 800+ top private hospitals in Odisha and major metros (AIIMS, Apollo, Tata Memorial)
documents: BSKY Health Card / NFSA Ration Card
application_steps: Show BSKY card / NFSA ration card at hospital helpdesk
Swasthya Mitra facilitates pre-authorization
Completely cashless hospital stay and treatment

name: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana (JMMSY)
description: Direct financial aid program providing monthly direct benefit transfer of ₹1,000 to underprivileged women aged 18 to 50 years domiciled in Jharkhand.
description_hi: झारखंड की 18 से 50 वर्ष की बहनों एवं माताओं को आर्थिक स्वावलंबन एवं सशक्तिकरण हेतु प्रतिमाह ₹1,000 (वार्षिक ₹12,000) की प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Women, Child Development and Social Security Department, Jharkhand
target_beneficiaries: Women aged 18-50 domiciled in Jharkhand belonging to Antyodaya/Priority ration card families whose household does not pay income tax
benefits: Direct monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 credited on the 15th of every month into beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Economic independence for rural and tribal women
documents: Bank Account linked with Aadhaar with single holder operation
application_steps: Submit application at special camps organized across Panchayats or on mmmsy.jharkhand.gov.in
Biometric verification by Pragya Kendra (CSC)
Sanction by Block Development Officer and monthly DBT release

name: Abua Awas Yojana (Jharkhand)
description: State rural housing scheme providing ₹2,00,000 financial assistance for constructing a 3-room pucca house with a kitchen for homeless and kutcha-house dwelling rural families.
description_hi: झारखंड के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले परिवारों को 3 कमरों का पक्का मकान (रसोईघर सहित) निर्माण हेतु ₹2,00,000 की सरकारी वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Rural Development Department, Jharkhand
target_beneficiaries: Homeless and kutcha-house dwelling rural families domiciled in Jharkhand not covered under PMAY-G
benefits: Financial grant of ₹2,00,000 paid across 4 construction stages: Foundation (₹30,000), Lintel (₹50,000), Roof (₹1,00,000), Completion (₹20,000)
Additional 95 days of unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA (~₹26,000)
documents: Geo-tagged photo of existing kutcha house
application_steps: Submit application at Aapki Yojana Aapki Sarkar Aapke Dwar camp
Gram Sabha scrutinizes and approves beneficiary priority list
Direct electronic transfer into bank account linked with construction stages

name: Orunodoi 2.0 Scheme (Assam)
description: Direct financial benefit transfer scheme transferring ₹1,250 on the 10th of every month into bank accounts of female heads of economically disadvantaged families across Assam.
description_hi: असम के गरीब परिवारों की महिला मुखिया को पोषण, दवा एवं दैनिक आवश्यकताओं हेतु प्रतिमाह ₹1,250 (वार्षिक ₹15,000) की प्रत्यक्ष नकद सहायता।
ministry: Finance Department, Government of Assam
target_beneficiaries: Permanent resident families of Assam with annual income below ₹2,00,000 with preference for families with widows, divyang, or unmarried daughters
benefits: Monthly assistance of ₹1,250 (covering ₹400 for medicines, ₹200 for 4 kg pulses, ₹250 for sugar/fruits, ₹150 for essential items, ₹250 for electricity)
Direct transfer into nominated woman's bank account via DBT
application_steps: Gaon Panchayat / VCDC / Urban Local Body prepares beneficiary shortlist
Verification by District Level Monitoring Committee
Direct electronic monthly disbursement

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
description: Direct financial empowerment scheme providing monthly direct benefit transfer of ₹2,000 to woman heads of households registered under BPL, Antyodaya, or APL cards in Karnataka.
description_hi: कर्नाटक के बीपीएल, अंत्योदय एवं एपीएल परिवारों की महिला मुखिया को आर्थिक आत्मनिर्भरता हेतु प्रतिमाह ₹2,000 (वार्षिक ₹24,000) की प्रत्यक्ष नकद सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Woman identified as head of the family in Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards whose husband is not paying income tax or GST
benefits: Direct transfer of ₹2,000 per month (₹24,000/year) into woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Dignified social security and domestic financial control
documents: Ration Card (APL/BPL/Antyodaya) showing woman as family head
Aadhaar Card of woman and husband
Bank Passbook seeded with Aadhaar and NPCI mapping
application_steps: Submit application at Karnataka One, Grama One, or Bangalore One centres or via Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in)
Automatic verification and sanction
Direct monthly credit via DBT

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka Unemployment Allowance)
description: Youth financial support scheme providing monthly unemployment allowance of ₹3,000 for degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders who graduated and remained unemployed.
description_hi: कर्नाटक के बेरोजगार स्नातकों को ₹3,000 प्रतिमाह तथा डिप्लोमा धारकों को ₹1,500 प्रतिमाह की वित्तीय सहायता 2 वर्ष की अवधि तक।
ministry: Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Department, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Graduates and diploma holders domiciled in Karnataka who completed their course and remained unemployed after 180 days of graduation
benefits: Monthly financial stipend of ₹3,000 for degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders for up to 2 years or until employment is secured
Free registration and skill training under Karnataka Skill Connect portal
documents: Degree / Diploma Passing Certificate and Marksheets
application_steps: Apply online on Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in)
Automatic verification of university degree through NAD / State Student Achievement Tracking System (SATS)
Monthly DBT disbursement upon periodic self-declaration

name: Vidyasiri Scholarship (Karnataka ePASS Food and Accommodation Scheme)
description: Post-matric scholarship and monthly food & accommodation stipend of ₹1,500 for backward classes (OBC, SC, ST) students who did not get admission into government hostels.
description_hi: कर्नाटक के पिछड़ा वर्ग, एससी एवं एसटी छात्रों को सरकारी छात्रावास न मिलने पर भोजन एवं आवास हेतु ₹1,500 प्रतिमाह (वार्षिक ₹15,000) तथा पूर्ण शुल्क रियायत।
ministry: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: OBC, SC, ST students studying in post-matric courses who are residents of Karnataka living away from home without hostel allotment
benefits: Food and accommodation allowance of ₹1,500 per month for 10 months (₹15,000/year)
Tuition fee waiver and exam fee reimbursement as approved by Department
documents: Caste and Income Certificate (RD number verified via Nadakacheri)
application_steps: Register on State Scholarship Portal (ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in)
College e-attestation of documents
District Backward Classes Welfare Officer approves and releases payment

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT - Tamil Nadu)
name_hi: कलैग्नार मगलिर उरीमई थित्तम (तमिलनाडु महिला अधिकार अनुदान)
description: Basic universal income rights scheme providing ₹1,000 per month directly into bank accounts of over 1.15 crore women heads of households in Tamil Nadu.
description_hi: तमिलनाडु की 1.15 करोड़ से अधिक महिला गृहणियों को उनके घरेलू श्रम के सम्मान एवं आर्थिक स्वावलंबन हेतु प्रतिमाह ₹1,000 की नियमित नकद सहायता।
ministry: Special Programme Implementation Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Women aged 21 and above who are heads of families possessing smart family cards with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Monthly financial rights grant of ₹1,000 credited on the 15th of every month directly via DBT
Zero deduction or minimum balance penalty from banks
documents: Bank Account Details with Aadhaar seeding
application_steps: Submit application at designated camp in Fair Price Shop / Ration Shop area
Field verification by volunteer and revenue staff
Direct monthly transfer to bank account

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
name_hi: पुधुमई पेन योजना (तमिलनाडु बालिका उच्च शिक्षा प्रोत्साहन)
description: Incentivizes female higher education by providing ₹1,000 per month directly into bank accounts of girl students who studied Class 6 to 12 in government schools pursuing degree/diploma courses.
description_hi: सरकारी स्कूलों से कक्षा 6 से 12वीं तक पढ़ने वाली छात्राओं को कॉलेज की स्नातक, इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल या डिप्लोमा शिक्षा पूरी होने तक ₹1,000 प्रतिमाह का वजीफा।
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Girl students domiciled in Tamil Nadu who studied from Class 6 to 12 in Government schools and enrolled in undergraduate degree, diploma, or ITI programs
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 credited throughout the duration of undergraduate, engineering, medical, law, or diploma degree
Higher education enrollment parity for rural and poor girl students
documents: EMIS (Educational Management Information System) ID verifying Class 6-12 in Tamil Nadu government school
Bank Account Details in student's name
application_steps: Register through college nodal officer on pudhumaipenn.tn.gov.in
Automatic school history verification via School Education EMIS database
Direct monthly DBT disbursement to student's bank account

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS Tamil Nadu)
name_hi: मुख्यमंत्री व्यापक स्वास्थ्य बीमा योजना (तमिलनाडु CMCHIS)
description: Cashless hospitalization scheme providing coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for 1,513 medical and surgical procedures across 1,600+ network hospitals in Tamil Nadu.
description_hi: तमिलनाडु के परिवारों को गंभीर बीमारियों एवं सर्जरी हेतु प्रति वर्ष प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस अस्पताल उपचार।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Families domiciled in Tamil Nadu holding Smart Ration Cards with annual income less than ₹1,20,000
benefits: Cashless hospital coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers specialized surgeries, diagnostic tests, bone marrow transplant, liver and renal transplants
Integrated with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY in Tamil Nadu
documents: Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority (≤ ₹1.2 Lakh/year)
application_steps: Enroll at District Collectorate CMCHIS kiosk with Smart Card and Income certificate
Biometric capture and smart insurance card issuance
Cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals

name: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
description: Agricultural investment support scheme providing direct financial transfer of up to ₹15,000 per acre per year (₹7,500 per acre each season) to farmers for seed, fertilizer, and farm inputs.
description_hi: तेलंगाना के किसानों को खरीफ एवं रबी दोनों मौसमों में खाद, बीज एवं कीटनाशक क्रय हेतु ₹15,000 प्रति एकड़ प्रति वर्ष की सीधी निवेश सहायता।
ministry: Agriculture and Cooperation Department, Telangana
target_beneficiaries: All landowning farmers possessing digital Pattadar Passbooks and active Dharani land records in Telangana
benefits: Financial grant of ₹7,500 per acre per season (total ₹15,000 per acre per year)
No middlemen, direct electronic credit into farmer's savings bank account
Freedom to purchase quality inputs from any vendor
application_steps: Land ownership verified automatically through Dharani portal records
Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) confirms crop status
Direct credit via e-Kuber portal to bank account

name: Kalyana Lakshmi & Shaadi Mubarak Scheme (Telangana)
name_hi: कल्याण लक्ष्मी एवं शादी मुबारक योजना (तेलंगाना)
description: One-time financial assistance of ₹1,00,116 to brides from SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority poor families in Telangana to prevent child marriage and alleviate wedding financial distress.
description_hi: तेलंगाना के एससी, एसटी, बीसी एवं अल्पसंख्यक गरीब परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह पर ₹1,00,116 की एकमुश्त सरकारी वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Scheduled Castes Development & Backward Classes Welfare Departments, Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Brides aged 18 or above domiciled in Telangana from SC/ST/BC/EBC (income ≤ ₹2 Lakh in urban; ₹1.5 Lakh in rural) and Minorities
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹1,00,116 credited directly into the bank account of the bride's mother
Abolishes dependence on usurious local moneylenders
documents: Bride's Age Proof (SSC Certificate / Birth Certificate showing age ≥18)
Aadhaar Cards of bride, bridegroom, and parents
Income and Caste Certificate verified through MeeSeva
application_steps: Apply online on telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in portal
Field inspection by Mandal Revenue Officer (MRO)
Direct bank sanction through Treasury

name: Jagananna Vidya Deevena (Andhra Pradesh Full Fee Reimbursement)
name_hi: जगनान्ना विद्या दीवेना (आंध्र प्रदेश पूर्ण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति)
description: Flagship higher education welfare program providing 100% full fee reimbursement directly into mothers' bank accounts for students pursuing ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, Engineering, and Medicine.
description_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश के गरीब विद्यार्थियों हेतु आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक, इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल एवं डिग्री पाठ्यक्रमों की 100% सम्पूर्ण कॉलेज ट्यूशन फीस की प्रतिपूर्ति।
ministry: Higher Education Department, Andhra Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in AP enrolled in recognized post-matric degree/diploma programs whose family annual income is under ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: 100% reimbursement of college tuition fees credited in quarterly installments into mother's bank account
Companion Vasathi Deevena covers boarding and hostel expenses up to ₹20,000/year
documents: Aadhaar Card of student and mother
application_steps: Apply through Grama / Ward Sachivalayam volunteer on jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in
College principal verifies enrollment and fee demand
Direct electronic transfer into mother's account

name: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Scheme (Andhra Pradesh)
name_hi: डॉ. वाईएसआर आरोग्यश्री स्वास्थ्य योजना (आंध्र प्रदेश)
description: Comprehensive catastrophic health insurance offering cashless medical coverage of up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year for 3,257 recognized ailments in Andhra Pradesh and super-specialty hospitals.
description_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश के गरीब परिवारों को कैंसर, हृदय रोग एवं 3,257 गंभीर बीमारियों के उपचार हेतु प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹25 लाख तक का कैशलेस अस्पताल स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
ministry: Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department, Andhra Pradesh
department: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Care Trust
target_beneficiaries: Families domiciled in Andhra Pradesh holding Rice Cards or having annual income up to ₹5.00 Lakh
benefits: Complete cashless medical care up to ₹25 Lakhs per family per year across 2,400+ empaneled hospitals including Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai
Post-operative financial subsistence allowance under Aarogya Asara (up to ₹5,000/month during convalescence)
documents: YSR Aarogyasri Health Card / Rice Card
application_steps: Aarogya Mithra at any network hospital verifies patient eligibility using QR code / Aadhaar
Pre-authorization granted electronically within 24 hours
Completely cashless discharge and medication

name: Karunya Benevolent Fund (KBF / KASP Kerala)
description: Financial assistance program funded by Kerala state lottery proceeds providing medical assistance up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹3 Lakh for cancer and transplants) for low-income patients suffering from acute ailments.
description_hi: केरल के गरीब मरीजों को कैंसर, किडनी डायलिसिस, हीमोफीलिया एवं हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹3 लाख तक का सरकारी वित्तीय अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Kerala with annual family income up to ₹3,00,000 suffering from critical diseases
benefits: One-time financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 for treatments and surgeries; up to ₹3,00,000 for kidney/liver transplants
Free regular hemodialysis through Karunya dialyzer support network
documents: Medical Certificate from attending specialist in empanelled hospital with estimated treatment cost
Income Certificate issued by Village Officer (≤ ₹3 Lakh/yr)
application_steps: Submit application at District Medical Office (DMO) or empanelled hospital Karunya liaison desk
District Committee evaluates and issues sanction letter
Payment disbursed directly to treating hospital

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Maharashtra state top-up providing additional ₹6,000 per year directly to PM-KISAN beneficiary farmers in the state, bringing total farmer income support to ₹12,000 per year.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र के पीएम-किसान लाभार्थी किसानों को राज्य सरकार द्वारा अतिरिक्त ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष की नकद सहायता (कुल वार्षिक सहायता ₹12,000)।
ministry: Agriculture Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: All farmers domiciled in Maharashtra registered as active eligible beneficiaries under PM-KISAN
benefits: Direct financial transfer of ₹6,000 per year in three installments of ₹2,000 credited alongside PM-KISAN tranches via DBT
documents: Aadhaar Card with active NPCI mapping
application_steps: Auto-enrolled through PM-KISAN database verification on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in
Direct electronic payment into bank account

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: State social security pension of ₹1,500 per month for destitute senior citizens, widows, abandoned women, persons with severe disability, and patients of critical illnesses.
description_hi: महाराष्ट्र के निराधार वृद्ध, विधवा, तलाकशुदा महिला एवं 40% से अधिक दिव्यांग नागरिकों को ₹1,500 प्रतिमाह की सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन।
ministry: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Destitute individuals aged 65 or above, widows, orphan children, or disabled citizens domiciled in Maharashtra with family income up to ₹21,000/yr
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 per beneficiary (up to ₹2,500 if family has 2 or more beneficiaries)
Direct credit via PFMS DBT into bank account
documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate (living in state for 15+ years)
application_steps: Apply at Tahsildar office or Aaple Sarkar portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in)
Sanction by Taluka Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Committee

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojana (Rajasthan)
description: Provides electricity bill subsidy of up to ₹1,000 per month (up to ₹12,000 per year) directly on metered agricultural connections for farmers in Rajasthan.
description_hi: राजस्थान के कृषि विद्युत उपभोक्ताओं (मीटर वाले कृषि कनेक्शन) को बिजली बिल में प्रतिमाह ₹1,000 (वार्षिक ₹12,000) तक का सीधा सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Energy Department, Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Farmers in Rajasthan having metered agricultural power connections in their name
benefits: Monthly electricity bill subsidy of ₹1,000 (maximum ₹12,000/year) adjusted directly in the electricity bill, effectively making power free for small farmers
Excess subsidy credited to bank account
application_steps: Link Jan Aadhaar and Aadhaar with agricultural electricity account on energy.rajasthan.gov.in or e-Mitra
Subsidy deducted automatically from monthly power bills

name: Mukhyamantri Rajshree Yojana (Rajasthan)
description: Financial incentive program providing ₹50,000 in six installments to girl children from birth until passing Class 12 to promote female survival, health, and secondary education.
description_hi: राजस्थान में बालिकाओं के संस्थागत जन्म से लेकर कक्षा 12वीं उत्तीर्ण करने तक 6 चरणों में कुल ₹50,000 की वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Girl children born in institutional health centers in Rajasthan possessing Jan Aadhaar card
benefits: Total financial assistance of ₹50,000: ₹2,500 at birth; ₹2,500 at 1-year immunization; ₹4,000 upon Class 1 admission; ₹5,000 upon Class 6; ₹11,000 upon Class 10; ₹25,000 upon passing Class 12
documents: Birth Certificate / Delivery slip of government hospital
application_steps: Registration through hospital upon institutional delivery
Subsequent installments applied via school through Shaladarpan and Jan Aadhaar portal
DBT credit to mother's account

name: Mukhya Mantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
description: State income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year directly to PM-KISAN beneficiary farmers in MP (in two equal installments), doubling total annual farmer assistance to ₹12,000.
description_hi: मध्य प्रदेश के पीएम-किसान लाभार्थी किसानों को राज्य सरकार द्वारा ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष की अतिरिक्त वित्तीय सहायता (कुल ₹12,000 वार्षिक)।
ministry: Revenue Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: All landholding farmer families in MP receiving Central PM-KISAN benefits
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹6,000 per year in two installments credited directly into farmer's bank account via SAARA portal
Total farmer support of ₹12,000/yr including central PM-KISAN
application_steps: Patwari verifies land ownership on saara.mp.gov.in portal
Sanction by Tehsildar and electronic payment credit

name: Mukhya Mantri Seekho Kamao Yojana (MMSKY Madhya Pradesh)
description: On-the-job training scheme for youth aged 18-29 offering vocational apprenticeships across 700+ industrial sectors with monthly stipends of ₹8,000 to ₹10,000.
description_hi: 18 से 29 वर्ष के युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावसायिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण तथा ₹8,000 से ₹10,000 प्रतिमाह का सरकारी वजीफा (स्टाइपेंड)।
ministry: Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Youth aged 18-29 domiciled in MP who have passed Class 12, ITI, Diploma, or Graduation
benefits: Monthly stipend during training: ₹8,000 for 12th pass; ₹8,500 for ITI; ₹9,000 for Diploma; ₹10,000 for Degree/Postgraduates (75% paid by Government via DBT)
State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT) certification
application_steps: Register on mmsky.mp.gov.in portal
Apply to posted apprenticeship vacancies in preferred establishments
Complete digital contract and commence on-the-job training

name: Manav Garima Yojana (Gujarat Self-Employment Toolkits)
description: Provides completely free modern toolkits and equipment worth up to ₹25,000 across 28 vocational trades (tailoring, carpentry, masonry, beauty parlor, plumbing) for self-employment.
description_hi: गुजरात के अनुसूचित जाति, सामाजिक एवं शैक्षणिक पिछड़ा वर्ग (SEBC) के कारीगरों को स्वरोजगार हेतु 28 व्यवसायों में निःशुल्क आधुनिक टूलकिट एवं उपकरण।
ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Artisans and unemployed persons in Gujarat belonging to SC, SEBC, or Economically Backward Classes with annual income up to ₹6,00,000
benefits: 100% free physical toolkits and machinery: Sewing machines, carpentry tool sets, masonry kits, beauty parlor kits, plumber toolkits, electrical repair kits
No loan repayment, completely free capital asset grant
documents: Trade Training Certificate or Self-experience proof
application_steps: Apply online on e-Kutir portal (esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in)
Choose vocational trade kit
District Social Welfare Officer verification and physical toolkit distribution at Taluka level

name: Kisan Suryodaya Yojana (Daytime Agricultural Power Gujarat)
name_hi: किसान सूर्योदय योजना (गुजरात दिन में बिजली)
description: Supplies 8 hours of reliable, high-voltage daytime power (between 5 AM to 9 PM) to farmers for agricultural tubewell irrigation, eliminating the hazards of nighttime farming.
description_hi: गुजरात के किसानों को रात्रि के समय जंगली जानवरों और दुर्घटनाओं के जोखिम से बचाने हेतु दिन के समय (सुबह 5 से रात 9 बजे) 8 घंटे की अबाधित कृषि बिजली आपूर्ति।
ministry: Energy and Petrochemicals Department, Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: All agricultural electricity consumers and farmers possessing farm pump connections in Gujarat
benefits: 8 hours guaranteed daytime agricultural electricity supply
Prevents night-time snakebites and wild animal attacks during irrigation
Enhanced irrigation efficiency and crop yield
application_steps: Automatic rollout village by village through GUVNL and local DISCOMs (DGVCL, MGVCL, PGVCL, UGVCL)
No individual application fee

name: Mukhyamantri Nishchay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Yojana (MNSSBY Bihar)
name_hi: मुख्यमंत्री निश्चय स्वयं सहायता भत्ता योजना (बिहार)
description: Monthly allowance of ₹1,000 for up to 2 years provided to unemployed 12th pass youth aged 20-25 years in Bihar to support their job search and competitive preparation.
description_hi: बिहार के 12वीं पास 20 से 25 वर्ष के बेरोजगार युवाओं को रोजगार की तलाश एवं तैयारी हेतु ₹1,000 प्रतिमाह का स्वयं सहायता भत्ता (2 वर्षों तक)।
ministry: Planning and Development Department, Bihar
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 20-25 domiciled in Bihar who have passed Class 12 and not enrolled in regular higher education
benefits: Monthly financial stipend of ₹1,000 for up to 24 months (total ₹24,000) directly into bank account
Mandatory free training in Basic Computer Skills, Communication, and Soft Skills through Kushal Yuva Program (KYP)
documents: Self-declaration of not being employed or studying in regular college
application_steps: Apply online on 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in
Visit District Registration and Counseling Centre (DRCC) with original documents
Monthly credit via DBT

name: Bihar Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (PMS Bihar - SC/ST/BC/EBC)
description: Dedicated state portal scheme providing 100% course fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances for SC, ST, BC, and EBC students in post-matric institutions.
description_hi: बिहार के अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति, पिछड़ा वर्ग एवं अत्यंत पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों हेतु दशमोत्तर कक्षाओं में सम्पूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Education Department, Bihar
target_beneficiaries: SC, ST, BC, and EBC students domiciled in Bihar pursuing Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation, and Post-graduation with family income up to ₹3 Lakh
benefits: Complete reimbursement of non-refundable tuition and institutional fees
Maintenance stipend directly credited into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
application_steps: Register on pmsonline.bih.nic.in portal
Institution verifies student enrollment and fee structure
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Krishak Bandhu (Natun) Scheme (West Bengal)
description: Assured agricultural financial assistance up to ₹10,000 per year per acre in two installments (Kharif and Rabi) along with ₹2,00,000 accidental death insurance for farmers aged 18-60.
description_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल के किसानों को ₹10,000 प्रति एकड़ प्रति वर्ष की सुनिश्चित वित्तीय सहायता तथा किसान की आकस्मिक मृत्यु पर परिवार को ₹2,00,000 का निःशुल्क बीमा।
ministry: Department of Agriculture, West Bengal
target_beneficiaries: All farmers and registered bargadars (sharecroppers) possessing cultivable land in West Bengal
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year (₹5,000 in Kharif + ₹5,000 in Rabi) for land of 1 acre or more; pro-rata minimum of ₹4,000/year for small/marginal holdings
₹2,00,000 death benefit paid to nominee in case of farmer's death between age 18-60
application_steps: Submit application at local Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) office or Duare Sarkar camps
Krishak Bandhu Smart Card issued
Direct bank credit per season

name: West Bengal Student Credit Card Scheme (WBSCC)
name_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल स्टूडेंट क्रेडिट कार्ड योजना
description: Collateral-free soft education loan up to ₹10,00,000 with nominal simple interest of 4% backed by 100% guarantee from West Bengal Government for pursuing higher studies in India or abroad.
description_hi: कक्षा 10वीं पास विद्यार्थियों को भारत या विदेश में उच्च शिक्षा (डिग्री, मेडिकल, इंजीनियरिंग) हेतु राज्य सरकार की गारंटी पर ₹10 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण मात्र 4% साधारण ब्याज पर।
ministry: Higher Education Department, West Bengal
target_beneficiaries: Students who have resided in West Bengal for at least 10 years aged up to 40 years admitted to higher education or competitive coaching institutes
benefits: Collateral-free education loan up to ₹10 Lakhs with 1% interest concession for full repayment during study period
Moratorium period covers course duration plus 1 year; repayment tenure up to 15 years
Covers tuition fees, hostel, laptop, books, and living expenses
documents: Color photograph of student and co-borrower
Proof of 10 years residence in WB
application_steps: Register on wbscc.wb.gov.in portal
Institution head verifies and forwards to Higher Education Department
Department approves and forwards to partner bank for loan sanction and credit card issue

name: Telangana Aasara Pension Scheme
description: Comprehensive social safety pension providing monthly financial support of ₹2,016 for elderly, widows, beedi workers, weavers, and toddy tappers, and ₹4,016 for disabled citizens.
description_hi: तेलंगाना के वृद्धों, विधवाओं, बीड़ी श्रमिकों एवं बुनकरों को ₹2,016 प्रतिमाह तथा दिव्यांगजनों को ₹4,016 प्रतिमाह की सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन।
ministry: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department, Telangana
department: Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty (SERP)
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 57+, widows, AIDS patients, elephantiasis patients, beedi workers, and disabled persons domiciled in Telangana
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹2,016 for elderly, widows, and occupational workers
Enhanced monthly pension of ₹4,016 for persons with benchmark disability
Direct monthly disbursement via biometric authentication at Post Office or Bank
application_steps: Submit application at MeeSeva centre or Gram Panchayat
Mandal Parishad Development Officer (MPDO) / Municipal Commissioner verification
District Collector issues sanction order

name: YSR Cheyutha Scheme (Andhra Pradesh)
description: Financial empowerment program granting ₹75,000 in four equal annual tranches of ₹18,750 to women aged 45-60 years belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority communities to establish sustainable livelihood enterprises.
description_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश की एससी, एसटी, बीसी एवं अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों की 45 से 60 वर्ष की महिलाओं को किराना, डेयरी व पोल्ट्री व्यवसाय हेतु ₹18,750 प्रतिवर्ष (कुल ₹75,000) की सहायता।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Andhra Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Women aged 45-60 belonging to SC, ST, BC, or Minority communities domiciled in AP holding Rice Cards with family income under ₹1.2 Lakh (rural) / ₹1.44 Lakh (urban)
benefits: Annual financial transfer of ₹18,750 for four consecutive years (total ₹75,000)
Partnership with corporate giants (Amul, ITC, P&G, Reliance) providing wholesale supply and technical training for setting up grocery shops, buffalo units, and goat rearing
application_steps: Volunteer surveys and enrolls eligible women through Grama / Ward Sachivalayam mobile app
Social audit published in Sachivalayam notice board
Direct DBT disbursement into woman's bank account

name: Saksham Yuva Scheme (Haryana Skill & Unemployment Allowance)
name_hi: सक्षम युवा योजना (हरियाणा कौशल एवं मानदेय भत्ता)
description: Provides monthly unemployment allowance and honorary assignment wages up to ₹9,000 per month for 100 hours of monthly work to 12th pass, graduate, and post-graduate youth in Haryana.
description_hi: हरियाणा के 12वीं, स्नातक एवं स्नातकोत्तर बेरोजगार युवाओं को ₹1,500 से ₹3,000 मासिक भत्ता तथा 100 घंटे मानद कार्य हेतु ₹6,000 अतिरिक्त मानदेय (कुल ₹9,000/माह)।
ministry: Employment Department, Haryana
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-35 domiciled in Haryana with family income under ₹3 Lakh registered in Parivar Pehchan Patra
benefits: Monthly allowance: ₹900 (10th), ₹1,500 (12th), ₹2,000 (Graduate), ₹3,000 (Postgraduate)
Additional ₹6,000 per month for doing 100 hours of honorary government work (total up to ₹9,000/month)
Free skill upskilling through Haryana Skill Development Mission (HSDM)
documents: Bank Account linked with Family ID
application_steps: Register on hrex.gov.in portal
Apply for Saksham Yuva scheme
Allocation of 100 hours work in government offices and monthly DBT

name: Bhavantar Bharpayee Yojana (Haryana Price Deficit Compensation)
name_hi: भावांतर भरपाई योजना (हरियाणा कृषि मूल्य अंतर भरपाई)
description: Compensates farmers for the price deficit when market prices of notified horticultural crops (potatoes, onions, tomatoes, cauliflower, carrots, peas) fall below the state protected benchmark price.
description_hi: सब्जी एवं बागवानी फसलों के बाजार भाव गिरने पर राज्य सरकार द्वारा तय संरक्षित मूल्य के अंतर की राशि की सीधी भरपाई किसानों के बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Department, Haryana
target_beneficiaries: Farmers growing notified horticulture and vegetable crops in Haryana registered on Meri Fasal Mera Byora portal
benefits: Direct price deficit compensation ranging from ₹500 to ₹1,000 per quintal directly transferred via DBT
Fixed risk protection insulating vegetable farmers from market crashes
documents: Meri Fasal Mera Byora Registration ID
application_steps: Register crop on fasal.haryana.gov.in portal during sowing season
Sell produce in approved APMC mandis
Differential amount calculated and credited directly to bank account

name: Haryana Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (SC / BC)
description: Full tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowances for SC and Backward Classes students pursuing post-matric courses in Haryana colleges.
description_hi: हरियाणा के अनुसूचित जाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों हेतु 11वीं कक्षा से स्नातकोत्तर एवं तकनीकी शिक्षा में सम्पूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Higher Education Department, Haryana
target_beneficiaries: SC and BC students domiciled in Haryana with family income below ₹2.5 Lakh registered in Parivar Pehchan Patra
benefits: 100% reimbursement of non-refundable college and exam fees
Monthly maintenance allowance of up to ₹1,200 per month credited directly via DBT
application_steps: Apply online on Har-Chhatravratti portal (harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in)
College e-verifies data and state department disburses funds

name: Punjab Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Social security pension of ₹1,500 per month provided directly into bank accounts of senior citizens aged 65+ (men) and 58+ (women) in Punjab.
description_hi: पंजाब के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों (पुरुष 65+ वर्ष, महिला 58+ वर्ष) को प्रतिमाह ₹1,500 की नियमित सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन।
ministry: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens residing in Punjab with annual family income not exceeding ₹60,000
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 credited directly into the beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Free medical check-ups in government dispensaries
documents: Age Proof (Voter ID / Aadhaar / Matriculation certificate)
application_steps: Submit application at Sewa Kendra or online via punjab.gov.in portal
Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) / SDM verification
Sanction order issued and monthly DBT started

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar SC Post-Matric Scholarship (Punjab)
name_hi: डॉ. बी.आर. अम्बेडकर एससी पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति (पंजाब)
description: State scholarship providing 100% free education, complete fee waiver, and maintenance stipends for SC students studying in post-matric courses in Punjab.
description_hi: पंजाब के अनुसूचित जाति के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, डिग्री एवं मेडिकल/इंजीनियरिंग में पूर्णतः निःशुल्क शिक्षा एवं मासिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Punjab
department: Directorate of Welfare of SCs & BCs
target_beneficiaries: SC students domiciled in Punjab studying in recognized institutions with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Complete waiver/reimbursement of institutional tuition and non-refundable fees
Free Freeship Card issued to enable college admission without paying upfront fees
Maintenance allowance credited via DBT
application_steps: Apply for Freeship Card on scholarships.punjab.gov.in (Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship Portal)
Take admission using Freeship Card without paying fees
Institute confirms admission online

name: Mukh Mantri Punjab Cancer Rahat Kosh Society (MMCPRK)
description: Provides financial grant up to ₹1,50,000 for cashless cancer treatment (chemotherapy, radiotherapy, cancer surgery) to cancer patients in Punjab across empaneled hospitals.
description_hi: पंजाब के कैंसर मरीजों को पीजीआई, एम्स एवं सूचीबद्ध सरकारी व निजी कैंसर अस्पतालों में उपचार हेतु ₹1,50,000 तक की निःशुल्क वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Department of Health and Family Welfare, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Any cancer patient who is a permanent resident of Punjab (except government employees with medical reimbursement)
benefits: Financial grant of up to ₹1,50,000 per patient disbursed directly to treating hospital (PGIMER, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, AIIMS, GMC)
Free medicines and diagnostics during hospitalization
documents: Biopsy / Histopathology diagnostic report confirming cancer
Treatment estimate from treating cancer hospital
application_steps: Get application filled and signed by treating oncologist in empaneled hospital
Submit to Civil Surgeon office of home district
District committee sanctions assistance and funds released to hospital

name: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Tourism Self-Employment Scheme
name_hi: वीर चंद्र सिंह गढ़वाली पर्यटन स्वरोजगार योजना (उत्तराखंड)
description: Provides 33% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹15 Lakh for non-transport, up to ₹25 Lakh for homestays/eco-resorts) on bank loans to start tourism, hotel, and commercial vehicle businesses in Uttarakhand.
description_hi: उत्तराखंड के युवाओं को होमस्टे, होटल, योग केंद्र, ट्रैकिंग व पर्यटन वाहन क्रय हेतु 33% से 50% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹25 लाख)।
ministry: Tourism Department, Uttarakhand
target_beneficiaries: Permanent residents of Uttarakhand aged 18+ establishing tourism-related enterprises in the state
benefits: Capital investment subsidy: 33% (up to ₹15 Lakhs in plain areas) and 50% (up to ₹25 Lakhs in hilly areas) for homestays, hotels, fast-food outlets, and adventure sports gear
Commercial vehicle subsidy of 25% (up to ₹7.5 Lakhs) for tourist taxis and buses
documents: Uttarakhand Domicile / Sthaniya Niwas Praman Patra
Land Revenue Documents (Khatauni) for construction projects
application_steps: Apply online on vcsg.uk.gov.in portal
Interview and screening by District Tourism Development Committee chaired by District Magistrate
Sanction letter issued and subsidy released to bank

name: Uttarakhand Vridhavastha Pension Yojana (Old Age Pension)
description: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 provided by Uttarakhand Government to senior citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income families in hill and plain districts.
description_hi: उत्तराखंड के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वृद्धजनों को प्रतिमाह ₹1,500 की नियमित सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Uttarakhand
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60+ domiciled in Uttarakhand whose family monthly income does not exceed ₹4,000 (BPL limit)
benefits: Monthly pension allowance of ₹1,500 directly transferred into beneficiary's bank account via PFMS DBT
application_steps: Apply online on ssp.uk.gov.in portal or through Gram Panchayat / Municipal office
Verification by Village Development Officer (VDO)
District Social Welfare Officer sanctions pension

name: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi (Himachal Pradesh)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी प्यारी बहना सुख सम्मान निधि (हिमाचल प्रदेश)
description: Monthly direct benefit transfer of ₹1,500 (₹18,000 annually) provided to all eligible adult women aged 18 to 59 years in Himachal Pradesh to ensure financial security.
description_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश की 18 से 59 वर्ष की पात्र महिलाओं को प्रतिमाह ₹1,500 (वार्षिक ₹18,000) की प्रत्यक्ष नकद सम्मान राशि।
ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Himachal Pradesh
department: Directorate of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Women aged 18-59 domiciled in Himachal Pradesh whose family members are not in regular government service or paying income tax
benefits: Monthly financial allowance of ₹1,500 credited directly into the woman's bank account via DBT
Universal cover for non-government households
application_steps: Submit application at local Tehsil Welfare Office or Gram Panchayat
Scrutiny by Tehsil Welfare Officer (TWO)
Direct monthly bank credit

name: HP Sahara Yojana (Financial Assistance for Critical Illness Patients)
name_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश सहारा योजना (गंभीर बीमारी मरीज आर्थिक सहायता)
description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 provided to economically weaker patients suffering from chronic debilitating diseases (Parkinson's, malignant cancer, kidney failure, muscular dystrophy, paralysis).
description_hi: कैंसर, किडनी फेलियर, पक्षाघात (पैरालिसिस), पार्किंसंस जैसी गंभीर बीमारियों से पीड़ित निर्धन मरीजों को दवाओं एवं तीमारदार हेतु ₹3,000 प्रतिमाह की सहायता।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Himachal Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in HP suffering from specified chronic illnesses with annual family income up to ₹4 Lakh
benefits: Monthly financial sustenance allowance of ₹3,000 credited directly into patient's or caregiver's bank account via DBT
Free medicines from hospital
documents: Medical Certificate from specialist of medical college / zonal hospital
application_steps: Submit application through local ASHA worker or at nearest Block Medical Officer (BMO) office
Chief Medical Officer (CMO) approves and initiates monthly DBT

name: Shakti Scheme (Free Bus Travel for Women in Karnataka)
name_hi: शक्ति योजना (कर्नाटक महिलाओं हेतु निःशुल्क बस यात्रा)
description: Provides completely free bus travel for all domicile women, girls, and transgender persons across all state government road transport corporations (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC) in Karnataka.
description_hi: कर्नाटक की सभी महिलाओं, छात्राओं एवं ट्रांसजेंडर नागरिकों को राज्य की सभी सरकारी बसों (KSRTC, BMTC) में निःशुल्क यात्रा की सुविधा।
ministry: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: All female and transgender citizens domiciled in Karnataka irrespective of income
benefits: 100% free travel in ordinary, express, and city buses within Karnataka (up to 20 km inside border states)
Significant monthly savings on commute expenses for working women and students
documents: Any Government issued photo ID proving Karnataka residence (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Driving License)
application_steps: Show valid Karnataka residence ID to bus conductor and receive zero-fare ticket immediately

name: Gruha Jyothi Scheme (Up to 200 Units Free Electricity Karnataka)
name_hi: गृह ज्योति योजना (कर्नाटक 200 यूनिट तक निःशुल्क बिजली)
description: Provides up to 200 units of free electricity every month to all residential domestic households in Karnataka based on their average annual consumption plus 10%.
description_hi: कर्नाटक के सभी घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को उनके औसत मासिक उपभोग के आधार पर प्रतिमाह 200 यूनिट तक निःशुल्क घरेलू बिजली।
ministry: Energy Department, Karnataka
department: Karnataka Electricity Supply Companies (BESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, MESCOM, CHESCOM)
target_beneficiaries: All residential domestic household consumers having individual electricity meter connections in Karnataka
benefits: Zero electricity bill for households consuming within their entitled limit (up to 200 units/month)
Significant monthly household savings of ₹1,000 to ₹1,600
documents: Electricity Account ID / Consumer Connection Number
application_steps: Apply online on Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in)
Link Aadhaar with electricity consumer account
Zero electricity bills generated automatically from subsequent billing cycle

name: Naan Mudhalvan Scheme (Tamil Nadu Upskilling & Career Guidance)
name_hi: नान मुधलवन योजना (तमिलनाडु युवा कौशल एवं करियर संवर्धन)
description: Massive youth empowerment platform delivering dynamic industry-aligned skill training in coding, data analytics, artificial intelligence, electric vehicles, and foreign languages to 10 lakh college students annually.
description_hi: तमिलनाडु के 10 लाख कॉलेज छात्रों को एआई, डेटा साइंस, क्लाउड कंप्यूटिंग एवं रोबोटिक्स में निःशुल्क आधुनिक तकनीकी प्रशिक्षण तथा रोजगार के अवसर।
ministry: Special Programme Implementation & Higher Education Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Students enrolled in government and aided Arts, Science, Engineering, and Polytechnic colleges in Tamil Nadu
benefits: Free integrated curriculum training courses created by tech giants (Microsoft, IBM, Cambridge, Infosys)
Free access to industry certification vouchers
Mega job placement drives and internships across 500+ multinational companies
documents: College Student Roll Number / ID Card
application_steps: Log in through college portal at naanmudhalvan.tn.gov.in
Choose elective skill training tracks
Attend curriculum integrated sessions and placement interviews

name: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
description: Fixed deposit scheme of ₹50,000 for single girl child (₹25,000 each for two girl children) with monthly interest payout and high maturity grant at age 18 to promote family planning and girl child education.
description_hi: केवल एक बेटी होने पर ₹50,000 तथा दो बेटियां होने पर ₹25,000 प्रति बेटी का सरकारी फिक्स्ड डिपॉजिट जो 18 वर्ष आयु पर ब्याज सहित उच्च शिक्षा हेतु प्राप्त होता है।
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Families in Tamil Nadu with only one or two girl children and no male child, where either parent has undergone sterilization before age 35 with family income up to ₹72,000
benefits: State Government deposits ₹50,000 in Tamil Nadu Power Finance Corporation for single girl (or ₹25,000 each for two girls)
Annual incentive payment of ₹1,800 to girl from age 6 to 18 for educational expenses
Full accumulated maturity proceeds paid to girl at age 18 for college studies
application_steps: Submit application to District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) before child turns 3 years of age
Verification of certificates and deposit receipt issued

name: Dalit Bandhu Scheme (Telangana Direct Capital Grant)
name_hi: दलित बंधु योजना (तेलंगाना ₹10 लाख प्रत्यक्ष पूंजी अनुदान)
description: Revolutionary direct capital transfer scheme providing a one-time grant of ₹10,00,000 with 100% subsidy (no bank loan or repayment required) to Dalit (SC) families to start profitable enterprises.
description_hi: तेलंगाना के दलित (एससी) परिवारों को अपना व्यवसाय, विनिर्माण, डेयरी, वाहन अथवा सेवा उद्यम शुरू करने हेतु ₹10 लाख का 100% गैर-वापसी योग्य सरकारी पूंजी अनुदान।
ministry: Scheduled Castes Development Department, Telangana
department: Telangana Scheduled Castes Co-operative Development Corporation (TSCCDC)
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste (SC) families domiciled in Telangana seeking financial self-reliance through independent business ventures
benefits: Direct one-time grant of ₹10,00,000 per family deposited into a dedicated Dalit Bandhu bank account
100% grant: No bank loan, no collateral, no margin money, and zero repayment burden
Beneficiary chooses enterprise: Transport (taxis, JCBs, tractors), manufacturing, dairy units, retail supermarkets, or medical clinics
documents: SC Caste Certificate verified via MeeSeva
Special Dalit Bandhu Bank Account details
application_steps: Selection through District Collector and Gram Sabha / Ward committee
Beneficiary attends enterprise counseling and selects business activity
Immediate release of ₹10 Lakhs directly for asset procurement

name: Rythu Bima Scheme (Telangana Farmers Group Life Insurance)
name_hi: रायथू बीमा योजना (तेलंगाना किसान समूह जीवन बीमा)
description: Completely free group life insurance scheme providing ₹5,00,000 financial compensation to the bereaved family within 10 days upon the death of a registered farmer aged 18-59 years.
description_hi: 18 से 59 वर्ष के किसान की किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु होने पर परिवार/नामिती को ₹5,00,000 की त्वरित बीमा राशि (100% प्रीमियम तेलंगाना सरकार द्वारा देय)।
ministry: Agriculture Department, Telangana
department: Directorate of Agriculture / LIC of India
target_beneficiaries: All pattadar farmers aged 18-59 holding title deeds and registered under Rythu Bandhu in Telangana
benefits: ₹5,00,000 life insurance claim paid to nominee directly into bank account via DBT within 10 days of death
100% premium paid entirely by Telangana Government to Life Insurance Corporation (LIC)
Covers death due to any cause (natural, accidental, illness)
documents: Aadhaar Card of farmer and nominee
application_steps: Automatic enrollment upon land registration in Dharani portal
In case of farmer's demise, Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) collects claim documents from home
Claim processed and ₹5 Lakh credited into nominee's account within 10 working days

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa - PM KISAN (Andhra Pradesh)
name_hi: वाईएसआर रायथू भरोसा (आंध्र प्रदेश किसान निवेश सहायता)
description: Financial assistance of ₹13,500 per year per farmer family (including ₹6,000 Central PM-KISAN and ₹7,500 State share) including tenant farmers (CCRC holders) and ROFR tribal farmers.
description_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश के सभी भू-स्वामी एवं काश्तकार (कौलू) किसानों को खेती की लागत हेतु प्रति वर्ष ₹13,500 की नकद वित्तीय सहायता (तीन किस्तों में)।
ministry: Agriculture & Marketing Department, Andhra Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Farmer families including landholders, tenant farmers belonging to SC, ST, BC, Minorities holding Crop Cultivator Rights Cards (CCRC), and ROFR landholders in AP
benefits: Annual financial transfer of ₹13,500: ₹7,500 in May (Kharif sowing); ₹4,000 in October (Rabi sowing); ₹2,000 in January (harvest season)
Full coverage extended to tenant farmers without land ownership
documents: Webland Land Title Records / CCRC Tenant Farmer Agreement
application_steps: Village Agriculture Assistant (VAA) at Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK) verifies land and crop data
Social audit list displayed at RBK
Direct DBT payment

name: YSR Pension Kanuka (Doorstep Social Security Pension)
name_hi: वाईएसआर पेंशन कनुका (घर-द्वार सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन)
description: Monthly social security pension of ₹3,000 (up to ₹6,000 to ₹15,000 for disabled/dialysis patients) delivered directly in cash at the beneficiary's doorstep by village volunteers on the 1st of every month.
description_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश के वृद्धजनों, विधवाओं, बुनकरों, ताड़ी निकालने वालों को ₹3,000 प्रतिमाह तथा गंभीर दिव्यांगों व डायलिसिस मरीजों को ₹6,000 से ₹10,000 प्रतिमाह घर बैठे नकद पेंशन।
ministry: Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Department, Andhra Pradesh
department: Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty (SERP)
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60+, widows, single women, weavers, fishermen, and disabled citizens living in BPL households in AP
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹3,000 for Old Age, Widow, Weavers, Toddy Tappers, and Single Women
Monthly pension of ₹6,000 for Persons with Severe Disability; ₹10,000 for Chronic Kidney Disease patients on dialysis
Delivered directly at home at 6:00 AM on the 1st of every month via biometric authentication
application_steps: Apply at Grama / Ward Sachivalayam
Welfare and Education Assistant (WEA) verifies documents and eligibility
Pension sanction card delivered to doorstep

name: MEDISEP (Medical Insurance for State Employees and Pensioners Kerala)
name_hi: मेडिसेप (केरल सरकारी कर्मचारी एवं पेंशनभोगी स्वास्थ्य बीमा)
description: Comprehensive cashless health insurance providing ₹3,00,000 basic coverage per year (plus catastrophic pool) across 1,920 medical procedures for employees and pensioners in Kerala.
description_hi: केरल के सरकारी कर्मचारियों एवं पेंशनभोगियों को प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹3 लाख (तथा गंभीर बीमारियों हेतु अतिरिक्त ₹35 करोड़ कॉर्पस) का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
ministry: Finance Department, Government of Kerala
target_beneficiaries: All serving state government employees, pensioners, family pensioners, and their eligible dependents in Kerala
benefits: Cashless hospital coverage of ₹3,00,000 per block period of 3 years (up to ₹1.5 Lakhs per year floater)
Special catastrophic illness fund providing up to ₹18 Lakhs for heart/liver/kidney transplants and neurosurgeries
Covers 1,920 medical/surgical procedures at empaneled hospitals
documents: MEDISEP ID Card / PPO Number / Employee PEN Number
application_steps: Automatic enrollment through SPARK / Treasury payroll system
Download MEDISEP e-card from medisep.kerala.gov.in
Present card for cashless hospitalization

name: Vidyakiranam Scheme (Educational Assistance for Children of Disabled Parents)
name_hi: विद्याकिरणम योजना (दिव्यांग माता-पिता के बच्चों हेतु छात्रवृत्ति)
description: Provides annual educational scholarships from Class 1 to Post-graduation for children of differently-abled parents (disability of 40% or more) to ensure uninterrupted education.
description_hi: 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले माता-पिता के बच्चों को पहली कक्षा से लेकर स्नातकोत्तर एवं मेडिकल/इंजीनियरिंग तक ₹3,500 से ₹35,000 की वार्षिक शैक्षणिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Social Justice Department, Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Children of parents with benchmark disability of 40% or more who belong to BPL families in Kerala
benefits: Annual educational assistance: ₹3,500 for Class 1-5; ₹5,000 for Class 6-10; ₹7,500 for Higher Secondary (+1/+2); ₹10,000 for Degree; up to ₹35,000 for Professional/PG courses
Credited directly via DBT into student's bank account
documents: Parents' Disability Certificate / UDID Card (≥40% disability)
application_steps: Apply online on SUNEETHI portal (suneethi.sjd.kerala.gov.in)
Institution head verifies student attendance
District Social Justice Officer (DSJO) approves and releases payment

name: Uttar Pradesh Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
name_hi: Uttar Pradesh निराश्रित विधवा पेंशन योजना
description: State welfare pension providing regular monthly financial subsistence directly to destitute and low-income widows domiciled in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh की निराश्रित एवं निर्धन विधवा महिलाओं को सम्मानजनक जीवन एवं आर्थिक संबल हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 18 and above domiciled in Uttar Pradesh living in low-income or BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Health assistance and social security coverage under state welfare programs
application_steps: Apply online through Uttar Pradesh e-District portal (https://sspy-up.gov.in/) or at local Block/Tehsil office
Verification by local revenue authority and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Uttar Pradesh Divyangjan Disability Pension Scheme
description: Provides monthly financial disability pension directly to persons with benchmark disability of 40% or more domiciled in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability domiciled in Uttar Pradesh with family income below state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly disability pension directly credited via DBT to bank account
Concessional public bus travel passes within state borders
Priority in free distribution of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and hearing aids
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board (≥40%)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://sspy-up.gov.in/ or through District Social Welfare Office
Verification of medical certificate and domicile
Monthly DBT release

name: Uttar Pradesh Agricultural Mechanization and Equipment Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: Uttar Pradesh कृषि यंत्रीकरण एवं कृषि उपकरण अनुदान योजना
description: Provides 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved modern farm machinery (tractors, power rotavators, seed drills, sprayers, threshers) for farmers in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh के किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, सीड ड्रिल एवं कृषि ड्रोन क्रय करने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers holding agricultural land in Uttar Pradesh
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural implements from empanelled dealers
Enhanced subsidy quota for SC, ST, and women farmers
Reduces farm labor shortage and boosts crop productivity
application_steps: Register on Uttar Pradesh Agriculture portal (http://upagriculture.com/)
Select machinery and authorized dealer
Lottery token generation, purchase equipment, and receive subsidy after field geo-tagging

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment)
name_hi: Uttar Pradesh मुख्यमंत्री युवा स्वरोजगार योजना
description: Credit-linked enterprise loan subsidy scheme facilitating bank loans up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹10 Lakhs in services with 15% to 25% margin money subsidy for youth in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग अथवा सेवा प्रतिष्ठान स्थापित करने हेतु बैंक ऋण एवं 25% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: Directorate of Industries, MSME Department, Uttar Pradesh
department: Directorate of Industries, MSME Department, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-40 residing in Uttar Pradesh setting up new micro-enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25 Lakh) for projects up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing
Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹2.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹10 Lakhs in service sector
Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDP) sponsored by state government
application_steps: Apply online through http://diupmsme.upsdc.gov.in/
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview and recommendation to bank
Bank loan sanction and subsidy credited into escrow account
