name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana (Rural / Urban Housing)
description: Provides financial grant of up to ₹1,30,000 for constructing disaster-resilient pucca houses for poor families in Uttar Pradesh who were left out of Central PMAY lists.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले निर्धन परिवारों (जो पीएम आवास से छूटे हों) को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.30 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Poor families living in kutcha houses in Uttar Pradesh belonging to SC, ST, Musahar, Vanya, leprosy-affected, or disabled categories
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 paid in 3 milestone installments directly into bank account
Additional 90 days unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG under Ujjwala
application_steps: Beneficiaries verified through Gram Sabha / Urban Local Body survey
Administrative sanction by District Magistrate / BDO
Stage-wise geo-tagged release of funds into beneficiary's bank account

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Kanyadan / Vivah Sahayata Yojana
name_hi: Uttar Pradesh मुख्यमंत्री कन्यादान / विवाह सहायता योजना
description: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 provided by Uttar Pradesh Government to poor parents for the marriage of their daughters aged 18 or above.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh के गरीब, श्रमिक एवं बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹31,000 से ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
department: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: BPL, labor card holders, and low-income families domiciled in Uttar Pradesh marrying daughters aged 18+ years
benefits: One-time cash grant credited directly into bride's bank account via DBT
Substantial relief from indebtedness caused by marriage expenses
documents: Bride's Age Proof (Aadhaar / Class 10 certificate proving age ≥18)
application_steps: Apply online via https://womenchild.up.gov.in/ or at local Block Development Office
Verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct payment into bride's bank account

name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes & Minorities
name_hi: Uttar Pradesh दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: State scholarship program providing full or partial tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances to OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh के पिछड़े एवं वंचित वर्ग के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh
department: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Uttar Pradesh pursuing post-matric courses with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Reimbursement of mandatory institutional tuition fees as fixed by the State Fee Committee
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Special book and thesis grants for professional and technical degree students
application_steps: Apply online on Uttar Pradesh Scholarship Portal (https://scholarship.up.gov.in/)
College nodal officer verifies academic records and fee demand online
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Uttar Pradesh Vridhavastha Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 provided by Uttar Pradesh Government to elderly citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income households.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु नियमित मासिक पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above residing in Uttar Pradesh living below the state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into the elderly citizen's bank account via DBT
Free geriatric health check-ups and diagnostic support at government health facilities
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age ≥60)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://sspy-up.gov.in/ or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Ward Office
Field verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Kosh (Medical Relief Fund)
name_hi: Uttar Pradesh मुख्यमंत्री चिकित्सा सहायता कोष
description: Discretionary emergency financial grant providing up to ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 for critical surgeries and medical treatment for patients belonging to BPL/low-income families in Uttar Pradesh.
description_hi: Uttar Pradesh के निर्धन मरीजों को हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, न्यूरोसर्जरी एवं किडनी डायलिसिस/प्रत्यारोपण हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी आपातकालीन चिकित्सा अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
department: Directorate of Medical and Health Services
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Uttar Pradesh suffering from major life-threatening diseases with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹5,00,000 for organ transplants) paid directly to the empaneled treating hospital
Immediate relief for major cardiac, renal, neurological, and oncology surgeries
documents: Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/yr) or BPL Ration Card
Medical Estimate and Diagnostic Report from Government Specialist
application_steps: Get treatment estimate signed by Medical Superintendent of empaneled hospital
Submit application to District Magistrate (DM) / Chief Minister's Relief Cell
Sanction issued and funds transferred directly to hospital account

description_hi: Rajasthan के निर्धन मरीजों को हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, न्यूरोसर्जरी एवं किडनी डायलिसिस/प्रत्यारोपण हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी आपातकालीन चिकित्सा अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Rajasthan
department: Directorate of Medical and Health Services
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Rajasthan suffering from major life-threatening diseases with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹5,00,000 for organ transplants) paid directly to the empaneled treating hospital
Immediate relief for major cardiac, renal, neurological, and oncology surgeries
documents: Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/yr) or BPL Ration Card
Medical Estimate and Diagnostic Report from Government Specialist
application_steps: Get treatment estimate signed by Medical Superintendent of empaneled hospital
Submit application to District Magistrate (DM) / Chief Minister's Relief Cell
Sanction issued and funds transferred directly to hospital account

name: Rajasthan Youth Apprenticeship and Skill Promotion Scheme
name_hi: Rajasthan युवा कौशल विकास एवं शिक्षुता संवर्धन योजना
description: State skill apprenticeship initiative providing industry-aligned practical training and monthly stipends of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 for youth in Rajasthan.
description_hi: Rajasthan के 10वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई एवं डिप्लोमा धारक युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक ऑन-द-जॉब प्रशिक्षण तथा मासिक सरकारी वजीफा।
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-30 domiciled in Rajasthan seeking technical apprenticeships
benefits: Monthly apprenticeship stipend of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 (with 50% state DBT subsidy contribution)
State Skill Mission certification and direct hiring opportunities in industrial estates
application_steps: Register on Rajasthan Employment / Skill portal
Apply to local industrial apprenticeship slots
Contract signing and monthly stipend disbursement

name: Rajasthan Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST & OBC Students
description: Financial scholarship providing ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 per year to underprivileged SC, ST, and OBC students in Class 9 and 10 in Rajasthan to curb dropouts before matriculation.
description_hi: Rajasthan के कक्षा 9वीं और 10वीं में अध्ययनरत अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाई जारी रखने हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Rajasthan
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Students in Class 9 and 10 domiciled in Rajasthan with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 credited directly into student's bank account via DBT
Additional ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000 per year for day scholars and hostellers for books and stationery
application_steps: Apply online on Rajasthan Scholarship Portal (https://sjmsnew.rajasthan.gov.in/) or via school headmaster
School head verifies and submits master list
Direct DBT disbursement to student's account

name: Madhya Pradesh Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
name_hi: Madhya Pradesh निराश्रित विधवा पेंशन योजना
description: State welfare pension providing regular monthly financial subsistence directly to destitute and low-income widows domiciled in Madhya Pradesh.
description_hi: Madhya Pradesh की निराश्रित एवं निर्धन विधवा महिलाओं को सम्मानजनक जीवन एवं आर्थिक संबल हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
department: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 18 and above domiciled in Madhya Pradesh living in low-income or BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Health assistance and social security coverage under state welfare programs
application_steps: Apply online through Madhya Pradesh e-District portal (https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in/) or at local Block/Tehsil office
Verification by local revenue authority and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Madhya Pradesh Divyangjan Disability Pension Scheme
description: Provides monthly financial disability pension directly to persons with benchmark disability of 40% or more domiciled in Madhya Pradesh.
description_hi: Madhya Pradesh के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
department: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability domiciled in Madhya Pradesh with family income below state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly disability pension directly credited via DBT to bank account
Concessional public bus travel passes within state borders
Priority in free distribution of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and hearing aids
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board (≥40%)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in/ or through District Social Welfare Office
Verification of medical certificate and domicile
Monthly DBT release

name: Madhya Pradesh Agricultural Mechanization and Equipment Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: Madhya Pradesh कृषि यंत्रीकरण एवं कृषि उपकरण अनुदान योजना
description: Provides 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved modern farm machinery (tractors, power rotavators, seed drills, sprayers, threshers) for farmers in Madhya Pradesh.
description_hi: Madhya Pradesh के किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, सीड ड्रिल एवं कृषि ड्रोन क्रय करने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, MP
department: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, MP
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers holding agricultural land in Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural implements from empanelled dealers
Enhanced subsidy quota for SC, ST, and women farmers
Reduces farm labor shortage and boosts crop productivity
application_steps: Register on Madhya Pradesh Agriculture portal (http://mpkrishi.mp.gov.in/)
Select machinery and authorized dealer
Lottery token generation, purchase equipment, and receive subsidy after field geo-tagging

name: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment)
name_hi: Madhya Pradesh मुख्यमंत्री युवा स्वरोजगार योजना
description: Credit-linked enterprise loan subsidy scheme facilitating bank loans up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹10 Lakhs in services with 15% to 25% margin money subsidy for youth in Madhya Pradesh.
description_hi: Madhya Pradesh के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग अथवा सेवा प्रतिष्ठान स्थापित करने हेतु बैंक ऋण एवं 25% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, MP
department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, MP
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-40 residing in Madhya Pradesh setting up new micro-enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25 Lakh) for projects up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing
Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹2.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹10 Lakhs in service sector
Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDP) sponsored by state government
application_steps: Apply online through https://msme.mponline.gov.in/
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview and recommendation to bank
Bank loan sanction and subsidy credited into escrow account

name: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana (Rural / Urban Housing)
description: Provides financial grant of up to ₹1,30,000 for constructing disaster-resilient pucca houses for poor families in Madhya Pradesh who were left out of Central PMAY lists.
description_hi: Madhya Pradesh के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले निर्धन परिवारों (जो पीएम आवास से छूटे हों) को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.30 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Poor families living in kutcha houses in Madhya Pradesh belonging to SC, ST, Musahar, Vanya, leprosy-affected, or disabled categories
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 paid in 3 milestone installments directly into bank account
Additional 90 days unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG under Ujjwala
application_steps: Beneficiaries verified through Gram Sabha / Urban Local Body survey
Administrative sanction by District Magistrate / BDO
Stage-wise geo-tagged release of funds into beneficiary's bank account

name: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Kanyadan / Vivah Sahayata Yojana
name_hi: Madhya Pradesh मुख्यमंत्री कन्यादान / विवाह सहायता योजना
description: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 provided by Madhya Pradesh Government to poor parents for the marriage of their daughters aged 18 or above.
description_hi: Madhya Pradesh के गरीब, श्रमिक एवं बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹31,000 से ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Directorate of Women and Child Development, MP
department: Directorate of Women and Child Development, MP
target_beneficiaries: BPL, labor card holders, and low-income families domiciled in Madhya Pradesh marrying daughters aged 18+ years
benefits: One-time cash grant credited directly into bride's bank account via DBT
Substantial relief from indebtedness caused by marriage expenses
documents: Bride's Age Proof (Aadhaar / Class 10 certificate proving age ≥18)
application_steps: Apply online via https://mpwcdmis.gov.in/ or at local Block Development Office
Verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct payment into bride's bank account

name: Madhya Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes & Minorities
name_hi: Madhya Pradesh दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: State scholarship program providing full or partial tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances to OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Madhya Pradesh.
description_hi: Madhya Pradesh के पिछड़े एवं वंचित वर्ग के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Higher Education Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Madhya Pradesh pursuing post-matric courses with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Reimbursement of mandatory institutional tuition fees as fixed by the State Fee Committee
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Special book and thesis grants for professional and technical degree students
application_steps: Apply online on Madhya Pradesh Scholarship Portal (http://scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in/)
College nodal officer verifies academic records and fee demand online
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Madhya Pradesh Vridhavastha Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 provided by Madhya Pradesh Government to elderly citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income households.
description_hi: Madhya Pradesh के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु नियमित मासिक पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
department: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above residing in Madhya Pradesh living below the state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into the elderly citizen's bank account via DBT
Free geriatric health check-ups and diagnostic support at government health facilities
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age ≥60)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in/ or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Ward Office
Field verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

description_hi: Gujarat के गरीब, श्रमिक एवं बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹31,000 से ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat
department: Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: BPL, labor card holders, and low-income families domiciled in Gujarat marrying daughters aged 18+ years
benefits: One-time cash grant credited directly into bride's bank account via DBT
Substantial relief from indebtedness caused by marriage expenses
documents: Bride's Age Proof (Aadhaar / Class 10 certificate proving age ≥18)
application_steps: Apply online via https://wcd.gujarat.gov.in/ or at local Block Development Office
Verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct payment into bride's bank account

name: Gujarat Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes & Minorities
name_hi: Gujarat दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: State scholarship program providing full or partial tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances to OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Gujarat.
description_hi: Gujarat के पिछड़े एवं वंचित वर्ग के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Education Department, Government of Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Gujarat pursuing post-matric courses with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Reimbursement of mandatory institutional tuition fees as fixed by the State Fee Committee
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Special book and thesis grants for professional and technical degree students
application_steps: Apply online on Gujarat Scholarship Portal (https://digitalgujarat.gov.in/)
College nodal officer verifies academic records and fee demand online
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Gujarat Vridhavastha Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 provided by Gujarat Government to elderly citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income households.
description_hi: Gujarat के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु नियमित मासिक पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above residing in Gujarat living below the state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into the elderly citizen's bank account via DBT
Free geriatric health check-ups and diagnostic support at government health facilities
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age ≥60)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://sje.gujarat.gov.in/ or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Ward Office
Field verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Gujarat Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Kosh (Medical Relief Fund)
description: Discretionary emergency financial grant providing up to ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 for critical surgeries and medical treatment for patients belonging to BPL/low-income families in Gujarat.
description_hi: Gujarat के निर्धन मरीजों को हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, न्यूरोसर्जरी एवं किडनी डायलिसिस/प्रत्यारोपण हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी आपातकालीन चिकित्सा अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat
department: Directorate of Medical and Health Services
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Gujarat suffering from major life-threatening diseases with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹5,00,000 for organ transplants) paid directly to the empaneled treating hospital
Immediate relief for major cardiac, renal, neurological, and oncology surgeries
documents: Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/yr) or BPL Ration Card
Medical Estimate and Diagnostic Report from Government Specialist
application_steps: Get treatment estimate signed by Medical Superintendent of empaneled hospital
Submit application to District Magistrate (DM) / Chief Minister's Relief Cell
Sanction issued and funds transferred directly to hospital account

name: Gujarat Youth Apprenticeship and Skill Promotion Scheme
name_hi: Gujarat युवा कौशल विकास एवं शिक्षुता संवर्धन योजना
description: State skill apprenticeship initiative providing industry-aligned practical training and monthly stipends of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 for youth in Gujarat.
description_hi: Gujarat के 10वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई एवं डिप्लोमा धारक युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक ऑन-द-जॉब प्रशिक्षण तथा मासिक सरकारी वजीफा।
ministry: Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-30 domiciled in Gujarat seeking technical apprenticeships
benefits: Monthly apprenticeship stipend of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 (with 50% state DBT subsidy contribution)
State Skill Mission certification and direct hiring opportunities in industrial estates
application_steps: Register on Gujarat Employment / Skill portal
Apply to local industrial apprenticeship slots
Contract signing and monthly stipend disbursement

name: Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST & OBC Students
description: Financial scholarship providing ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 per year to underprivileged SC, ST, and OBC students in Class 9 and 10 in Gujarat to curb dropouts before matriculation.
description_hi: Gujarat के कक्षा 9वीं और 10वीं में अध्ययनरत अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाई जारी रखने हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Education Department, Government of Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Students in Class 9 and 10 domiciled in Gujarat with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 credited directly into student's bank account via DBT
Additional ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000 per year for day scholars and hostellers for books and stationery
application_steps: Apply online on Gujarat Scholarship Portal (https://digitalgujarat.gov.in/) or via school headmaster
School head verifies and submits master list
Direct DBT disbursement to student's account

name: Karnataka Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
description: State welfare pension providing regular monthly financial subsistence directly to destitute and low-income widows domiciled in Karnataka.
description_hi: Karnataka की निराश्रित एवं निर्धन विधवा महिलाओं को सम्मानजनक जीवन एवं आर्थिक संबल हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 18 and above domiciled in Karnataka living in low-income or BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Health assistance and social security coverage under state welfare programs
application_steps: Apply online through Karnataka e-District portal (https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/) or at local Block/Tehsil office
Verification by local revenue authority and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Karnataka Divyangjan Disability Pension Scheme
description: Provides monthly financial disability pension directly to persons with benchmark disability of 40% or more domiciled in Karnataka.
description_hi: Karnataka के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability domiciled in Karnataka with family income below state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly disability pension directly credited via DBT to bank account
Concessional public bus travel passes within state borders
Priority in free distribution of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and hearing aids
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board (≥40%)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/ or through District Social Welfare Office
Verification of medical certificate and domicile
Monthly DBT release

name: Karnataka Agricultural Mechanization and Equipment Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: Karnataka कृषि यंत्रीकरण एवं कृषि उपकरण अनुदान योजना
description: Provides 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved modern farm machinery (tractors, power rotavators, seed drills, sprayers, threshers) for farmers in Karnataka.
description_hi: Karnataka के किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, सीड ड्रिल एवं कृषि ड्रोन क्रय करने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers holding agricultural land in Karnataka
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural implements from empanelled dealers
Enhanced subsidy quota for SC, ST, and women farmers
Reduces farm labor shortage and boosts crop productivity
application_steps: Register on Karnataka Agriculture portal (https://raitamitra.karnataka.gov.in/)
Select machinery and authorized dealer
Lottery token generation, purchase equipment, and receive subsidy after field geo-tagging

name: Karnataka Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment)
description: Credit-linked enterprise loan subsidy scheme facilitating bank loans up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹10 Lakhs in services with 15% to 25% margin money subsidy for youth in Karnataka.
description_hi: Karnataka के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग अथवा सेवा प्रतिष्ठान स्थापित करने हेतु बैंक ऋण एवं 25% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Commerce and Industries, Karnataka
department: Department of Commerce and Industries, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-40 residing in Karnataka setting up new micro-enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25 Lakh) for projects up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing
Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹2.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹10 Lakhs in service sector
Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDP) sponsored by state government
application_steps: Apply online through https://kum.karnataka.gov.in/
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview and recommendation to bank
Bank loan sanction and subsidy credited into escrow account

name: Karnataka Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana (Rural / Urban Housing)
description: Provides financial grant of up to ₹1,30,000 for constructing disaster-resilient pucca houses for poor families in Karnataka who were left out of Central PMAY lists.
description_hi: Karnataka के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले निर्धन परिवारों (जो पीएम आवास से छूटे हों) को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.30 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Poor families living in kutcha houses in Karnataka belonging to SC, ST, Musahar, Vanya, leprosy-affected, or disabled categories
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 paid in 3 milestone installments directly into bank account
Additional 90 days unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG under Ujjwala
application_steps: Beneficiaries verified through Gram Sabha / Urban Local Body survey
Administrative sanction by District Magistrate / BDO
Stage-wise geo-tagged release of funds into beneficiary's bank account

description_hi: Tamil Nadu के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले निर्धन परिवारों (जो पीएम आवास से छूटे हों) को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.30 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Poor families living in kutcha houses in Tamil Nadu belonging to SC, ST, Musahar, Vanya, leprosy-affected, or disabled categories
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 paid in 3 milestone installments directly into bank account
Additional 90 days unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG under Ujjwala
application_steps: Beneficiaries verified through Gram Sabha / Urban Local Body survey
Administrative sanction by District Magistrate / BDO
Stage-wise geo-tagged release of funds into beneficiary's bank account

name: Tamil Nadu Mukhyamantri Kanyadan / Vivah Sahayata Yojana
name_hi: Tamil Nadu मुख्यमंत्री कन्यादान / विवाह सहायता योजना
description: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 provided by Tamil Nadu Government to poor parents for the marriage of their daughters aged 18 or above.
description_hi: Tamil Nadu के गरीब, श्रमिक एवं बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹31,000 से ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Directorate of Social Welfare, Tamil Nadu
department: Directorate of Social Welfare, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: BPL, labor card holders, and low-income families domiciled in Tamil Nadu marrying daughters aged 18+ years
benefits: One-time cash grant credited directly into bride's bank account via DBT
Substantial relief from indebtedness caused by marriage expenses
documents: Bride's Age Proof (Aadhaar / Class 10 certificate proving age ≥18)
application_steps: Apply online via https://socialwelfare.tn.gov.in/ or at local Block Development Office
Verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct payment into bride's bank account

name: Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes & Minorities
name_hi: Tamil Nadu दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: State scholarship program providing full or partial tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances to OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Tamil Nadu.
description_hi: Tamil Nadu के पिछड़े एवं वंचित वर्ग के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Tamil Nadu pursuing post-matric courses with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Reimbursement of mandatory institutional tuition fees as fixed by the State Fee Committee
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Special book and thesis grants for professional and technical degree students
application_steps: Apply online on Tamil Nadu Scholarship Portal (https://escholarship.tn.gov.in/)
College nodal officer verifies academic records and fee demand online
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Tamil Nadu Vridhavastha Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 provided by Tamil Nadu Government to elderly citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income households.
description_hi: Tamil Nadu के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु नियमित मासिक पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above residing in Tamil Nadu living below the state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into the elderly citizen's bank account via DBT
Free geriatric health check-ups and diagnostic support at government health facilities
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age ≥60)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://www.tn.gov.in/scheme/department_wise/31 or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Ward Office
Field verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Tamil Nadu Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Kosh (Medical Relief Fund)
name_hi: Tamil Nadu मुख्यमंत्री चिकित्सा सहायता कोष
description: Discretionary emergency financial grant providing up to ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 for critical surgeries and medical treatment for patients belonging to BPL/low-income families in Tamil Nadu.
description_hi: Tamil Nadu के निर्धन मरीजों को हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, न्यूरोसर्जरी एवं किडनी डायलिसिस/प्रत्यारोपण हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी आपातकालीन चिकित्सा अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
department: Directorate of Medical and Health Services
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Tamil Nadu suffering from major life-threatening diseases with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹5,00,000 for organ transplants) paid directly to the empaneled treating hospital
Immediate relief for major cardiac, renal, neurological, and oncology surgeries
documents: Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/yr) or BPL Ration Card
Medical Estimate and Diagnostic Report from Government Specialist
application_steps: Get treatment estimate signed by Medical Superintendent of empaneled hospital
Submit application to District Magistrate (DM) / Chief Minister's Relief Cell
Sanction issued and funds transferred directly to hospital account

name: Tamil Nadu Youth Apprenticeship and Skill Promotion Scheme
name_hi: Tamil Nadu युवा कौशल विकास एवं शिक्षुता संवर्धन योजना
description: State skill apprenticeship initiative providing industry-aligned practical training and monthly stipends of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 for youth in Tamil Nadu.
description_hi: Tamil Nadu के 10वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई एवं डिप्लोमा धारक युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक ऑन-द-जॉब प्रशिक्षण तथा मासिक सरकारी वजीफा।
ministry: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-30 domiciled in Tamil Nadu seeking technical apprenticeships
benefits: Monthly apprenticeship stipend of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 (with 50% state DBT subsidy contribution)
State Skill Mission certification and direct hiring opportunities in industrial estates
application_steps: Register on Tamil Nadu Employment / Skill portal
Apply to local industrial apprenticeship slots
Contract signing and monthly stipend disbursement

name: Tamil Nadu Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST & OBC Students
name_hi: Tamil Nadu पूर्व-दशम छात्रवृत्ति योजना (कक्षा 9 एवं 10)
description: Financial scholarship providing ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 per year to underprivileged SC, ST, and OBC students in Class 9 and 10 in Tamil Nadu to curb dropouts before matriculation.
description_hi: Tamil Nadu के कक्षा 9वीं और 10वीं में अध्ययनरत अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाई जारी रखने हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Students in Class 9 and 10 domiciled in Tamil Nadu with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 credited directly into student's bank account via DBT
Additional ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000 per year for day scholars and hostellers for books and stationery
application_steps: Apply online on Tamil Nadu Scholarship Portal (https://escholarship.tn.gov.in/) or via school headmaster
School head verifies and submits master list
Direct DBT disbursement to student's account

name: Telangana Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
description: State welfare pension providing regular monthly financial subsistence directly to destitute and low-income widows domiciled in Telangana.
description_hi: Telangana की निराश्रित एवं निर्धन विधवा महिलाओं को सम्मानजनक जीवन एवं आर्थिक संबल हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department, Telangana
department: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department, Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 18 and above domiciled in Telangana living in low-income or BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Health assistance and social security coverage under state welfare programs
application_steps: Apply online through Telangana e-District portal (https://aasara.telangana.gov.in/) or at local Block/Tehsil office
Verification by local revenue authority and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Telangana Divyangjan Disability Pension Scheme
description: Provides monthly financial disability pension directly to persons with benchmark disability of 40% or more domiciled in Telangana.
description_hi: Telangana के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department, Telangana
department: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department, Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability domiciled in Telangana with family income below state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly disability pension directly credited via DBT to bank account
Concessional public bus travel passes within state borders
Priority in free distribution of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and hearing aids
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board (≥40%)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://aasara.telangana.gov.in/ or through District Social Welfare Office
Verification of medical certificate and domicile
Monthly DBT release

name: Telangana Agricultural Mechanization and Equipment Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: Telangana कृषि यंत्रीकरण एवं कृषि उपकरण अनुदान योजना
description: Provides 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved modern farm machinery (tractors, power rotavators, seed drills, sprayers, threshers) for farmers in Telangana.
description_hi: Telangana के किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, सीड ड्रिल एवं कृषि ड्रोन क्रय करने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Agriculture and Cooperation Department, Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers holding agricultural land in Telangana
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural implements from empanelled dealers
Enhanced subsidy quota for SC, ST, and women farmers
Reduces farm labor shortage and boosts crop productivity
application_steps: Register on Telangana Agriculture portal (https://agri.telangana.gov.in/)
Select machinery and authorized dealer
Lottery token generation, purchase equipment, and receive subsidy after field geo-tagging

name: Telangana Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment)
description: Credit-linked enterprise loan subsidy scheme facilitating bank loans up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹10 Lakhs in services with 15% to 25% margin money subsidy for youth in Telangana.
description_hi: Telangana के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग अथवा सेवा प्रतिष्ठान स्थापित करने हेतु बैंक ऋण एवं 25% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: Industries and Commerce Department, Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-40 residing in Telangana setting up new micro-enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25 Lakh) for projects up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing
Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹2.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹10 Lakhs in service sector
Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDP) sponsored by state government
application_steps: Apply online through https://ipass.telangana.gov.in/
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview and recommendation to bank
Bank loan sanction and subsidy credited into escrow account

description_hi: Punjab के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
department: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability domiciled in Punjab with family income below state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly disability pension directly credited via DBT to bank account
Concessional public bus travel passes within state borders
Priority in free distribution of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and hearing aids
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board (≥40%)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://punjab.gov.in/ or through District Social Welfare Office
Verification of medical certificate and domicile
Monthly DBT release

name: Punjab Agricultural Mechanization and Equipment Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: Punjab कृषि यंत्रीकरण एवं कृषि उपकरण अनुदान योजना
description: Provides 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved modern farm machinery (tractors, power rotavators, seed drills, sprayers, threshers) for farmers in Punjab.
description_hi: Punjab के किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, सीड ड्रिल एवं कृषि ड्रोन क्रय करने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Punjab
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers holding agricultural land in Punjab
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural implements from empanelled dealers
Enhanced subsidy quota for SC, ST, and women farmers
Reduces farm labor shortage and boosts crop productivity
application_steps: Register on Punjab Agriculture portal (https://agri.punjab.gov.in/)
Select machinery and authorized dealer
Lottery token generation, purchase equipment, and receive subsidy after field geo-tagging

name: Punjab Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment)
description: Credit-linked enterprise loan subsidy scheme facilitating bank loans up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹10 Lakhs in services with 15% to 25% margin money subsidy for youth in Punjab.
description_hi: Punjab के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग अथवा सेवा प्रतिष्ठान स्थापित करने हेतु बैंक ऋण एवं 25% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Punjab
department: Department of Industries and Commerce, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-40 residing in Punjab setting up new micro-enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25 Lakh) for projects up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing
Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹2.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹10 Lakhs in service sector
Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDP) sponsored by state government
application_steps: Apply online through https://pbindustries.gov.in/
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview and recommendation to bank
Bank loan sanction and subsidy credited into escrow account

name: Punjab Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana (Rural / Urban Housing)
description: Provides financial grant of up to ₹1,30,000 for constructing disaster-resilient pucca houses for poor families in Punjab who were left out of Central PMAY lists.
description_hi: Punjab के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले निर्धन परिवारों (जो पीएम आवास से छूटे हों) को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.30 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Poor families living in kutcha houses in Punjab belonging to SC, ST, Musahar, Vanya, leprosy-affected, or disabled categories
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 paid in 3 milestone installments directly into bank account
Additional 90 days unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG under Ujjwala
application_steps: Beneficiaries verified through Gram Sabha / Urban Local Body survey
Administrative sanction by District Magistrate / BDO
Stage-wise geo-tagged release of funds into beneficiary's bank account

name: Punjab Mukhyamantri Kanyadan / Vivah Sahayata Yojana
name_hi: Punjab मुख्यमंत्री कन्यादान / विवाह सहायता योजना
description: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 provided by Punjab Government to poor parents for the marriage of their daughters aged 18 or above.
description_hi: Punjab के गरीब, श्रमिक एवं बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹31,000 से ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Department of Social Security and WCD, Punjab
department: Department of Social Security and WCD, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: BPL, labor card holders, and low-income families domiciled in Punjab marrying daughters aged 18+ years
benefits: One-time cash grant credited directly into bride's bank account via DBT
Substantial relief from indebtedness caused by marriage expenses
documents: Bride's Age Proof (Aadhaar / Class 10 certificate proving age ≥18)
application_steps: Apply online via https://sswcd.punjab.gov.in/ or at local Block Development Office
Verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct payment into bride's bank account

name: Punjab Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes & Minorities
name_hi: Punjab दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: State scholarship program providing full or partial tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances to OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Punjab.
description_hi: Punjab के पिछड़े एवं वंचित वर्ग के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Punjab
department: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Punjab pursuing post-matric courses with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Reimbursement of mandatory institutional tuition fees as fixed by the State Fee Committee
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Special book and thesis grants for professional and technical degree students
application_steps: Apply online on Punjab Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.punjab.gov.in/)
College nodal officer verifies academic records and fee demand online
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Punjab Vridhavastha Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 provided by Punjab Government to elderly citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income households.
description_hi: Punjab के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु नियमित मासिक पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
department: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above residing in Punjab living below the state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into the elderly citizen's bank account via DBT
Free geriatric health check-ups and diagnostic support at government health facilities
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age ≥60)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://punjab.gov.in/ or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Ward Office
Field verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Punjab Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Kosh (Medical Relief Fund)
description: Discretionary emergency financial grant providing up to ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 for critical surgeries and medical treatment for patients belonging to BPL/low-income families in Punjab.
description_hi: Punjab के निर्धन मरीजों को हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, न्यूरोसर्जरी एवं किडनी डायलिसिस/प्रत्यारोपण हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी आपातकालीन चिकित्सा अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Punjab
department: Directorate of Medical and Health Services
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Punjab suffering from major life-threatening diseases with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹5,00,000 for organ transplants) paid directly to the empaneled treating hospital
Immediate relief for major cardiac, renal, neurological, and oncology surgeries
documents: Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/yr) or BPL Ration Card
Medical Estimate and Diagnostic Report from Government Specialist
application_steps: Get treatment estimate signed by Medical Superintendent of empaneled hospital
Submit application to District Magistrate (DM) / Chief Minister's Relief Cell
Sanction issued and funds transferred directly to hospital account

name: Punjab Youth Apprenticeship and Skill Promotion Scheme
name_hi: Punjab युवा कौशल विकास एवं शिक्षुता संवर्धन योजना
description: State skill apprenticeship initiative providing industry-aligned practical training and monthly stipends of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 for youth in Punjab.
description_hi: Punjab के 10वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई एवं डिप्लोमा धारक युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक ऑन-द-जॉब प्रशिक्षण तथा मासिक सरकारी वजीफा।
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-30 domiciled in Punjab seeking technical apprenticeships
benefits: Monthly apprenticeship stipend of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 (with 50% state DBT subsidy contribution)
State Skill Mission certification and direct hiring opportunities in industrial estates
application_steps: Register on Punjab Employment / Skill portal
Apply to local industrial apprenticeship slots
Contract signing and monthly stipend disbursement

name: Punjab Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST & OBC Students
description: Financial scholarship providing ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 per year to underprivileged SC, ST, and OBC students in Class 9 and 10 in Punjab to curb dropouts before matriculation.
description_hi: Punjab के कक्षा 9वीं और 10वीं में अध्ययनरत अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाई जारी रखने हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Punjab
department: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Students in Class 9 and 10 domiciled in Punjab with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 credited directly into student's bank account via DBT
Additional ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000 per year for day scholars and hostellers for books and stationery
application_steps: Apply online on Punjab Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.punjab.gov.in/) or via school headmaster
School head verifies and submits master list
Direct DBT disbursement to student's account

description: State welfare pension providing regular monthly financial subsistence directly to destitute and low-income widows domiciled in Haryana.
description_hi: Haryana की निराश्रित एवं निर्धन विधवा महिलाओं को सम्मानजनक जीवन एवं आर्थिक संबल हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs & BCs Department, Haryana
department: Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs & BCs Department, Haryana
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 18 and above domiciled in Haryana living in low-income or BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Health assistance and social security coverage under state welfare programs
application_steps: Apply online through Haryana e-District portal (https://pension.socialjusticehry.gov.in/) or at local Block/Tehsil office
Verification by local revenue authority and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

description_hi: Kerala की निराश्रित एवं निर्धन विधवा महिलाओं को सम्मानजनक जीवन एवं आर्थिक संबल हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala
department: Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 18 and above domiciled in Kerala living in low-income or BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Health assistance and social security coverage under state welfare programs
application_steps: Apply online through Kerala e-District portal (https://welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in/) or at local Block/Tehsil office
Verification by local revenue authority and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Kerala Divyangjan Disability Pension Scheme
description: Provides monthly financial disability pension directly to persons with benchmark disability of 40% or more domiciled in Kerala.
description_hi: Kerala के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala
department: Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability domiciled in Kerala with family income below state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly disability pension directly credited via DBT to bank account
Concessional public bus travel passes within state borders
Priority in free distribution of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and hearing aids
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board (≥40%)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in/ or through District Social Welfare Office
Verification of medical certificate and domicile
Monthly DBT release

name: Kerala Agricultural Mechanization and Equipment Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: Kerala कृषि यंत्रीकरण एवं कृषि उपकरण अनुदान योजना
description: Provides 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved modern farm machinery (tractors, power rotavators, seed drills, sprayers, threshers) for farmers in Kerala.
description_hi: Kerala के किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, सीड ड्रिल एवं कृषि ड्रोन क्रय करने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Agriculture Development and Farmers' Welfare, Kerala
department: Department of Agriculture Development and Farmers' Welfare, Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers holding agricultural land in Kerala
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural implements from empanelled dealers
Enhanced subsidy quota for SC, ST, and women farmers
Reduces farm labor shortage and boosts crop productivity
application_steps: Register on Kerala Agriculture portal (https://aims.kerala.gov.in/)
Select machinery and authorized dealer
Lottery token generation, purchase equipment, and receive subsidy after field geo-tagging

name: Kerala Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment)
description: Credit-linked enterprise loan subsidy scheme facilitating bank loans up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹10 Lakhs in services with 15% to 25% margin money subsidy for youth in Kerala.
description_hi: Kerala के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग अथवा सेवा प्रतिष्ठान स्थापित करने हेतु बैंक ऋण एवं 25% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Kerala
department: Department of Industries and Commerce, Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-40 residing in Kerala setting up new micro-enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25 Lakh) for projects up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing
Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹2.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹10 Lakhs in service sector
Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDP) sponsored by state government
application_steps: Apply online through https://industry.kerala.gov.in/
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview and recommendation to bank
Bank loan sanction and subsidy credited into escrow account

name: Kerala Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana (Rural / Urban Housing)
description: Provides financial grant of up to ₹1,30,000 for constructing disaster-resilient pucca houses for poor families in Kerala who were left out of Central PMAY lists.
description_hi: Kerala के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले निर्धन परिवारों (जो पीएम आवास से छूटे हों) को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.30 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Poor families living in kutcha houses in Kerala belonging to SC, ST, Musahar, Vanya, leprosy-affected, or disabled categories
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 paid in 3 milestone installments directly into bank account
Additional 90 days unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG under Ujjwala
application_steps: Beneficiaries verified through Gram Sabha / Urban Local Body survey
Administrative sanction by District Magistrate / BDO
Stage-wise geo-tagged release of funds into beneficiary's bank account

name: Kerala Mukhyamantri Kanyadan / Vivah Sahayata Yojana
name_hi: Kerala मुख्यमंत्री कन्यादान / विवाह सहायता योजना
description: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 provided by Kerala Government to poor parents for the marriage of their daughters aged 18 or above.
description_hi: Kerala के गरीब, श्रमिक एवं बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹31,000 से ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Kerala
department: Women and Child Development Department, Kerala
target_beneficiaries: BPL, labor card holders, and low-income families domiciled in Kerala marrying daughters aged 18+ years
benefits: One-time cash grant credited directly into bride's bank account via DBT
Substantial relief from indebtedness caused by marriage expenses
documents: Bride's Age Proof (Aadhaar / Class 10 certificate proving age ≥18)
application_steps: Apply online via https://wcd.kerala.gov.in/ or at local Block Development Office
Verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct payment into bride's bank account

name: Kerala Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes & Minorities
name_hi: Kerala दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: State scholarship program providing full or partial tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances to OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Kerala.
description_hi: Kerala के पिछड़े एवं वंचित वर्ग के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Scheduled Castes Development & Backward Classes Welfare, Kerala
department: Scheduled Castes Development & Backward Classes Welfare, Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Kerala pursuing post-matric courses with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Reimbursement of mandatory institutional tuition fees as fixed by the State Fee Committee
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Special book and thesis grants for professional and technical degree students
application_steps: Apply online on Kerala Scholarship Portal (https://egrantz.kerala.gov.in/)
College nodal officer verifies academic records and fee demand online
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Kerala Vridhavastha Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 provided by Kerala Government to elderly citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income households.
description_hi: Kerala के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु नियमित मासिक पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala
department: Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above residing in Kerala living below the state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into the elderly citizen's bank account via DBT
Free geriatric health check-ups and diagnostic support at government health facilities
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age ≥60)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in/ or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Ward Office
Field verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Kerala Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Kosh (Medical Relief Fund)
description: Discretionary emergency financial grant providing up to ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 for critical surgeries and medical treatment for patients belonging to BPL/low-income families in Kerala.
description_hi: Kerala के निर्धन मरीजों को हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, न्यूरोसर्जरी एवं किडनी डायलिसिस/प्रत्यारोपण हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी आपातकालीन चिकित्सा अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Kerala
department: Directorate of Medical and Health Services
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Kerala suffering from major life-threatening diseases with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹5,00,000 for organ transplants) paid directly to the empaneled treating hospital
Immediate relief for major cardiac, renal, neurological, and oncology surgeries
documents: Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/yr) or BPL Ration Card
Medical Estimate and Diagnostic Report from Government Specialist
application_steps: Get treatment estimate signed by Medical Superintendent of empaneled hospital
Submit application to District Magistrate (DM) / Chief Minister's Relief Cell
Sanction issued and funds transferred directly to hospital account

name: Kerala Youth Apprenticeship and Skill Promotion Scheme
name_hi: Kerala युवा कौशल विकास एवं शिक्षुता संवर्धन योजना
description: State skill apprenticeship initiative providing industry-aligned practical training and monthly stipends of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 for youth in Kerala.
description_hi: Kerala के 10वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई एवं डिप्लोमा धारक युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक ऑन-द-जॉब प्रशिक्षण तथा मासिक सरकारी वजीफा।
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-30 domiciled in Kerala seeking technical apprenticeships
benefits: Monthly apprenticeship stipend of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 (with 50% state DBT subsidy contribution)
State Skill Mission certification and direct hiring opportunities in industrial estates
application_steps: Register on Kerala Employment / Skill portal
Apply to local industrial apprenticeship slots
Contract signing and monthly stipend disbursement

name: Kerala Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST & OBC Students
description: Financial scholarship providing ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 per year to underprivileged SC, ST, and OBC students in Class 9 and 10 in Kerala to curb dropouts before matriculation.
description_hi: Kerala के कक्षा 9वीं और 10वीं में अध्ययनरत अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाई जारी रखने हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Scheduled Castes Development & Backward Classes Welfare, Kerala
department: Scheduled Castes Development & Backward Classes Welfare, Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Students in Class 9 and 10 domiciled in Kerala with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 credited directly into student's bank account via DBT
Additional ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000 per year for day scholars and hostellers for books and stationery
application_steps: Apply online on Kerala Scholarship Portal (https://egrantz.kerala.gov.in/) or via school headmaster
School head verifies and submits master list
Direct DBT disbursement to student's account

description_hi: Jharkhand के कक्षा 9वीं और 10वीं में अध्ययनरत अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाई जारी रखने हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare, JH
department: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare, JH
target_beneficiaries: Students in Class 9 and 10 domiciled in Jharkhand with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 credited directly into student's bank account via DBT
Additional ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000 per year for day scholars and hostellers for books and stationery
application_steps: Apply online on Jharkhand Scholarship Portal (https://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in/) or via school headmaster
School head verifies and submits master list
Direct DBT disbursement to student's account

name: Chhattisgarh Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
description: State welfare pension providing regular monthly financial subsistence directly to destitute and low-income widows domiciled in Chhattisgarh.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh की निराश्रित एवं निर्धन विधवा महिलाओं को सम्मानजनक जीवन एवं आर्थिक संबल हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 18 and above domiciled in Chhattisgarh living in low-income or BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Health assistance and social security coverage under state welfare programs
application_steps: Apply online through Chhattisgarh e-District portal (https://sw.cg.gov.in/) or at local Block/Tehsil office
Verification by local revenue authority and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Chhattisgarh Divyangjan Disability Pension Scheme
description: Provides monthly financial disability pension directly to persons with benchmark disability of 40% or more domiciled in Chhattisgarh.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability domiciled in Chhattisgarh with family income below state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly disability pension directly credited via DBT to bank account
Concessional public bus travel passes within state borders
Priority in free distribution of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and hearing aids
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board (≥40%)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://sw.cg.gov.in/ or through District Social Welfare Office
Verification of medical certificate and domicile
Monthly DBT release

name: Chhattisgarh Agricultural Mechanization and Equipment Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: Chhattisgarh कृषि यंत्रीकरण एवं कृषि उपकरण अनुदान योजना
description: Provides 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved modern farm machinery (tractors, power rotavators, seed drills, sprayers, threshers) for farmers in Chhattisgarh.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, सीड ड्रिल एवं कृषि ड्रोन क्रय करने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Chhattisgarh
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers holding agricultural land in Chhattisgarh
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural implements from empanelled dealers
Enhanced subsidy quota for SC, ST, and women farmers
Reduces farm labor shortage and boosts crop productivity
application_steps: Register on Chhattisgarh Agriculture portal (https://agriportal.cg.nic.in/)
Select machinery and authorized dealer
Lottery token generation, purchase equipment, and receive subsidy after field geo-tagging

name: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment)
description: Credit-linked enterprise loan subsidy scheme facilitating bank loans up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹10 Lakhs in services with 15% to 25% margin money subsidy for youth in Chhattisgarh.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग अथवा सेवा प्रतिष्ठान स्थापित करने हेतु बैंक ऋण एवं 25% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: Commerce and Industries Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-40 residing in Chhattisgarh setting up new micro-enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25 Lakh) for projects up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing
Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹2.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹10 Lakhs in service sector
Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDP) sponsored by state government
application_steps: Apply online through https://industries.cg.gov.in/
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview and recommendation to bank
Bank loan sanction and subsidy credited into escrow account

name: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana (Rural / Urban Housing)
description: Provides financial grant of up to ₹1,30,000 for constructing disaster-resilient pucca houses for poor families in Chhattisgarh who were left out of Central PMAY lists.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले निर्धन परिवारों (जो पीएम आवास से छूटे हों) को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.30 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Poor families living in kutcha houses in Chhattisgarh belonging to SC, ST, Musahar, Vanya, leprosy-affected, or disabled categories
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 paid in 3 milestone installments directly into bank account
Additional 90 days unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG under Ujjwala
application_steps: Beneficiaries verified through Gram Sabha / Urban Local Body survey
Administrative sanction by District Magistrate / BDO
Stage-wise geo-tagged release of funds into beneficiary's bank account

name: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Kanyadan / Vivah Sahayata Yojana
name_hi: Chhattisgarh मुख्यमंत्री कन्यादान / विवाह सहायता योजना
description: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 provided by Chhattisgarh Government to poor parents for the marriage of their daughters aged 18 or above.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के गरीब, श्रमिक एवं बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹31,000 से ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Chhattisgarh
department: Women and Child Development Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: BPL, labor card holders, and low-income families domiciled in Chhattisgarh marrying daughters aged 18+ years
benefits: One-time cash grant credited directly into bride's bank account via DBT
Substantial relief from indebtedness caused by marriage expenses
documents: Bride's Age Proof (Aadhaar / Class 10 certificate proving age ≥18)
application_steps: Apply online via https://mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in/ or at local Block Development Office
Verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct payment into bride's bank account

name: Chhattisgarh Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes & Minorities
name_hi: Chhattisgarh दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: State scholarship program providing full or partial tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances to OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Chhattisgarh.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के पिछड़े एवं वंचित वर्ग के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Tribal and Scheduled Caste Development Department, Chhattisgarh
department: Tribal and Scheduled Caste Development Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Chhattisgarh pursuing post-matric courses with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Reimbursement of mandatory institutional tuition fees as fixed by the State Fee Committee
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Special book and thesis grants for professional and technical degree students
application_steps: Apply online on Chhattisgarh Scholarship Portal (http://postmatric-scholarship.cg.nic.in/)
College nodal officer verifies academic records and fee demand online
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Chhattisgarh Vridhavastha Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 provided by Chhattisgarh Government to elderly citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income households.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु नियमित मासिक पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above residing in Chhattisgarh living below the state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into the elderly citizen's bank account via DBT
Free geriatric health check-ups and diagnostic support at government health facilities
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age ≥60)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://sw.cg.gov.in/ or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Ward Office
Field verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Kosh (Medical Relief Fund)
description: Discretionary emergency financial grant providing up to ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 for critical surgeries and medical treatment for patients belonging to BPL/low-income families in Chhattisgarh.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के निर्धन मरीजों को हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, न्यूरोसर्जरी एवं किडनी डायलिसिस/प्रत्यारोपण हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी आपातकालीन चिकित्सा अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Chhattisgarh
department: Directorate of Medical and Health Services
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Chhattisgarh suffering from major life-threatening diseases with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹5,00,000 for organ transplants) paid directly to the empaneled treating hospital
Immediate relief for major cardiac, renal, neurological, and oncology surgeries
documents: Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/yr) or BPL Ration Card
Medical Estimate and Diagnostic Report from Government Specialist
application_steps: Get treatment estimate signed by Medical Superintendent of empaneled hospital
Submit application to District Magistrate (DM) / Chief Minister's Relief Cell
Sanction issued and funds transferred directly to hospital account

name: Chhattisgarh Youth Apprenticeship and Skill Promotion Scheme
name_hi: Chhattisgarh युवा कौशल विकास एवं शिक्षुता संवर्धन योजना
description: State skill apprenticeship initiative providing industry-aligned practical training and monthly stipends of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 for youth in Chhattisgarh.
description_hi: Chhattisgarh के 10वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई एवं डिप्लोमा धारक युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक ऑन-द-जॉब प्रशिक्षण तथा मासिक सरकारी वजीफा।
ministry: Commerce and Industries Department, Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-30 domiciled in Chhattisgarh seeking technical apprenticeships
benefits: Monthly apprenticeship stipend of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 (with 50% state DBT subsidy contribution)
State Skill Mission certification and direct hiring opportunities in industrial estates
application_steps: Register on Chhattisgarh Employment / Skill portal
Apply to local industrial apprenticeship slots
Contract signing and monthly stipend disbursement
