description_hi: Himachal Pradesh के निर्धन मरीजों को हृदय शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, न्यूरोसर्जरी एवं किडनी डायलिसिस/प्रत्यारोपण हेतु ₹2 लाख से ₹5 लाख तक का सरकारी आपातकालीन चिकित्सा अनुदान।
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Himachal Pradesh
department: Directorate of Medical and Health Services
target_beneficiaries: Patients domiciled in Himachal Pradesh suffering from major life-threatening diseases with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000 (up to ₹5,00,000 for organ transplants) paid directly to the empaneled treating hospital
Immediate relief for major cardiac, renal, neurological, and oncology surgeries
documents: Income Certificate (≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/yr) or BPL Ration Card
Medical Estimate and Diagnostic Report from Government Specialist
application_steps: Get treatment estimate signed by Medical Superintendent of empaneled hospital
Submit application to District Magistrate (DM) / Chief Minister's Relief Cell
Sanction issued and funds transferred directly to hospital account

name: Himachal Pradesh Youth Apprenticeship and Skill Promotion Scheme
name_hi: Himachal Pradesh युवा कौशल विकास एवं शिक्षुता संवर्धन योजना
description: State skill apprenticeship initiative providing industry-aligned practical training and monthly stipends of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 for youth in Himachal Pradesh.
description_hi: Himachal Pradesh के 10वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई एवं डिप्लोमा धारक युवाओं को उद्योगों में व्यावहारिक ऑन-द-जॉब प्रशिक्षण तथा मासिक सरकारी वजीफा।
ministry: Industries Department, Himachal Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-30 domiciled in Himachal Pradesh seeking technical apprenticeships
benefits: Monthly apprenticeship stipend of ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 (with 50% state DBT subsidy contribution)
State Skill Mission certification and direct hiring opportunities in industrial estates
application_steps: Register on Himachal Pradesh Employment / Skill portal
Apply to local industrial apprenticeship slots
Contract signing and monthly stipend disbursement

name: Himachal Pradesh Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST & OBC Students
name_hi: Himachal Pradesh पूर्व-दशम छात्रवृत्ति योजना (कक्षा 9 एवं 10)
description: Financial scholarship providing ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 per year to underprivileged SC, ST, and OBC students in Class 9 and 10 in Himachal Pradesh to curb dropouts before matriculation.
description_hi: Himachal Pradesh के कक्षा 9वीं और 10वीं में अध्ययनरत अनुसूचित जाति, जनजाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग के विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाई जारी रखने हेतु वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Higher Education Department, Himachal Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Students in Class 9 and 10 domiciled in Himachal Pradesh with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 credited directly into student's bank account via DBT
Additional ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000 per year for day scholars and hostellers for books and stationery
application_steps: Apply online on Himachal Pradesh Scholarship Portal (https://hpepass.cgg.gov.in/) or via school headmaster
School head verifies and submits master list
Direct DBT disbursement to student's account

name: Delhi Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
description: State welfare pension providing regular monthly financial subsistence directly to destitute and low-income widows domiciled in Delhi.
description_hi: Delhi की निराश्रित एवं निर्धन विधवा महिलाओं को सम्मानजनक जीवन एवं आर्थिक संबल हेतु प्रतिमाह नियमित पेंशन।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Widows aged 18 and above domiciled in Delhi living in low-income or BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via DBT
Health assistance and social security coverage under state welfare programs
application_steps: Apply online through Delhi e-District portal (https://edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in/) or at local Block/Tehsil office
Verification by local revenue authority and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release

name: Delhi Divyangjan Disability Pension Scheme
description: Provides monthly financial disability pension directly to persons with benchmark disability of 40% or more domiciled in Delhi.
description_hi: Delhi के 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले नागरिकों को मासिक वित्तीय पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Persons with 40% or more benchmark disability domiciled in Delhi with family income below state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly disability pension directly credited via DBT to bank account
Concessional public bus travel passes within state borders
Priority in free distribution of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and hearing aids
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Medical Board (≥40%)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in/ or through District Social Welfare Office
Verification of medical certificate and domicile
Monthly DBT release

name: Delhi Agricultural Mechanization and Equipment Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: Delhi कृषि यंत्रीकरण एवं कृषि उपकरण अनुदान योजना
description: Provides 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved modern farm machinery (tractors, power rotavators, seed drills, sprayers, threshers) for farmers in Delhi.
description_hi: Delhi के किसानों को ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर, रीपर, सीड ड्रिल एवं कृषि ड्रोन क्रय करने पर 40% से 50% तक सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Development Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
department: Development Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers holding agricultural land in Delhi
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural implements from empanelled dealers
Enhanced subsidy quota for SC, ST, and women farmers
Reduces farm labor shortage and boosts crop productivity
application_steps: Register on Delhi Agriculture portal (https://delhi.gov.in/)
Select machinery and authorized dealer
Lottery token generation, purchase equipment, and receive subsidy after field geo-tagging

name: Delhi Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Self-Employment)
description: Credit-linked enterprise loan subsidy scheme facilitating bank loans up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹10 Lakhs in services with 15% to 25% margin money subsidy for youth in Delhi.
description_hi: Delhi के शिक्षित बेरोजगार युवाओं को स्वयं का उद्योग अथवा सेवा प्रतिष्ठान स्थापित करने हेतु बैंक ऋण एवं 25% तक सरकारी मार्जिन मनी अनुदान।
ministry: Industries Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
department: Industries Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth aged 18-40 residing in Delhi setting up new micro-enterprises
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25 Lakh) for projects up to ₹25 Lakhs in manufacturing
Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹2.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹10 Lakhs in service sector
Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDP) sponsored by state government
application_steps: Apply online through https://industries.delhi.gov.in/
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview and recommendation to bank
Bank loan sanction and subsidy credited into escrow account

name: Delhi Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana (Rural / Urban Housing)
description: Provides financial grant of up to ₹1,30,000 for constructing disaster-resilient pucca houses for poor families in Delhi who were left out of Central PMAY lists.
description_hi: Delhi के बेघर एवं कच्चे मकानों में रहने वाले निर्धन परिवारों (जो पीएम आवास से छूटे हों) को पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु ₹1.30 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Poor families living in kutcha houses in Delhi belonging to SC, ST, Musahar, Vanya, leprosy-affected, or disabled categories
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 paid in 3 milestone installments directly into bank account
Additional 90 days unskilled wage labor support under MGNREGA
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG under Ujjwala
application_steps: Beneficiaries verified through Gram Sabha / Urban Local Body survey
Administrative sanction by District Magistrate / BDO
Stage-wise geo-tagged release of funds into beneficiary's bank account

name: Delhi Mukhyamantri Kanyadan / Vivah Sahayata Yojana
name_hi: Delhi मुख्यमंत्री कन्यादान / विवाह सहायता योजना
description: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 to ₹51,000 provided by Delhi Government to poor parents for the marriage of their daughters aged 18 or above.
description_hi: Delhi के गरीब, श्रमिक एवं बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹31,000 से ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी आर्थिक सहायता।
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Delhi
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Delhi
target_beneficiaries: BPL, labor card holders, and low-income families domiciled in Delhi marrying daughters aged 18+ years
benefits: One-time cash grant credited directly into bride's bank account via DBT
Substantial relief from indebtedness caused by marriage expenses
documents: Bride's Age Proof (Aadhaar / Class 10 certificate proving age ≥18)
application_steps: Apply online via https://wcd.delhi.gov.in/ or at local Block Development Office
Verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Social Welfare Officer
Direct payment into bride's bank account

name: Delhi Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes & Minorities
name_hi: Delhi दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
description: State scholarship program providing full or partial tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances to OBC, SC, ST, and EWS students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Delhi.
description_hi: Delhi के पिछड़े एवं वंचित वर्ग के छात्र-छात्राओं हेतु 11वीं, 12वीं, आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक एवं डिग्री कोर्सेज में शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं छात्रवृत्ति।
ministry: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of NCT of Delhi
department: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Students domiciled in Delhi pursuing post-matric courses with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: Reimbursement of mandatory institutional tuition fees as fixed by the State Fee Committee
Monthly maintenance allowance credited directly into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Special book and thesis grants for professional and technical degree students
application_steps: Apply online on Delhi Scholarship Portal (https://edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in/)
College nodal officer verifies academic records and fee demand online
District Welfare Officer approves and releases payment directly via DBT

name: Delhi Vridhavastha Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 provided by Delhi Government to elderly citizens aged 60+ living in BPL or low-income households.
description_hi: Delhi के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को गरिमापूर्ण जीवन हेतु नियमित मासिक पेंशन सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में।
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above residing in Delhi living below the state poverty threshold
benefits: Monthly pension allowance credited directly into the elderly citizen's bank account via DBT
Free geriatric health check-ups and diagnostic support at government health facilities
documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID showing age ≥60)
application_steps: Submit application online via https://edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in/ or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Ward Office
Field verification by local revenue staff and sanction by District Welfare Officer
Direct electronic monthly payment release
